name: 로랜드 뱅크스
text:
[reaction] 당신이 적을 하나 쓰러뜨린 후: 당신이 위치한 장소에서 단서를 1개 발견합니다 (라운드당 1번 한정).
[elder_sign] 효과: 당신이 위치한 장소에 있는 단서마다 +1
back_text: 덱 크기: 30장. 덱 구성 선택지: 레벨 0-5 수호자 카드([guardian]), 레벨 0-2 탐구자 카드([seeker]), 레벨 0-5 중립 카드. 덱 구성 요구조건(덱 크기에 포함되지 않습니다): 로랜드의 38구경 특제 권총, 은폐, 무작위 기본 약점 카드 1장.
flavor: 모든 일은 정확한 규칙과 절차에 따라야 한다. “ㄱ”은 꺾어 써야 하고, “ㅇ”은 왼쪽에서 오른쪽으로 동그라미를 그려야 한다. 지금까지는 이 방법이 잘 먹혔다.
back_flavor: 로랜드는 절차와 규칙을 지키는 것에서 안정감을 느껴왔다. 로랜드는 요원이라는 직업이 어떤 주어진 상황 속에서도 따를 수 있는 지침이 있다는 점에 안도했다. 하지만 최근, 그의 연방 요원 수첩에서는 적혀 있지 않는 케이스를 맡게 되었다. 기괴한 괴물, 시간과 공간을 통하는 차원문, 마법 주문을 맞닥뜨렸을 때 어떻게 해야 하는지는 그의 연방 수첩 어디에도 없었다. 그의 눈으로 보지 못했다면, 결코 믿지 않았을 일들이 일어나고 있었다 …. 그리고 이것들을 그의 윗선에서 이해할리도 없었다. 로랜드는 자신의 힘만으로 이 사건을 해결해야 함을 직감했다.
real_text:
[reaction] After you defeat an enemy: Discover 1 clue at your location. (Limit once per round.)
[elder_sign] effect: +1 for each clue on your location.

name: 웬디 애덤스
text:
[reaction] 당신이 혼돈 토큰을 공개할 때, 당신의 손에서 카드를 1장 선택해서 버립니다: 공개된 혼돈 토큰을 취소하고 주머니에 반납합니다. 새로운 혼돈 토큰을 공개합니다(테스트/기능당 1번 한정).
[elder_sign] 효과: +0. ‘웬디의 부적’이 플레이 상태라면, +0 대신 자동 성공합니다.
back_text: 덱 크기: 30장. 덱 구성 선택지: 레벨 0-5 생존자 카드([survivor]), 레벨 0-2 무법자 카드([rogue]), 레벨 0-5 중립 카드. 덱 구성 요구조건(덱 크기에 포함되지 않습니다): 웬디의 부적, 홀로 남겨지다, 무작위 기본 약점 카드 1장.
back_flavor: 웬디가 어렸을 때, 그녀의 어머니는 웬디의 목걸이를 가지고 함께 놀아주곤 했다. 그녀의 어머니는 자신의 이야기를 들려주었고, 웬디는 반짝이는 목걸이를 빙빙 돌리며 바라보곤 했다. 그러던 어느 날, 그녀의 아버지가 바다에서 실종되었고, 그 이후 어머니는 기이한 행동을 하기 시작했다. 집안 구석구석에 이상한 표식을 그렸던 것이다. 결국 웬디의 어머니는 정신병원으로 끌려 갔고, 웬디는 고아원으로 가게 되었다. 웬디의 어머니가 정신병원으로 끌려가기 전, 어머니는 웬디를 “보호해주기 위해” 웬디에게 자신의 목걸이를 주었다. 웬디는 고아원에서 몇 해를 보내다가, 홀로 살아가는 것이 더 나을 것이라는 확신을 갖고 고아원에서 도망쳤다.
real_text:
[reaction] When you reveal a chaos token, choose and discard 1 card from your hand: Cancel that chaos token and return it to the bag. Reveal a new chaos token. (Limit once per test/ability.)
[elder_sign] effect: +0. If Wendy's Amulet is in play, you automatically succeed instead.

name: “스키즈” 오'툴
text:
[free] 당신의 차례 도중, 자원을 2개 소비합니다: 당신은 이번 차례에 추가로 행동 하나를 더 해도 됩니다(차례당 1번 한정).
[elder_sign] 효과: +2. 성공하면, 자원을 2개 획득합니다.
back_text: 덱 크기: 30장. 덱 구성 선택지: 레벨 0-5 무법자 카드([rogue]), 레벨 0-2 수호자 카드([guardian]), 레벨 0-5 중립 카드. 덱 구성 요구조건(덱 크기에 포함되지 않습니다): 줄행랑, 병원 빚, 무작위 기본 약점 카드 1장.
flavor: “이봐. 난 세상의 종말을 보려고 철창 밖으로 나온 게 아니라고.”
back_flavor: 스키즈는 범죄자로 살아갈 생각은 없었다. 하지만 때론 옳은 일을 해야할 때 자신의 손이 더러워지는 것을 감수할 필요가 있었다. 경찰은 스키즈가 모친의 수술비로 인해 돈이 필요한 것을 고려해주지 않았다. 결국 스키즈의 어머니는 스키즈가 감옥에 들어간 후 2년 만에 돌아가셨다. 그의 감방 동료인 브래드 홀린스는 스키즈에게 세상엔 죽음보다 더 나쁜 운명도 존재한다고 말해주었다. 그는 매일 저녁 조용한 목소리로 “고대의 존재”에 대해 중얼거렸고, 자신의 꿈에 나오는 괴상한 모험담을 들려주었다. 스키즈는 어느 날 밤 브래드가 화염 속에서 불타 죽는 광경을 본 뒤에야 그의 말을 믿게 되었다. 시간이 흘러 스키즈는 마침내 석방되었고, 해답을 찾기 위해 아컴으로 돌아왔다.

name: “이것 좀 봐!”
text:
신속. 당신이 조사에서 난이도보다 2 이하의 차이로 능력 테스트에 실패한 후 플레이할 수 있습니다.
당신이 위치한 장소에서 단서를 2개 발견합니다.
real_text:
Fast. Play after you fail a skill test by 2 or less while investigating.
Discover 2 clues in your location.

name: 체력 단련
text:
[free] 자원을 1개 소비합니다: 당신은 이번 능력 테스트에서 +1 [willpower]를 얻습니다.
[free] 자원을 1개 소비합니다: 당신은 이번 능력 테스트에서 +1 [combat]을 얻습니다.
real_text:
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [willpower] for this skill test.
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [combat] for this skill test.

name: 야구 방망이
text: [action]: 전투. 당신은 이번 공격에서 +2 [combat]을 얻습니다. 이번 공격은 +1 피해를 줍니다. 이번 공격에서 [skull] 또는 [auto_fail]가 공개되면, 이번 공격을 해결한 후 ‘야구 방망이’를 버립니다.
real_text: [action]: Fight. You get +2 [combat] for this attack. This attack deals +1 damage. If a [skull] or [auto_fail] symbol is revealed during this attack, discard Baseball Bat after the attack resolves.

name: 행운의 토끼 발 부적
text: [reaction] 당신이 능력 테스트에 실패한 후, ‘행운의 토끼 발 부적’을 소진합니다: 카드를 1장 뽑습니다.
flavor: 사람들은 토끼 발 부적이 행운을 가져온다고 말한다. 이전까지는 그런 이야기에 코웃음을 쳤지만, 지금은 그 부적의 행운에라도 매달려야 할 것 같다.
real_text: [reaction] After you fail a skill test, exhaust Rabbit's Foot: Draw 1 card.

name: 데이지 워커
text:
당신의 차례 도중, 당신은 추가로 행동 하나를 더 해도 됩니다. 단, 이 추가 행동은 [[서적]] [action] 기능에만 사용할 수 있습니다.
[elder_sign] 효과: +0. 성공하면, 당신이 조종하는 [[서적]]마다 카드를 1장 뽑습니다.
back_text: 덱 크기: 30장. 덱 구성 선택지: 레벨 0-5 탐구자 카드([seeker]), 레벨 0-2 신비주의자 카드([mystic]), 레벨 0-5 중립 카드. 덱 구성 요구조건(덱 크기에 포함되지 않습니다): 데이지의 토트백, 네크로노미콘(존 디 번역본), 무작위 기본 약점 카드 1장.
flavor: “책에는 매우 강력한 힘이 있어요. 현실을 다시금 쓸 수 있는 힘 말이에요.”
back_flavor: 미스캐토닉 대학의 저명한 사서인 데이지는 언제나 자신의 삶에서 가장 중요한 것은 책이라고 생각하고 있었다. 그녀는 자신이 가장 끔찍하게 여기던 공포, 폭력, 두려움을 탐구하는 방법으로 소설책을 선택했다. 그러던 중, 그녀는 네크로노미콘의 존 디 번역본을 우연히 발견했다. 이 책은 불경스럽고, 배덕적이었으며, 사실이라기엔 너무나도 끔찍했다. 하지만 그녀가 평소에 연구하던 잘 알려져 있지 않은 초자연적인 주제로 볼 때, 데이지는 이 책 안에 소설 같은 가상의 이야기가 아닌 수많은 진실이 담겨있음을 알게 되었다. 그녀는 오른 도서관에서 소장한 금서들에 어떤 다른 비밀이 더 있는지 궁금해졌다‧‧‧.
real_text:
You may take an additional action during your turn, which can only be used on [[Tome]] [action] abilities.
[elder_sign] effect: +0. If you succeed, draw 1 card for each [[Tome]] you control.

name: 네크로노미콘
text: 폭로 - ‘네크로노미콘’을 플레이 영역 중 당신의 위협 영역에 둡니다. 그리고 이 카드에 공포를 3개 올려놓습니다. 이 카드에 공포가 남아 있는 한, 이 카드는 플레이 영역에서 나갈 수 없습니다. 당신이 뽑은 [elder_sign] 혼돈 토큰을 [auto_fail]로 취급합니다. [action]: ‘네크로노미콘’에 올려놓은 공포 1개를 데이지 워커에게 이동시킵니다. 그런 다음, ‘네크로노미콘’에 더 이상 공포가 없다면, 이 카드를 버립니다.
real_text: Revelation - Put The Necronomicon into play in your threat area, with 3 horror on it. It cannot leave play while it has 1 or more horror on it. Treat each [elder_sign] you reveal on a chaos token as a [auto_fail]. [action]: Move 1 horror from The Necronomicon to Daisy Walker. Then, if The Necronomicon has no horror on it, discard it.

name: 신성한 묵주
text: 당신은 +1 [willpower]를 얻습니다.
flavor: 신실한 믿음을 가지면, 평범한 장신구든 신비로운 유물이든 그 종류에 구애되지 않고 강력한 힘을 발휘합니다.
real_text: You get +1 [willpower].

name: 뒤통수치기
text: 전투. 이번 공격은 [combat] 대신 [agility]을 사용합니다. 이번 공격은 +2 피해를 줍니다.
real_text: Fight. This attack uses [agility] instead of [combat]. This attack deals +2 damage.

name: 마체테
text: [action]: 전투. 당신은 이번 공격에서 +1 [combat]을 얻습니다. 공격 받은 적이 당신과 교전 중인 유일한 적이라면, 이번 공격은 +1 피해를 줍니다.
flavor: 덩굴이나 수풀을 헤쳐나갈 때에도 쓰이지만, 이 괴물들의 촉수를 베어 낼 때에도 유용하게 쓰입니다.
real_text: [action]: Fight. You get +1 [combat] for this attack. If the attacked enemy is the only enemy engaged with you, this attack deals +1 damage.

name: 교활한 움직임
text: 회피. 당신이 위치한 장소의 모든 적을 자동 회피합니다.
flavor: 저걸로 조금 시간을 벌었다.
real_text: Evade. Automatically evade all enemies at your location.

name: 뜻밖의 용기
text: 능력 테스트당 최대 1장 소모할 수 있습니다.
flavor: 사람들은 때로 가장 이상한 상황에서 가장 이타적인 행동을 하곤 합니다.
real_text: Max 1 committed per skill test.

name: 냉기 구울
text: Spawn - Cellar.
flavor: Inside the tunnels beneath the house, a massive beast tears its way out of the ice. It is covered in a think layer of frost, its breath visible in the bitter cold.
real_text: Spawn - Cellar.

name: 서재
flavor: The door to your study has vanished.
back_flavor: You've been investigating the strange events occurring in Arkham for several days now. Your deck in covered in newspaper articles, police reports, and witness accounts.

name: 회합
text:
쉬움 / 보통
[skull]: -X. X 는 당신이 위치한 장소에 있는 [[구울]] 적의 수입니다.
[cultist]: -1. 실패하면, 공포를 1 받습니다.
[tablet]: -2. 당신이 위치한 장소에 [[구울]]이 있다면, 당신은 피해를 1 받습니다.
back_text:
어려움 / 전문가
[skull]: -2. 실패하면, 이번 능력 테스트를 한 후 조우 덱과 버린 조우 카드 더미에서 [[구울]] 적을 하나 찾아 그 카드를 뽑습니다. 조우 덱을 섞습니다.
[cultist]: 다른 혼돈 토큰을 하나 더 공개합니다. 실패하면, 공포를 2 받습니다.
[tablet]: -4. 당신이 위치한 장소에 [[구울]] 적이 있다면, 당신은 피해 1과 공포 1을 받습니다.
real_text:
Easy / Standard
[skull] -X. X is the number of [[Ghoul]] enemies at your location.
[cultist] -1. If you fail, take 1 horror.
[tablet] -2. If there is a [[Ghoul]] enemy at your location, take 1 damage.

name: 무슨 일이야?!
back_text: The lead investigator must decide (choose one): Either each investigator discards 1 card at random from his or her hand, or the lead investigator takes 2 horror.
flavor: It is late at night. You are holed up in your study, researching the bloody disappearances that have been taking place in the region. A few hours into your research, you hear the sound of strange chanting coming from your parlor, down the hall. At the same time, you hear dirt churning, as if something were digging beneath the floor.
back_flavor: Your house continues to change before your very eyes. The walls have decayed, and the ground in many rooms has turned to dirt. It is almost as if you have been transported somewhere else entirely, although every now and again you recognize elements of your former home.

name: 구울이 나타나다
back_text: Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck. Discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until a [[Ghoul]] enemy is discarded. The lead investigator draws that enemy.
flavor: The floor beneath you is giving way, and you see a vast network of tunnels, twisting into the darkness below. Shapes and silhouettes of strange creatures move swiftly through the tunnels, trying to find a way up. You probably don't want to be here when they do...
back_flavor: A feral beast, roughly humanoid with a canine cast and hooves for feet, tears through the ground in front of you. Below the floor, you can see vast tunnels beneath your house. Fiendish howling echoes from deep within the underground caverns.

name: 갇히다
back_text:
Put into play the set-aside Hallway, Cellar, Attic, and Parlor.
Discard each enemy in the Study.
Place each investigator in the Hallway.
Remove the Study from the game.
flavor: As you leap to investigate, the door to your study vanishes before your eyes, leaving behind only solid wall. You're trapped inside your study until you can find another way out.
back_flavor:
You notice that the edges of your newly purchased rug are tattered and mud-stained. Finding this odd, you shift the furniture aside and pull back the rug. To your surprise, you see the door leading out of your study. You slowly turn the knob, and the door swings open, revealing your hallway below.
You jump through the doorway, landing on your feet on soft dirt. The door to the study slams shut above you. The smell of burning wood fills the narrow hall, intermingled with the scent of rot and decay.

name: 장벽
text: Objective - When the round ends, investigators in the hallway may, as a group, spend the requisite number of clues to advance.
back_text:
The barrier blocking passage into the parlor has vanished. Reveal the Parlor.
Put the set-aside Lita Chantler into play in the Parlor.
Spawn the set-aside Ghoul Priest in the Hallway.
flavor: A glowing barrier blocks the path to your parlor. As you move toward it, intense heat forces you to back away. Picking up a handful of dirt, you toss it as the barrier and watch in horror as the dirt incinerates. Perhaps there's something in the cellar or attic that can help.
back_flavor: Using the barrel from the attic, you carry ice and snow from the cellar and hurl it at the barrier. The barrier sparks and shudders as it consumes the ice, then hisses and fades out of existence.
real_text: Objective - When the round ends, investigators in the hallway may, as a group, spend the requisite number of clues to advance.

name: 복도
flavor: The walls of your house are splattered with mud, and your hardwood floor is gone, replaced with a dirt path.
back_flavor: A moment of panic and disorientation strikes as you land upon the floor of the hallway. The world spins, as if turned on its head.

name: 다락방
text: Forced - After you enter the Attic: Take 1 horror.
flavor: The bloody carcass of a malformed beast swings from a meat hook chained to the ceiling. Blood drains slowly from the carcass, dripping into a small barrel.
back_flavor: The smell of rotten meat assaults your nostrils as you approach the attic stairs.
real_text: Forced - After you enter the Attic: Take 1 horror.

name: 지하실
text: Forced - After you enter the Cellar: Take 1 damage.
flavor: Your cellar seems to have been replaced with an underground network of icy tunnels and caverns. The cold chills you to the bone.
back_flavor: The stairs leading down to your cellar are slick, and they glisten with a thin layer of ice...
real_text: Forced - After you enter the Cellar: Take 1 damage.

name: 거실
text: [action] Resign. "This is too much for me!" You run out the front door, fleeing in panic. While Lita Chantler is not controlled by a player, she gains: "[action]: Parley. Test [intellect] (4). If you succeed, take control of Lita Chantler."
back_text: The entrance to the Parlor is blocked by a darkly glowing unfathomable barrier. You cannot move into the Parlor.
back_flavor: You're unsure what would happen if you tried to cross the threshold of the strange barrier, but based on its extreme heat, you sure as hell don't want to try.
real_text: [action] Resign. "This is too much for me!" You run out the front door, fleeing in panic. While Lita Chantler is not controlled by a player, she gains: "[action]: Parley. Test [intellect] (4). If you succeed, take control of Lita Chantler."

name: 식인귀
text: Spawn - Attic.
flavor: A monstrous creature feeds from the rotting carcass in the attic.
real_text: Spawn - Attic.

name: 들끓는 쥐 떼
text: Hunter.
flavor: A horde of cruel rats skitters forth in an undulating wave of claws, teeth, and mottled fur.
real_text: Hunter.

name: 구울 하수인
flavor: It was a colossal and nameless blasphemy with glaring red eyes, and it held in bony claws a thing that had been a man, gnawing at the head as a child nibbles at a stick of candy. <cite>H. P. Lovecraft, "Pickman's Model"</cite>

name: 굶주린 구울
text: Prey - Lowest remaining health.
flavor: The sight of the thing raised the question: Do we eat to live, or do we live to eat?
real_text: Prey - Lowest remaining health.

name: 움켜쥐는 손
text: Revelation - Test [agility] (3). For each point you fail by, take 1 damage.
flavor: Decaying hands rise up from below and grasp and claw at your ankles.
real_text: Revelation - Test [agility] (3). For each point you fail by, take 1 damage.

name: 부패한 시체
text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). For each point you fail by, take 1 horror.
flavor: A sickening display of gore causes you to retch. You're glad this wasn't you.
real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). For each point you fail by, take 1 horror.

name: 시끄러운 소음
text: Revelation - Put Dissonant Voices into play in your threat area. You cannot play assets or events. Forced - At the end of the round: Discard Dissonant Voices.
real_text: Revelation - Put Dissonant Voices into play in your threat area. You cannot play assets or events. Forced - At the end of the round: Discard Dissonant Voices.

name: 사교도 시종
text: Spawn - Any empty location. Forced - After Acolyte enters play: Place 1 doom on it.
flavor: It was only a small sacrifice.
real_text: Spawn - Any empty location. Forced - After Acolyte enters play: Place 1 doom on it.

name: 기이한 주문
text: Revelation - Place 2 doom on the nearest [[Cultist]] enemy. If there are no [[Cultist]] enemies in play, search the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[Cultist]] enemy and draw it. Shuffle the encounter deck.
real_text: Revelation - Place 2 doom on the nearest [[Cultist]] enemy. If there are no [[Cultist]] enemies in play, search the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[Cultist]] enemy and draw it. Shuffle the encounter deck.

name: 추적해오는 나이트건트
text:
Hunter.
While attempting to evade Hunting Nightgaunt, double the negative modifier of each revealed chaos token.
flavor: ... they had no faces at all to smile with, but only a suggestive blankness where a face ought to be. <cite>H. P. Lovecraft</cite>
real_text:
Hunter.
While attempting to evade Hunting Nightgaunt, double the negative modifier of each revealed chaos token.

text: Prey - Fewest cards in hand. Forced - When Yithian Observer attacks you: Discard 1 card at random from your hand. If you cannot, Yithian Observer deals +1 damage and +1 horror for this attack.
real_text: Prey - Fewest cards in hand. Forced - When Yithian Observer attacks you: Discard 1 card at random from your hand. If you cannot, Yithian Observer deals +1 damage and +1 horror for this attack.

real_text: Revelation - Place 1 doom on the current agenda. This effect can cause the current agenda to advance.

text: Revelation - Attach to your location. Limit 1 per location. Attached location gets +2 shroud. Forced - After attached location is successfully investigated: Discard Obscuring Fog.
real_text: Revelation - Attach to your location. Limit 1 per location. Attached location gets +2 shroud. Forced - After attached location is successfully investigated: Discard Obscuring Fog.

name: 우몰도스의 분노
text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (5). For each point you fail by, you must either (choose one): Choose and discard a card from your hand, or take 1 damage and 1 horror.
flavor: A deathly chill from below engulfs you, attempting to suck your life force away.
real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (5). For each point you fail by, you must either (choose one): Choose and discard a card from your hand, or take 1 damage and 1 horror.

name: 루스 터너
text: Spawn - St. Mary's Hospital. Forced - After Ruth Turner is evaded: Add her to the victory display.
flavor: Bodies from the morgue have mysteriously gone missing. Perhaps the mortician in St. Mary's had something to do with these disappearances.
real_text: Spawn - St. Mary's Hospital. Forced - After Ruth Turner is evaded: Add her to the victory display.

name: 빅토리아 데버루
text: Spawn - Northside. [action] Spend 5 resources: Parley. Add Victoria Devereux to the victory display.
flavor: Oliver Thomas, the proprietor of the Curiositie Shoppe, has informed you that a new client has taken a keen interest in a mysterious mask...
real_text: Spawn - Northside. [action] Spend 5 resources: Parley. Add Victoria Devereux to the victory display.

name: 애그니스 베이커
text:
[reaction] ‘애그니스 베이커’에 공포를 1개 이상 올려놓은 후: 당신이 위치한 장소의 적 하나에게 피해를 1 줍니다(단계당 1번 한정).
[elder_sign] 효과: 애그니스 베이커가 가진 공포마다 +1.
back_text: 덱 크기: 30장. 덱 구성 선택지: 레벨 0-5 신비주의자 카드([mystic]), 레벨 0-2 생존자 카드([survivor]), 레벨 0-5 중립 카드. 덱 구성 요구조건(덱 크기에 포함되지 않습니다): 하이퍼보리아의 가보, 어두운 기억, 무작위 기본 약점 카드 1장.
flavor: “난 지금과는 다른 삶을 기억해요. 나는 마법과 정복의 시대를 살았어요.”
back_flavor: 애그니스 베이커는 이번 생에서는 그저 그런 종업원에 불과했다. 하지만, 현대 세계에서 상상할 수도 없는 오래 전에, 그녀는 매우 강력한 마녀였다. 모든 일은 어느 날 그녀가 다락방에서 괴상한 유물을 발견하면서 시작되었다. 열쇠처럼 생긴 그 유물은 가족들의 먼지 쌓인 유품들과 함께 보관되어 있었다. 그녀가 이 물건에 손을 대자, 엄청난 기억들이 그녀의 머릿속에 흘러 들어왔고, “하이퍼보리아”라는 한 단어가 떠올랐다. 그녀가 전생의 기억과 환영을 파헤치면 파헤칠수록 그녀의 마법은 강해졌다‧‧‧. 그리고 그녀의 두려움 또한 깊어져갔다.

Agnes Baker deck only.

[free] 자원을 1개 소비합니다: 당신은 이번 능력 테스트에서 +1 [agility]을 얻습니다.

[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [agility] for this skill test.

name: 바리케이드
text: 당신이 위치한 장소에 부착합니다. [[정예]]가 아닌 적은 이 카드가 부착된 장소로 이동할 수 없습니다. 강제 - 한 조사자가 이 카드가 부착된 장소에서 나갈 때: ‘바리케이드’를 버립니다.
real_text: Attach to your location. Non-[[Elite]] enemies cannot move into attached location. Forced - When an investigator leaves attached location: Discard Barricade.

name: 백과사전
text: [action] ‘백과사전’을 소진합니다: 당신이 위치한 장소에 있는 조사자 한 명을 선택합니다. 그 조사자는 이번 단계가 끝날 때까지, 당신이 선택한 능력 하나에 +2를 얻습니다.
flavor: 이 내용은 이해했다고 생각했다. 하지만 페이지를 넘기면 넘길수록, 이 우주적 진실에 대해 우리가 알고 있는 것은 아무것도 없다는 것을 깨달았다.
real_text: [action] Exhaust Encyclopedia: Choose an investigator at your location. That investigator gets +2 to a skill of your choice until the end of the phase.

name: 접이식 칼
text: 신속. [action]: 전투. 난이도보다 2 이상 높은 차이로 능력 테스트에 성공하면, 이번 공격은 +1 피해를 줍니다.
real_text: Fast. [action]: Fight. If you succeed by 2 or more, this attack deals +1 damage.

name: 소매치기
text: [reaction] 당신이 적을 회피한 후, ‘소매치기’를 소진합니다: 카드를 1장 뽑습니다.
real_text: [reaction] After you evade an enemy, exhaust Pickpocketing: Draw 1 card.

name: 레오 데 루카
text: 당신의 차례동안, 당신은 행동을 한 번 추가로 해도 됩니다.
flavor: “난 미시시피에서 태어났어. 루이지애나는 그저 듣기 좋으라고 하는 소리야.”
real_text: You may take an additional action during your turn.

name: 가죽 코트
flavor: 이 코트의 유행은 한참 지났습니다. 하지만 두툼한 탓에 따뜻하고, 적의 위협에도 걱정이 없을 것 같습니다.

name: 생존 본능
text: 이번 능력 테스트에 성공하고 그것이 회피 시도라면, 회피한 조사자는 자신과 교전중인 다른 모든 적에 대해 즉시 교전을 풀어도 됩니다. 그리고 그 조사자는 이어진 장소 한 곳으로 이동해도 됩니다.
real_text: If this skill test is successful during an evasion attempt, the evading investigator may immediately disengage from each other enemy engaged with him or her, and may move to a connecting location.

name: 통찰력
text:
능력 테스트당 최대 1장 소모할 수 있습니다.
이번 테스트에 성공하면, 카드를 1장 뽑습니다.
flavor: 드디어 찾았다!
real_text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
If this test is successful, draw 1 card.

name: 심기증
text: 폭로 - 당신의 위협 영역에 ‘심기증’을 추가합니다. 강제 - 당신이 피해를 받은 후: 직접적인 공포를 1 받습니다. [action][action]: ‘심기증’을 버립니다.
real_text: Revelation - Add Hypochondria to your threat area. Forced - After you take 1 or more damage: Take 1 direct horror. [action] [action]: Discard Hypochondria.

name: 순찰 경찰
text:
당신은 +1 [combat]을 얻습니다.
[free] ‘순찰 경찰’을 버립니다: 당신이 위치한 장소에 있는 적 하나에게 피해를 1 줍니다.
real_text:
You get +1 [combat].
[fast] Discard Beat Cop: Deal 1 damage to an enemy at your location.

name: 응급 처치
text:
사용(소모품 3개). ‘응급 처치’에 더 이상 소모품이 없으면, 이 카드를 버립니다.
[action] 소모품을 1개 소비합니다: 당신이 위치한 장소에 있는 조사자 한 명의 피해나 공포를 1 회복합니다.
real_text:
Uses (3 supplies). If First Aid has no supplies, discard it.
[action] Spend 1 supply: Heal 1 damage or horror from an investigator at your location.

name: 무자비한 일격
text: 이번 능력 테스트가 성공하고 그것이 공격이라면, 이번 공격은 +1 피해를 줍니다.
flavor: 끔찍한 타격음과 함께, 그는 이 혐오스러운 괴물이 움직이지 않을 때까지 때리고 때리고 또 때렸다.
real_text: If this skill test is successful during an attack, that attack deals +1 damage.

name: 낡은 지식의 서
text: [action] ‘낡은 지식의 서’를 소진합니다: 당신이 위치한 장소에 있는 조사자 한 명을 선택합니다. 그 조사자는 자신의 덱 맨 위 카드 3장 중에서 카드 1장을 찾은 뒤, 그 카드를 뽑습니다. 남은 카드들은 그 조사자의 덱에 다시 넣고, 덱을 섞습니다.
real_text: [action] Exhaust Old Book of Lore: Choose an investigator at your location. That investigator searches the top 3 cards of his or her deck for a card, draws it, and shuffles the remaining cards into his or her deck.

name: 연구 사서
text: [reaction] ‘연구 사서’가 플레이 영역에 들어온 후: 당신의 덱에서 [[서적]] 자산을 1장 찾습니다. 그리고 찾은 [[서적]] 자산을 당신의 손에 듭니다. 당신의 덱을 섞습니다.
flavor: “우리 모두 알다시피, 오른 도서관에는 문제가 있었다네. 가여운 아미티지 박사의 상태가 악화되고, 관련 없는 다른이가‧‧‧ 몇 해 전 사고‧‧‧.”
real_text: [reaction] After Research Librarian enters play: Search your deck for a [[Tome]] asset and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck.

name: 의학 서적
text: [action] 당신이 위치한 장소에 있는 조사자 한 명을 선택하고 [intellect] (2)을 테스트합니다. 성공하면, 그 조사자는 피해를 1 회복합니다. 실패하면, 그 조사자는 피해를 1 받습니다.
real_text: [action] Choose an investigator at your location and test [intellect] (2). If you succeed, heal 1 damage from that investigator. If you fail, deal 1 damage to that investigator.

name: 정신력에 달린 문제
text:
신속. 당신의 차례에만 플레이할 수 있습니다.
이번 라운드가 끝날 때까지, 당신은 자신의 [intellect]을 자신의 [combat]과 [agility]으로 사용해도 됩니다.
real_text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Until the end of the round, you may use your [intellect] in place of your [combat] and [agility].

name: 직감에 따라 움직이다
text:
신속. 당신의 차례에만 플레이할 수 있습니다.
당신이 위치한 장소에서 단서를 1개 발견합니다.
real_text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Discover 1 clue at your location.

name: 추론
text: 이번 능력 테스트가 성공하고 그것이 장소 조사라면, 그 장소에서 추가로 단서를 1개 더 발견합니다.
flavor: 이 상징을 이전에 본 적이 있는데‧‧‧ 더 늦기 전에 다른 사람들에게 알려줘야 해!
real_text: If this skill test is successful while investigating a location, discover 1 additional clue at that location.

name: 빈집털이
text: [action] ‘빈집털이’를 소진합니다: 조사. 성공하면, 단서를 발견하는 대신 자원을 3개 획득합니다.
real_text: [action] Exhaust Burglary: Investigate. If you succeed, instead of discovering clues, gain 3 resources.

name: 41구경 데린저
text: 사용(탄약 3발). [action] 탄약을 1발 소비합니다: 전투. 당신은 이번 공격에서 +2 [combat]을 얻습니다. 난이도보다 2 이상 높은 차이로 능력 테스트에 성공하면, 이번 공격은 +1 피해를 줍니다.
real_text: Uses (3 ammo). [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You get +2 [combat] for this attack. If you succeed by 2 or more, this attack deals +1 damage.

name: 역경
text:
[free] 자원을 1개 소비합니다: 당신은 이번 능력 테스트에서 +1 [combat]을 얻습니다.
[free] 자원을 1개 소비합니다: 당신은 이번 능력 테스트에서 +1 [agility]을 얻습니다.
real_text:
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [combat] for this skill test.
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [agility] for this skill test.

name: 도피
text:
신속. 당신의 차례에만 플레이할 수 있습니다.
당신과 교전 중인 모든 적과 교전이 풀리고, 당신은 적이 없는 공개된 장소로 이동합니다.
real_text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Disengage from each enemy engaged with you and move to a revealed location with no enemies.

name: 기습
text: 당신이 위치한 장소에 있고, 소진 상태인 적 하나에게 피해를 2 줍니다.
real_text: Deal 2 damage to an exhausted enemy at your location.

name: 기회주의자
text:
당신이 수행하는 능력 테스트에서만 소모할 수 있습니다.
난이도보다 3 이상 높은 차이로 능력 테스트에 성공하면, 이 테스트가 끝난 후 ‘기회주의자’ 카드를 버리는 대신 당신의 손으로 가져옵니다.
real_text:
Commit only to a skill test you are performing.
If you succeed by 3 or more, return Opportunist to your hand after this test instead of discarding it.

name: 쓰레기 더미 뒤지기
text: [reaction] 당신이 난이도보다 2 이상 높은 차이로 조사에 성공한 후, ‘쓰레기 더미 뒤지기’를 소진합니다: 당신의 버린 카드 더미에서 [[물품]] 카드를 1장 선택하여 당신의 손에 듭니다.
real_text: [reaction] After you successfully investigate by 2 or more, exhaust Scavenging: Choose an [[Item]] card in your discard pile and add it to your hand.

name: 귀신이 들리다
text: 폭로 - 당신의 위협 영역에 ‘귀신이 들리다’를 추가합니다. 당신의 모든 능력은 -1을 얻습니다. [action][action]: ‘귀신이 들리다’를 버립니다.
real_text: Revelation - Add Haunted to your threat area. You get -1 to each of your skills. [action] [action]: Discard Haunted.

name: 구울 사제
text: Prey - Highest [combat]. Hunter. Retaliate.
flavor: A figure in red robes wearing a bone mask. It gibbers and snarls before leaping to attack.
real_text: Prey - Highest [combat]. Hunter. Retaliate.

name: 공포에 얼어붙다
text: Revelation - Put Frozen in Fear into play in your threat area. The first time you perform one of the following actions (move, fight, or evade) each round, it costs 1 additional action. Forced - At the end of your turn: Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, discard Frozen in Fear.
real_text: Revelation - Put Frozen in Fear into play in your threat area. The first time you perform one of the following actions (move, fight, or evade) each round, it costs 1 additional action. Forced - At the end of your turn: Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, discard Frozen in Fear.

name: 구울들이 뛰쳐나간다!
text: Forced - At the end of the enemy phase: Each unengaged [[Ghoul]] enemy moves 1 location towards the Parlor. Forced - At the end of the round: Place 1 doom on this agenda for each [[Ghoul]] enemy in the Hallway or Parlor.
back_text: - If the investigators are at Act 1 or 2, they are trapped inside the house as the ghouls tear them apart. (→R3) - If the investigators are at Act 3, they barely escape with their lives, allowing the ghouls to run rampant. Each investigator that has not resigned is defeated and suffers 1 physical trauma.
flavor: You hear a crazed howl outside, and suddenly all the creatures turn their attention to that sound. They rush to escape the house, breaking down doors and clawing at everything in their way.
back_flavor: The ground begins to shake and you can see claws rising up from the dirt as uncanny creatures desperately try to claw their way out of the ground all around you. Everywhere you turn, you see monsters rising from the earth. Terrified, you flee as fast as you can.
real_text: Forced - At the end of the enemy phase: Each unengaged [[Ghoul]] enemy moves 1 location towards the Parlor. Forced - At the end of the round: Place 1 doom on this agenda for each [[Ghoul]] enemy in the Hallway or Parlor.

name: 대체 무슨 짓이야?
text: Objective - If the Ghoul Priest is Defeated, advance.
back_text: The lead investigator must decide (choose one): - It was never much of a home. Burn it down! (→R1) - This hell-pit is my home! No way are we burning it! (→R2)
flavor: A woman with a torch stands in your parlor, a glimmer of hatred in her eyes. "What have you done to my barrier?" she screams, furious. Before you can enter, a ghastly wail sounds behind you, and a creature wearing robes and a deer skull mask tears through the wall, advancing towards you.
back_flavor:
When the robed creature falls, the fiendish swarm burrows back into the ground and the chaos of the house quiets. But the stranger in your parlor chamber doesn't seem relieved.
"You broke my seal that was set to trap the ghouls within." She raises her torch. "Now, we must take more direct measures and burn this hell-pit to the ground!"
real_text: Objective - If the Ghoul Priest is Defeated, advance.

name: 병원 빚
text: 폭로 - ‘병원 빚’을 플레이 영역 중 당신의 위협 영역에 둡니다. [free]: 당신의 자원 저장소에서 자원을 1개 ‘병원 빚’으로 이동시킵니다(라운드당 2번 한정). 강제 - 게임이 끝날 때, ‘병원 빚’에 놓인 자원이 5개 이하라면: 당신은 이번 시나리오에서 경험치를 2만큼 적게 얻습니다.
real_text: Revelation - Put Hospital Debts into play in your threat area. [fast]: Move 1 resource from your resource pool to Hospital Debts. (Limit twice per round.) Forced - When the game ends, if Hospital Debts has fewer than 6 resources on it: You earn 2 fewer experience for this scenario.

name: 추가 장전
text: 당신이 위치한 장소에 있는 조사자 한 명이 조종하는 [[총]] 자산에 탄약을 3발 올려놓습니다.
flavor: 총알 맞고도 멀쩡한 괴물은 여지껏 본 적이 없다네.
real_text: Place 3 ammo tokens on a [[Firearm]] asset controlled by an investigator at your location.

name: 산탄총
text: 사용(탄약 2발). [action] 탄약을 1발 소비합니다: 전투. 당신은 이번 공격에서 +3 [combat]을 얻습니다. 이번 공격은 기본 피해 대신 능력값이 난이도를 넘어선 차이만큼 피해를 줍니다(최소 1, 최대 5). 이번 공격에 실패하고 다른 조사자에게 피해를 주려 하면, 이번 공격은 능력값이 난이도에 모자란 차이만큼 다른 조사자에게 피해를 줍니다(최소 1, 최대 5).
real_text: Uses (2 ammo). [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You get +3 [combat] for this attack. Instead of its standard damage, this attack deals 1 damage for each point you succeed by (to a minimum of 1, to a maximum of 5). If you fail and would damage another investigator, this attack deals 1 damage for each point you fail by (to a minimum of 1, to a maximum of 5).

name: 돋보기
text:
신속.
당신은 조사하는 동안 +1 [intellect]을 얻습니다.
[free] 당신이 위치한 장소에 단서가 없다면: ‘돋보기’를 당신의 손으로 가져옵니다.
flavor: 보이지 않는 세계를 투과하는 렌즈. 때로는 당신이 보길 원치 않던 존재를 보여주기도 합니다.
real_text:
Fast.
You get +1 [intellect] while investigating.
[fast] If there are no clues on your location: Return Magnifying Glass to your hand.

name: 조이 사마라스
text:
[reaction] 적 하나가 당신과 교전한 후: 자원을 1개 획득합니다.
[elder_sign] 효과: +1. 이번 능력 테스트가 성공하고 그것이 공격이라면, 이번 공격은 +1 피해를 줍니다.
back_text: 덱 크기: 30장. 덱 구성 선택지: 레벨 0-5 수호자 카드([guardian]), 레벨 0-5 중립 카드, 이외의 레벨 0 다른 역할군([seeker], [rogue], [mystic], [survivor]) 카드 최대 5장. 덱 구성 요구조건(덱 크기에 포함되지 않습니다): 조이의 십자가, 악을 처단하라, 무작위 기본 약점 카드 1장.
flavor: “신께서 말씀하신 바에 따라, 망설이지 않고 그 뜻을 따르겠어.”
back_flavor: 조이는 여섯 살이었을 적, 신의 부름을 받고 자신이 특별한 존재라는 것을 깨달았다. 끔찍한 화마가 부모님을 앗아가 버린 그날 밤, 신은 이 세계의 사람들 중에서 자신의 대리인이 될 존재로 조이를 선택했다고 말해 주었다. 조이는 무고한 이를 보호하고 악을 단죄하려 했다. 그때부터 신은 조이가 곤경에 처할 때마다 길을 알려주고, 안정을 찾아 주었다. 조이는 이제 이 도시 저 도시를 옮겨 다니며 요리사로 일하면서 생계를 이어 가고 있다. 그녀는 일을 하지 않을 때면 주님의 목소리를 따라 뜻을 이루고자 밤의 어둠 속으로 발을 내딛는다. 그리고 사악한 존재를 발견하면, 가책이나 망설임 없이 때려눕힌다.
real_text:
[reaction] After you become engaged with an enemy: Gain 1 resource.
[elder_sign] effect: +1. If this skill test is successful during an attack, that attack deals +1 damage.

name: 짐 컬버
text: 당신이 공개하는 [skull] 토큰의 보정값을 “0”으로 취급합니다. 당신이 [elder_sign] 토큰을 공개할 때마다, 당신은 그 대신 [elder_sign] 토큰을 [skull] 토큰으로 취급해도 됩니다. [elder_sign] 효과: +1.
back_text: 덱 크기: 30장. 덱 구성 선택지: 레벨 0-5 신비주의자 카드([mystic]), 레벨 0-5 중립 카드, 이외의 레벨 0 다른 역할군([guardian], [seeker], [rogue], [survivor]) 카드 최대 5장. 덱 구성 요구조건(덱 크기에 포함되지 않습니다): 짐의 트럼펫, 최후의 랩소디, 무작위 기본 약점 카드 1장.
flavor: “아니, 전혀 조용하지 않소. 내가 트럼펫을 불 때면, 죽은 친구들이 정말 사납게 날뛴다오.”
back_flavor: 아버지의 트럼펫을 집어 든 이후, 재즈란 그에게 골칫거리일 따름이었다. 트럼펫의 나팔 안에는 음산한 느낌을 풍기는 다른 세계의 글귀가 적혀 있으나, 연주할 때는 좋은 커피와 같이 부드럽고 짙은 음정이 울려 퍼졌다. 짐은 이 트럼펫 덕에 많은 연주 계약을 따냈다. 짐이 장례식장에서 연주를 하자 젠킨스 씨의 미망인이 관에서 일어나 춤을 춘 그 날까지는 말이다. 그 이후로, 짐은 당최 일을 구할 수 없었다. 재즈에 대해, 그리고 차가운 가을밤에 묘지의 구울들이 떠들어대는 이야기에 대해 많이 알게 된 것도 그때부터다. 얼마 전, 구울은 종말에 관한 이야기를 들려 주었다. 이 세상에 지금 존재하는, 그리고 미래에 나타날 모든 것의 종말인 ‘최후의 랩소디’가 다가온다는 이야기이다. 사실, 짐은 그런 이야기에 그리 신경쓰지 않는다.
real_text:
Treat the modifier on [skull] tokens you reveal as "0."
Anytime you reveal a [elder_sign] token, you may choose to instead treat it as a [skull] token.
[elder_sign] effect: +1.

name: 대박 아니면 쪽박
text:
능력 테스트당 최대 1장 소모할 수 있습니다.
이번 테스트의 난이도가 두 배가 됩니다. 이번 능력 테스트에 성공하면, 테스트의 모든 성공 효과를 두 번씩 해결합니다.
real_text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
Double the difficulty of this skill test. If this skill test is successful, resolve the effects of the successful test twice.

name: 팀워크
text: 당신과 같은 장소에 있는 조사자들은 [[물품]] 자산 또는 [[조력자]] 자산 또는 자원을 서로 원하는 만큼 주거나 교환해도 됩니다.
flavor: 혼자 가는 건 위험하다.
real_text: Investigators at your location may give or trade any number of [[Item]] assets, [[Ally]] assets, or resources among one another.

name: 탐구의 의식
text: 사용(충전 3회). [action] 충전을 1회 소비합니다: 조사. 이번 조사는 [intellect] 대신 [willpower]를 사용합니다. 성공하면, 이 장소에서 추가로 단서를 1개 더 발견합니다. 이번 테스트 동안 [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], [auto_fail] 기호가 공개되면, 이번 테스트를 해결한 후 남은 행동을 모두 잃고 즉시 당신의 차례가 끝납니다.
real_text: Uses (3 charges). [action] Spend 1 charge: Investigate. Investigate using [willpower] instead of [intellect]. If you succeed, discover 1 additional clue at this location. If a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol is revealed during this test, after this test resolves lose all remaining actions and immediately end your turn.

name: 어두운 기억
text: 현재 주요사건에 파멸을 1개 올려놓습니다. 이 효과는 현재 주요사건을 진행시킬 수 있습니다. 강제 - 당신의 차례 끝에 ‘어두운 기억’이 당신의 손에 있다면: ‘어두운 기억’을 공개하고 공포를 2 받습니다.
flavor: 안돼‧‧‧ 다시는‧‧‧!
real_text: Place 1 doom on the current agenda. This effect can cause the current agenda to advance. Forced - If Dark Memory is in your hand at the end of your turn, reveal it and take 2 horror.

name: 데이지의 토트백
text:
데이지 워커 덱 전용.
당신에게 손 슬롯이 2칸 추가됩니다. 이 손 슬롯에서는 [[서적]] 자산만 놓을 수 있습니다.
real_text:
Daisy Walker deck only.
You have 2 additional hand slots, which can only be used to hold [[Tome]] assets.

name: 위기일발
text:
신속. 한 조사자가 당신이 위치한 장소에 있는 ‘약점’이 아니고 [[정예]]가 아닌 적을 회피한 후 플레이할 수 있습니다.
그 적을 조우 덱에 넣고 조우 덱을 섞습니다.
real_text:
Fast. Play after a non-weakness, non-[[Elite]] enemy at your location is evaded.
Shuffle that enemy into the encounter deck.

name: 기괴한 석상
text:
사용(충전 4회). ‘기괴한 석상’에 더 이상 충전이 없으면, 이 카드를 버립니다.
[reaction] 당신이 혼돈 토큰을 공개하려 할 때, 충전을 1회 소비합니다: 혼돈 토큰을 1개 대신 2개 공개합니다. 공개한 토큰 중 1개를 선택하여 해결합니다. 다른 토큰은 무시합니다.
real_text:
Uses (4 charges). If Grotesque Statue has no charges, discard it.
[reaction] When you would reveal a chaos token, spend 1 charge: Reveal 2 chaos tokens instead of 1. Choose 1 of those tokens to resolve, and ignore the other.

name: 불꽃으로 다가가다
text: 조우 덱 맨 위 카드를 뽑습니다. 그런 다음, 당신이 위치한 장소에서 단서를 2개 발견합니다.
flavor: “끝없는 암흑의 바다 한복판, 우리는 그중에서도 무지라는 평온한 외딴섬에서 살아가고 있다. 다만, 우리가 무지에서 벗어나기 위해 더 멀리 항해해야 한다는 의미는 아니다.” <cite>H. P. 러브크래프트, “크툴루의 부름”</cite>
real_text: Draw the top card of the encounter deck. Then, discover 2 clues at your location.

name: 비술 연구
text:
[free] 자원을 1개 소비합니다: 당신은 이번 능력 테스트에서 +1 [willpower]를 얻습니다.
[free] 자원을 1개 소비합니다: 당신은 이번 능력 테스트에서 +1 [intellect]을 얻습니다.
real_text:
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [willpower] for this skill test.
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [intellect] for this skill test.

name: 판돈 독식
text: 자원을 10개 획득합니다.
flavor: “또 이겼어! 자기한테 미안해서 어쩌나~ 오늘은 날이 아닌가봐.”
real_text: Gain 10 resources.

name: 순찰 경찰
text:
당신은 +1 [combat]을 얻습니다.
[free] ‘순찰 경찰’을 소진하고 ‘순찰 경찰’에게 피해를 1 줍니다: 당신과 같은 장소에 있는 적 하나에게 피해를 1 줍니다.
real_text:
You get +1 [combat].
[fast] Exhaust Beat Cop and deal 1 damage to it: Deal 1 damage to an enemy at your location.

name: 레오 데 루카
text: 당신의 차례동안, 당신은 행동을 한 번 추가로 해도 됩니다.
flavor: “난 미시시피에서 태어났어. 루이지애나는 그저 듣기 좋으라고 하는 소리야.”
real_text: You may take an additional action during your turn.

name: 생존 의지
text:
신속. 당신의 차례에만 플레이할 수 있습니다.
당신의 차례가 끝날 때까지, 당신이 수행하는 모든 능력 테스트에서 혼돈 토큰을 공개하지 않습니다.
real_text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Until the end of your turn, do not reveal chaos tokens for any skill tests you perform.

name: 세인트 메리 병원
text: [action]: Heal 3 damage. (Limit once per game.)
flavor: An extended stay at St. Mary's can do wonders for the body, but its effect on one's psyche is unclear.
back_flavor: Arkham's only hospital, St. Mary's has a twenty-four-hour receiving room and is busy at all hours of the night. Doctor Mortimore and Nurse Sharon have been particularly stressed lately, thanks in part to recent events.
real_text: [action]: Heal 3 damage. (Limit once per game.)

name: 미스캐토닉 대학
text: [action]: Search the top 6 cards of your deck for a [[Tome]] or [[Spell]] card and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck.
flavor: The campus is quiet and lonely. Several of the buildings have been left unlocked for students and faculty working late into the night.
back_flavor: Miskatonic University is one of the most prestigious colleges in the Northeast. The university library is famous for its collection of occult books maintained by the esteemed Dr. Henry Armitage.
real_text: [action]: Search the top 6 cards of your deck for a [[Tome]] or [[Spell]] card and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck.

name: 큰길
text: The Main Path is connected to each other [[Woods]] location. [action]: Resign. "There's nothing we can do to stop them!" You flee from the woods, leaving Arkham to its grisly fate.
back_flavor: Hangman's Brook separates Uptown from the woods south of Arkham. Passing over the small bridge, you follow the main path deeper into the trees.
real_text: The Main Path is connected to each other [[Woods]] location. [action]: Resign. "There's nothing we can do to stop them!" You flee from the woods, leaving Arkham to its grisly fate.

name: 조이의 십자가
text:
조이 사마라스 덱 전용.
[reaction] 적 하나가 당신과 교전한 후, ‘조이의 십자가’를 소진하고 자원을 1개 소비합니다: 그 적에게 피해를 1 줍니다.
real_text:
Zoey Samaras deck only.
[reaction] After an enemy becomes engaged with you, exhaust Zoey's Cross and spend 1 resource: Deal 1 damage to that enemy.

name: 악을 처단하라
text: 폭로 - 적 하나를 버릴 때까지 조우 덱 맨 윗장부터 카드를 1장씩 버립니다. 이렇게 버려진 적에게 ‘악을 처단하라’를 부착합니다. 그 적은 당신의 위치에서 가장 먼 장소에 출현합니다. 강제 - 게임이 끝날 때, 이 카드가 부착된 적이 플레이 상태라면: ‘조이 사마라스’는 정신적 트라우마를 하나 겪습니다.
real_text: Revelation - Discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until an enemy is discarded. Attach Smite the Wicked to that enemy and spawn it at the location farthest from you. Forced - When the game ends, if attached enemy is in play: Zoey Samaras suffers 1 mental trauma.

name: 내상
text: 폭로 – ‘내상’을 플레이 영역 중 당신의 위협 영역에 둡니다. 강제 – 당신의 차례 끝에: 직접적인 피해를 1 받습니다. [action][action]: ‘내상’을 버립니다.
real_text: Revelation - Place Internal Injury into play in your threat area. Forced - At the end of your turn: Take 1 direct damage. [action] [action]: Discard Internal Injury.

name: 경찰 배지
text:
당신은 +1 [willpower]를 얻습니다.
[free] 당신이 위치한 장소에 있는 조사자가 자신의 차례를 진행하는 동안, ‘경찰 배지’를 버립니다: 그 조사자는 이번 차례에 행동을 두 번 더 수행해도 됩니다.
real_text:
You get +1 [willpower].
[fast] While an investigator at your location is taking his or her turn, discard Police Badge: That investigator may take 2 additional actions this turn.

name: 쭈그러뜨리기
text: 사용(충전 4회). [action] 충전을 1회 소비합니다: 전투. 이번 공격은 [combat] 대신 [willpower]를 사용합니다. 그리고 +1 피해를 줍니다. 이번 공격에서 [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], [auto_fail] 기호가 공개되면, 공포를 1 받습니다.
real_text: Uses (4 charges). [action] Spend 1 charge: Fight. This attack uses [willpower] instead of [combat] and deals +1 damage. If a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol is revealed during this attack, take 1 horror.

name: 점술
text:
사용(충전 3회).
[action] ‘점술’을 소진하고 충전을 1회 소비합니다: 조우 덱이나 아무 조사자의 덱 중 하나를 골라 위에서 카드를 3장 확인해 봅니다. 확인해 본 카드는 원하는 순서대로 원래 덱에 다시 놓습니다.
real_text:
Uses (3 charges).
[action] Exhaust Scrying and spend 1 charge: Look at the top 3 cards of any investigator's deck or the encounter deck. Return them to the top of that deck in any order.

name: 방탄 조끼
flavor: 탄약은‧‧‧ 12인치 송곳니와는 전혀 다르지.

name: 고대 표식 부적
flavor: 이건 우리 가족이 대대로 물려받은 거란다. 이 부적을 소중히 간직하면, 이 부적이 널 지켜줄 거야.

name: 금단의 지식
text:
사용(비밀 4개). ‘금단의 지식’에 더 이상 비밀이 없으면, 이 카드를 버립니다.
[free] ‘금단의 지식’을 소진하고 공포를 1 받습니다: 비밀 1개를 ‘금단의 지식’에서 당신의 자원 저장소로 이동시킵니다. 이동시킨 토큰은 자원으로 사용합니다.
real_text:
Uses (4 secrets). If Forbidden Knowledge has no secrets, discard it.
[fast] Exhaust Forbidden Knowledge and take 1 horror: Move 1 secret from Forbidden Knowledge to your resource pool, as a resource.

name: Trapper's Cabin
text:
While you are at Trapper's Cabin, you cannot gain resources.
[action] Spend 5 resources: Test [intellect] (3) to convince an old trapper to sell you his last bear trap. If you succeed, take control of the set-aside Bear Trap asset.
back_flavor: After hours of navigating through impenetrable fog and overgrowth, your clothes stick to your skin and you swat at what seems like the thousandth mosquito.
real_text:
While you are at Trapper's Cabin, you cannot gain resources.
[action] Spend 5 resources: Test [intellect] (3) to convince an old trapper to sell you his last bear trap. If you succeed, take control of the set-aside Bear Trap asset.

name: Lady Esprit
text: [action] Exhaust Lady Esprit and deal her 1 horror: Heal 2 damage or gain 2 resources. Any investigator at Lady Esprit's location may activate this ability.
real_text: [action] Exhaust Lady Esprit and deal her 1 horror: Heal 2 damage or gain 2 resources. Any investigator at Lady Esprit's location may activate this ability.

name: Marsh Gug
text: Spawn - Any [[Bayou]] location. Hunter.
flavor: A great thrashing accompanied by an echoing roar turns your blood to ice.
real_text: Spawn - Any [[Bayou]] location. Hunter.

name: Beast of the Bayou
text: Revelation - The Rougarou makes an immediate attack against each investigator at The Rougarou's location and each connecting location. If no attacks were made by this effect, place 1 doom on the current agenda.
flavor: Driven by hunger, it cares for naught but its next meal.
real_text: Revelation - The Rougarou makes an immediate attack against each investigator at The Rougarou's location and each connecting location. If no attacks were made by this effect, place 1 doom on the current agenda.

name: On the Prowl
text: Surge. Revelation - Find a non-[[Bayou]] location with the fewest clues on it. Move The Rougarou (one location at a time) until it enters that location.
flavor: A dreadful howl pierces your eardrums. The Rougarou is on the move...
real_text: Surge. Revelation - Find a non-[[Bayou]] location with the fewest clues on it. Move The Rougarou (one location at a time) until it enters that location.

name: 복수의 때가 오다
text: Forced - When this agenda advances: - If the investigators are at Act 1, put the set-aside Ritual Site into play and spawn the set-aside Umôrdhoth there. - If the investigators are at Act 2 or 3, discard all enemies at the Ritual Site and spawn the set-aside Umôrdhoth there.
back_text: Revelation - Replace the current Act and Agenda with The Devourer Below. This card is both the current Act and the current Agenda. Objective - If Umôrdhoth is defeated, (→R2)
flavor: The world begins to shift and change as the ritual nears its conclusion. The air grows chilly, and the entire forest is covered in a layer of rime. The trees bend unnaturally, and their shadows lengthen into weird shape.
real_text: Forced - When this agenda advances: - If the investigators are at Act 1, put the set-aside Ritual Site into play and spawn the set-aside Umôrdhoth there. - If the investigators are at Act 2 or 3, discard all enemies at the Ritual Site and spawn the set-aside Umôrdhoth there.

name: 적응력
text:
영속.
캠페인에서 게임과 게임 사이에, 당신의 덱에 있는 레벨 0 카드를 최대 2장까지 선택해서 동일한 장수의 레벨 0 카드로 맞바꿔도 됩니다(당신의 조사자에게 적용되는 덱구성 규칙을 모두 따라야 합니다).
real_text:
Permanent.
In between each game of a campaign, you may swap up to two level 0 cards out of your deck in exchange for an equal number of level 0 cards. (You must still follow all deckbuilding rules for your investigator).

name: 너무 깊이 파헤치다
text: 플레이어 순서대로, 각 조사자는 조우 덱 맨 위 카드를 1장씩 뽑습니다. 그런 다음, ‘너무 깊이 파헤치다’를 승점 더미에 추가합니다.
flavor: 한 번 눈에 보인 이상 더는 외면할 수 없는 것도 있습니다.
real_text: In player order, each investigator draws 1 card from the top of the encounter deck. Then, add Delve Too Deep to the victory display.

name: 시간이 얼마 남지 않았다
text: [action]: Resign. You don't want to risk taking too long, so you head to safety with the information you've gathered.
flavor: The minutes pass quickly as your investigation continues.
back_flavor: Twelve bells ring out across the town. It is midnight. There is no time left to investigate the city; you must act based on the information you've collected from the cultists you've found.
real_text: [action]: Resign. You don't want to risk taking too long, so you head to safety with the information you've gathered.

name: 음모를 밝혀내다
text: [action] The investigators spend 2 clues per investigator, as a group: Draw the top card of the Cultist deck. Objective - Find as many unique [[Cultist]] enemies as you can and add them to the victory display. If there are 6 unique [[Cultist]] enemies in the victory display, advance. (Note: Not all 6 of them are in the Cultist deck.)
flavor: You have one night to find the members of this cult and unveil their plan. The more members of the cult you can find and interrogate before midnight, the better.
back_flavor: You've successfully uncovered the identities of all of the cult's high-ranking members within Arkham. The man who had stalked you throughout the city was dedicated in his conviction, as was Herman, the undertaker of the graveyard. Others seemed to have been coerced to aid the cult. Ruth, the mortician, had been told that her family would be killed if she did not supply the ghouls with fresh corpses. Thankfully, you managed to help her escape the hospital safely. Peter, the professor, had to be convinced that his involvement with the cult would do more harm than good. Victoria's obsession with occult artifacts had landed her deep within the cult's web. When you confronted Drew in the asylum, he attacked you - but interestingly, he did so because he thought you were part of the cult. The deeper you delve into this conspiracy, the clearer it becomes that many lives have been ruined by it.
real_text: [action] The investigators spend 2 clues per investigator, as a group: Draw the top card of the Cultist deck. Objective - Find as many unique [[Cultist]] enemies as you can and add them to the victory display. If there are 6 unique [[Cultist]] enemies in the victory display, advance. (Note: Not all 6 of them are in the Cultist deck.)

name: 아컴 강변
flavor: There is something unsettling about the water of the Miskatonic River tonight. It ripples and bubbles as though something is moving beneath the surface.
back_flavor: The banks of the Miskatonic River are lined with docks, warehouses and small shops in a district aptly named Rivertown.

name: 줄행랑
text:

name: 아컴의 숲
back_text: Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck and discard cards from the top until a [[Monster]] enemy is discarded. Spawn that enemy in the Main Path. Then, place 1 doom on that enemy.
flavor: After interrogating members of the conspiracy within Arkham, you have learned that they are performing a rite of vengeance in response to the destruction of one of their master's lairs. You have entered the woods outside Arkham to try and stop them. The woods seem unnaturally cold, and filled with a deathly silence.
back_flavor:
Throughout the woods, a shrieking cry echoes. From somewhere deeper in the forest, a score of hideous voices answer the call, inhuman as the baying of hounds and yet articulate, repeating a singular name:
"Umôrdhoth... Umôrdhoth... Umôrdhoth..."

flavor:
"Umôrdhoth... Umôrdhoth... Umôrdhoth..."
The chanting builds in intensity, echoing into the cold air of the night. The sparse clouds in the sky coalesce above the Arkham woods, blotting out the faint light of the stars.
back_flavor: A dark presence approaches, and you are assaulted by invisible pressures that bring you to your knees. A terrible force threatens to invade your mind and soul. Your throat clenches and your eyes water as the sensation burns through you.
real_text: Each enemy gets +1 fight and +1 evade.

name: 흔적을 조사하다

Search the collection for each enemy recorded in your Campaign Log under "Cultists Who Got Away," and spawn those enemies at the Main Path.
flavor: The evidence you've gathered has led you to the woods south of Arkham, where you believe a ritual to summon a being called "Umôrdhoth" is about to take place. Steeling your resolve, you set forth deeper into the woods, hoping to find the site of this ritual.
back_flavor:
Scattered throughout the forest you've seen glyphs and arcane sigils in various places - etched into the bark of trees, carved upon the faces of stones, and dripped in blood upon the ground. Though you cannot decipher these glyphs, you notice that most of them tend to face south. Following these signs leads you by twists and turns towards a cave in the darkest and coldest part of the forest.
As you advance, shadowy figures emerge from the trees, blocking the only path to the cave.

flavor: The remaining cultists have followed you into the woods to try to stop you, and now they block the path to your objective. They stand ominously beneath the overhanging trees, silent sentinels in the night. You must defeat them or sneak past if you are to gain access to the site of their ritual.
back_flavor: When you enter the cave, the air grows cold, and your nostrils are assaulted by the pungent smell of blood and rot.
real_text: Objective - If an investigator enters the Ritual Site, advance.

back_flavor: You brave the unnatural chill and weave through arcane symbols, crossing the threshold of the circle. You smother the markings on the ground, covering them with dirt, breaking apart the carefully constructed pattern of smooth rocks. A shrill noise pierces your ears as the air grows suddenly warmer, and the world distorts around you, settling into normality.

name: A Creature of the Bayou
back_text:
Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck.
If The Rougarou is in play, find a non-[[Bayou]] location with the fewest clues on it. Move The Rougarou (one location at a time) until it enters that location.
If The Rougarou is not in play, after advancing to agenda 2a, add 1 doom to that agenda.
flavor: After arriving in New Orleans the next day, you start your investigation by asking the locals what they knew of the recent killings. As you suspected, most know very little of the incidents. You do manage to find several eyewitnesses who give similar descriptions of the creature: its lithe, muscular form, lanky arms, and wolf-like visage. A promising start - but if there is any truth to the rumors about this "curse", you'll have to talk to Lady Esprit herself.
back_flavor: A violent storm rolls in as your search continues. Black rainclouds conquer the sky, the air thick with humidity. You recall that all of the recent killings took place late at night, under the cover of dark clouds. A shiver runs down your spine - what if you are next?

name: The Rougarou Feeds
back_text:
Shuffle all copies of On the Prowl from the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck.
If The Rougarou is in play, find a non-[[Bayou]] location with the fewest clues on it. Move The Rougarou (one location at a time) until it enters that location.
If The Rougarou is not in play, after advancing to agenda 3a, add 1 doom to that agenda.
flavor: Around you, the bayou feasts. Flesh rips and jaws snap just beyond the trees, and light droplets of rain ripple upon the surface of the water. You can't tell exactly where the sounds are coming from. Perhaps it's the dreadful ambience of the bayou itself.
back_flavor: A clash of thunder roars through the sky, and you reel in pain from the sudden explosion of noise. Your vision doubles, and bile leaps up your throat. A lone howl returns the call of the sky, echoing throughout the bayou. You wrench yourself off the muddy ground and find your bearings, unable to shake the feeling that you're running out of time.

name: The Curse Spreads
text: Forced - At the end of the investigation phase, if The Rougarou is not engaged with an investigator: Add 1 doom to this agenda.
back_text:
The bearer of the Curse of the Rougarou weakness read the following (out loud):
You feel something dripping from your hand, and are surprised to find your knuckles bloody and torn. Nearby, the bard of a tree is smashed and dripping with blood. The anger of your failure slowly fades as you realize the blood is yours.
(→R1)
If no investigators gained the Curse of the Rougarou: (→R1)
flavor: Tendrils of slime ooze from the bogs, crawling over tree roots and grasping at you as you pass. The air hangs heavy with a noxious heat. You feel as though you are sinking, sinking deep into the bayou, sinking beneath the heaviness of the black sky and the rank mist...
back_flavor: A high-pitched shriek echoes through the bayou, followed by the sinister howls of the accursed Rougarou. The beast has drawn blood again - this you are sure of.
real_text: Forced - At the end of the investigation phase, if The Rougarou is not engaged with an investigator: Add 1 doom to this agenda.

name: Finding Lady Esprit
text: Objective - Only investigators at a [[Bayou]] location may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.
back_text:
Put the set-aside Lady Esprit into play at a [[Bayou]] location. Put into play each set aside location. Put the set-aside The Rougarou enemy into play at any non-[[Bayou]] location. Shuffle the encounter discard pile and each encounter card from the Curse of the Rougarou encounter set into the encounter deck. The lead investigator reads the following (out loud):
As you leave Lady Esprit's shack, a terrible sickness courses through you, and you drop to your knees.
The lead investigator puts the set-aside Curse of the Rougarou weakness into play in his or her threat area.
flavor: According to your contact, Lady Esprit is a Voodoo priestess who lives deep within the bayou. Most tend to stay clear of her lonely shack. After all, the bayou can be a dangerous place, even were it not for the recent rash of savage killings.
back_flavor: Finding Lady Esprit's shack is no simple endeavor, but eventually you spot the decrepit shanty through the mist. Lady Esprit greets you as you enter, not at all surprised by your intrusion. She claims that the Rougarou was once a man, cursed by a being known as "Shub-Niggurath" into the form of a great wolf. She believes that she can lift the Rougarou's curse from the bayou, but only if the creature is destroyed.
real_text: Objective - Only investigators at a [[Bayou]] location may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.

name: Hunting the Rougarou
text: Forced - After The Rougarou leaves a location: Place 1 clue from the token bank on that location. Objective - "We have to destroy the beast!" If The Rougarou is defeated: (→R2) Objective - "Maybe there's another way..." While an investigator is engaged with The Rougarou, he or she may choose to advance. (Limit once per phase.)
back_text: If each of the following requirements are met, proceed to (→R3). Otherwise, flip this act back to its "a" side. - "We must learn more about the curse." The investigators must have 4 [per_investigator] clues, as a group. - "We must keep it contained." The Rougarou must have a [[Trap]] card attached to it. - "We must protect ourselves." The Rougarou must have at least 1 [per_investigator] damage on it. - "We must calm it down." The investigators must have either "found a binding stone" or "found a strange doll."
flavor: The Rougarou is somewhere within the vast bayou. You must track it down and destroy it, lest the beast's curse consume you as well.
back_flavor: Conversing with the creature is a daunting task. Whenever it is cornered, it bellows and attacks, like a feral beast. If there is still some semblance of humanity left inside the create, it is buried deep beneath the rage and bloodlust of the curse.

text: [reaction] 당신이 난이도보다 2 이상 높은 차이로 조사에 성공한 후: 당신이 위치한 장소에서 단서를 1개 발견합니다. [elder_sign] 효과: +2. 당신은 이번 테스트를 자동 실패하기로 하면서 카드를 3장 뽑아도 됩니다.
back_text: 덱 크기: 30장. 덱 구성 선택지: 레벨 0-5 탐구자 카드([seeker]), 레벨 0-5 중립 카드, 이외의 레벨 0 다른 역할군([guardian], [rogue], [mystic], [survivor]) 카드 최대 5장. 덱 구성 요구조건(덱 크기에 포함되지 않습니다): 진실을 찾아서, 렉스의 저주, 무작위 기본 약점 카드 1장. 덱 구성 제한: [[행운]] 카드는 사용할 수 없습니다.
flavor: “이번에는, 무슨 수를 써서라도 진실을 밝혀내고야 말 테다.”
back_flavor: 재난이 닥칠 때마다, 렉스 머피는 대개 그 재난에 휘말려 고통받아 왔다. 렉스와 며칠 보내어 보면, 그 어떤 완고한 무신론자라도 렉스가 저주 받은 인간이라는 사실을 인정할 수밖에 없다. 렉스가 좋은 기삿거리다 싶은 실마리를 찾을 때면 늘 일이 잘못 돌아갔다. 인스머스에서 있었던 사건을 찍은 사진은 바다로 날아가 버렸고, 던위치에서의 사건을 추적한 기록은 보안관에게 가져가기도 전에 비에 씻겨 사라졌다. 끔찍한 불운 때문에 소름끼치는 괴물이나 이단의 음모 앞에 놓인 적도 한두 번이 아니다. 살아남기 위해, 렉스는 자신의 기자 정신을 발휘해 다음 번 찾아올 재난보다 한 발 앞서 나아가고 있다.

back_flavor: 제니 반즈는 물질적인 안락함과 멋진 저녁 식사, 그리고 최신 유행을 찾아다니는 데에 젊은 시절을 보냈다. 하지만 그러한 삶도 동생 이자벨이 보낸 편지를 받고 난 이후 변하고 말았다. 편지에서, 이자벨은 불가사의한 힘이 자신에게 가해지고 있으며 그로 인해 어떤 초자연적인 위협의 희생양이 될까봐 두렵다고 적어 놓았다. 그것이 제니가 사랑하는 동생으로부터 받은 마지막 편지였다. 그 후, 제니는 미국으로 돌아와 오컬트와 관련된 사건을 닥치는 대로 추적하고 조사했다. 꽃이 쉽사리 시들지 않듯, 제니는 명사수인 동시에 미지에 대한 두려움이 없는 명석한 조사자로서 활약했다. 이자벨의 실종 사건을 밝혀내기 전까지 제니는 결코 수색을 멈추지 않을 것이다.

name: The Festivities Begin
flavor: Last-minute ocean liner tickets from Boston to Italy set you back a fair bit of dough, but after a tense journey, you arrive in Venice. The Carnevale has already begun, and the city is in celebration. Colorful confetti rains from above, covering the streets. Many revelers throng in Piazza San Marco, the square outside of Basilica. The parade is to begin shortly. You find the nearest uniformed Carabinieri and show him a copy of the symbol you'd transcribed from "Zanni's" mask. He pauses to decide your trustworthiness, nods, and escorts you into the basilica to see the Abbess Allegria Di Biase.

name: The Shadow of the Eclipse
back_text:
If there are 1 or more Masked Carnevale-Goers in play, the lead investigator chooses 1 and flips it to its other side. If its other side is an Innocent Reveler, place it underneath the agenda deck.
If there is still a Masked Carnevale-Goer in play, flip this agenda back to agenda 2a.
Otherwise, advance to agenda 3a.
flavor: The clamor and celebration of the Carnevale has for the most part drowned out the terrors you've seen in the city... Until now. The sun vanishes behind the moon, and darkness overtakes the sky. There is a solitary cry and the sound of crashing water. Within moments, screams erupt throughout the city. And yet, somehow, you see revelers still celebrating with wide, crazed smiles.
back_flavor: The shadow of the eclipse is unrelenting. Throughout the city, a dull chant overtakes the screaming and the chaos, its language ancient and morbid. Tentacles course through the canals from the south, weaving beneath bridges and trapping entire islands within their grasp.

name: Chaos at the Carnevale

back_text: In player order, Cnidathqua attacks each investigator in play, regardless of their location. Damage and horror from these attacks must be assigned to an Innocent Reveler first, if able. Then, flip this agenda back to agenda 3a.
flavor: In the lagoon, an ancient terror stirs. The creature's tentacles coil around the city, and the water level begins to rise. As if in response, the chanting you hear throughout the city grows louder.
back_flavor: Great tentacle-arms, covered with acrid slime, rise from the canals and lash at you and anyone else unfortunate enough to be in the vicinity.
real_text: Forced - After a Writhing Appendage enters play: Place 2 doom on it.

name: The Carnevale Conspiracy
text: [action] The investigators spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Look at the other side of a Masked Carnevale-Goer at any location. Objective - If there are a total of 3 Innocent Revelers underneath the act and/or agenda decks, advance.
back_text:
Put the set-aside Cnidathqua enemy into play in the center of all of the locations. For the remainder of the scenario, Cnidathqua is considered to be in play but is not at any location.
The lead investigator chooses a Masked Carnevale-Goer in play and flips it to its other side.
flavor: The abbess addresses you privately: "So, you know what is coming?" You nod. "Then you know what must be done. They are using the celebration as a sacrifice for their wretched master. Bring as many innocents as you can here, where I can protect them. But beware - the creature's servants will try to blend into the crowd with their false masks."
back_flavor: Many of the revelers are under the sway of a foul spell, and they cannot see the danger emerging around them. You push your way through the crowded streets, gathering what few sane revelers you can find and guiding them toward the relative safety of the Basilica. As the last of them is escorted inside, the ground shakes violently, and a watery shape looms above the island to the south from deep within the lagoon. Their ritual nearly finished, the "revelers" in the streets begin to unmask...

The only way to ensure the safety of the sacrifices is to draw the creature in the lagoon away from the city. Sweat beads down your forehead as you realize this decision may be your last. Legs trembling, you head towards the moored boats docked by the canals.

name: Row!
text: Forced - When you would draw the top card of the encounter deck: Instead look at the top 5 cards of the encounter deck and put each Writhing Appendage among those cards into play, engaged with you. Discard the rest of those cards. Objective - If there are 4 [per_investigator] resources on Gondola, advance.
flavor: Relief turns to desperation as the creature draws its attention to your gondola. You have only one chance if you are to survive.
back_flavor: The skin on your hands blisters, rubbed raw by the oar, and your arms ache with pain. The creature movement is slow, its body covered in acrid slime, but its countless tentacles lash at you from the dark waters, coiling around your gondola and attempting to pry the oar out of your hands. With a heart-wrenching snap, the oar splinters into two pieces, the bottom half splashing into the lagoon. You desperately try to propel the gondola forward using any means you can, but it is futile. The beast gains on you, looming over the boat with an impossible feathery shape, its tendrils reaching for you. Above it, the black shape of the moon begins to slide. A thin crescent of sunlight pierces through the mist as the eclipse ends, and the creature's tendrils recoil to surround its body. Slowly it sinks into the lagoon, its body melting as the sun escapes its prison.

If you spent clues to advance:
You find the window nearest to the guard and tap it loud enough to get his attention. He gives a startled jump, then shifts open the window. “What do you want?” he asks timidly. You explain the situation to him and tell him he is in grave danger. He warily opens the front door to the Museum, shaking his head. “I wasn’t even supposed to be here today...”

"I just started here last week," he explains. "What sort of trouble did you say was going on?" You haven’t the heart to give him the full story.

name: 현실에 난 틈
back_text:
Remove the leftmost location from the game (or place it in the victory display if it has Victory X and no clues on it). Each investigator at that location is defeated. Each enemy and asset at that location is discarded.
Discard all clues controlled by the investigators.
flavor: As the train to Dunwich comes to a jarring stop, you look out the window behind you and see an immense tear in the sky, like a rip in a piece of cloth. Several of the rearmost train cars are pulled backwards, and there is a dreadful metallic crunch as they are detached. The train cars topple upwards and into the rift in the sky. Nearby passengers are panicking, others are cowering in their seats, and one elderly man has fainted in fear.
back_flavor: The rearmost car of the train detaches as it is pulled backwards. To your horror, it rises off the tracks and is consumed by the gate above you.

name: 점차 커져가는 아귀
back_text:
Remove the leftmost location from the game (or place it in the victory display if it has Victory X and no clues on it). Each investigator at that location is defeated. Each enemy and asset at that location is discarded.
Discard all clues controlled by the investigators.
flavor: The tear grows larger, and you can feel the rearmost car of the train shaking as it is pulled backwards. The situation threatens to erupt into chaos as more passengers realize the danger they are in. Some passengers are looking for places to hide, while others are running about the compartments in terror.
back_flavor: The next train car is ripped backwards with violent force. A middle-aged man hangs from his fingertips as the car flies unhindered toward the rift. In moments, the car is consumed whole, and the man lets go rather than be pulled into the void. He starts to fall, but is caught by the rift's force and pulled inside it anyway.

name: 뒤로 끌려가다
back_text:
Remove each of the two leftmost locations from the game (or place it in the victory display if either one has Victory X and no clues on it). Each investigator at those locations is defeated. Each enemy and asset at those locations is discarded.
Discard all clues controlled by the investigators.
flavor: The pull of the rift in the sky seems to grow stronger, and the entire train begins to roll backwards along the tracks. The rearmost cars of the train begin to rattle, the force of the rift threatening to detach them. You must get out of these cars as fast as you can!
back_flavor: Two of the train cars closest to the gate are severed from the rest of the train by a sheet of impossibly hot steam, which slices through metal like a knife through butter. The cars are sucked upwards and fly into the gate. Something above the train lets out a terrible screech, though to your ears it is like the shrill sound of a broken steam pipe.

name: 휘말리다
back_text:
Remove each of the two leftmost locations from the game (or place it in the victory display if either one has Victory X and no clues on it). Each investigator at those locations is defeated. Each enemy and asset at those locations is discarded.
Discard all clues controlled by the investigators.
flavor: The gate crackles with power as its strength increases. Dirt and rocks from the edge of the bridge behind you are torn from the ground and trees are uprooted, pulled in by the gate. One younger passenger smashes the window of your car and shouts, “We gotta get outta here!” He leaps out of the window, but before he lands in the river below, he is snatched in the talons of a swift flying creature, and carried out of sight. A trail of steam is left in the creature’s wake.
back_flavor: The two rearmost train cars begin to melt as they are filled with superheated steam. The metal warps, and the passengers inside scream in agony. The cars are ripped from the train tracks along with rail slats and chunks of the bridge behind you.

name: 시간이 다 되다
back_text: Each investigator is immediately defeated and takes 1 mental trauma. (→R2)
flavor: The rift in the sky twists and shakes, completely distorted. Its size is now massive, its shape warping and shifting, as if it is about to explode.
back_flavor: The entire bridge cracks under the pressure of the gate, and breaks apart. Instead of plummeting into the river, the remaining train cars are pulled into the sky, toward the rift. You hang on for dear life and scream in horror as you are pulled into the gate. Then, everything goes black.

name: 뛰어!
text: Objective - If an investigator enters the Engine Car, immediately advance.
back_text:
The investigator entering the Engine Car reads the following (out loud):
A tender car filled with coal blocks your way to the engine cab. Swallowing your fear, you climb out of the nearby window and clamber onto the roof of the train, making your way across the tender car. The steady backward motion of the train makes it difficult for you to keep your footing. As you get close, a winged creature swoops down from above, its body composed of piping hot steam.
You must decide (choose one): - Test [agility] (3) to attempt to dodge the creature. If you fail, you leap too far and barely grip the side of the train, hanging on for dear life. Although you manage to pull yourself up, the experience is terrifying. You suffer 1 mental trauma. - Test [combat] (3) to attempt to endure the creature's extreme heat. If you fail, the creature flies through you and the heat burns you. You suffer 1 physical trauma.
flavor: The train has stopped on a bridge high above the Miskatonic River - you might be able to survive the fall, but you don’t like your chances. Your best bet is to make your way to the engine car as fast as you can and get the train running again.
real_text: Objective - If an investigator enters the Engine Car, immediately advance.

back_flavor: The engine roars to life and kicks into motion. You shovel coal into the engine's firebox and are relieved to see that the train is moving forward along the tracks once again.

name: 기이한 실종 사건
back_text: If there are 3 or more potential sacrifices, choose one of them at random and place it underneath the agenda deck, without looking at it.
flavor: Your welcome in Dunwich has been cold. A string of disappearances has left the already aloof townsfolk on edge. Most of them look at you with distrust, and few are willing to help in your investigation. Who knows what will happen if you don’t find the location of the missing townsfolk soon...
back_flavor: Whippoorwills gather along the gambrel roofs of Dunwich and begin to shriek in jubilation. The people of Dunwich believe that the presence of whippoorwills foreshadows somebody’s imminent death. Do they long for your death? Or is the victim someone else?

name: 옛 존재가 굶주렸다
back_text: If there are 2 or more potential sacrifices, choose one of them at random and place it underneath the agenda deck, without looking at it.
flavor: As the sun sets, the frightened townsfolk retreat into their homes and lock their doors. It is clear to you that many of them know more than they are letting on. A sickening feeling turns over in your stomach as the village’s true nature becomes clear.
back_flavor: More whippoorwills flock to Dunwich village as the night progresses. The other townsfolk, notoriously superstitious, are terrified by the birds’ presence. With the doors around you shut and locked, you find yourself alone in the streets of Dunwich.

name: 야수를 먹이다
back_text: Each investigator must immediately resign.
flavor: The rhythmic screeching of the whippoorwills fills the night. If the superstitions of Dunwich are correct, their song portends impending death... But for whom?
back_flavor: The whippoorwills that have been cawing through the night scatter in unison, as if they are somehow satisfied with the turn of events.

name: 해답을 찾아서
text: Objective - When an investigator enters The Hidden Chamber, advance.
back_text:
Reveal each unrevealed location. 
Move all clues in play (including those on each investigator) to The Hidden Chamber.
Spawn the set-aside Silas Bishop enemy in The Hidden Chamber.
flavor: The disappearances in town may be related to the events in Arkham. You suspect that something awful is afoot. You must find where the missing townsfolk are being held in order to unveil this conspiracy.
back_flavor:
You find your way into the hidden chamber where you believe the missing folk are being held, but the horrors that confront you there fray the edges of your sanity. Bound by chains in a secluded corner of the room is an unspeakable creature with the face of a man. It wheezes and wrestles to free itself as it notices your entrance. The many mouths covering the creature’s body are covered in blood and gristles of meat, as though it were feeding recently.
With a hideous croak, the creature speaks with seven mouths."Ss... se... eth...?" Then it lurches forward as though to grab you, and several of its chains snap.
real_text: Objective - When an investigator enters The Hidden Chamber, advance.

name: 야수가 갇힌 방
text: Objective - If Silas Bishop is defeated: (→R1) Objective - If there are no clues in the Hidden Chamber, advance.
back_text: If The Necronomicon is in play: (→R2) Otherwise: (→R3)
flavor: The pitiful beast lunges to grab you with slimy arms, its many jaws snapping in hunger. Killing it would be merciful. But perhaps there is something else to discover about this creature…
back_flavor: Despite the danger, you brave the beast's horrifying presence and investigate further before killing it. What you find confirms your worst suspicions. Several journal entries written by a "Seth Bishop" describe the process of feeding the creature in horrifying detail - tomatoes at first, then small game, then cattle, and then finally 'human sacrifices'. But the most disturbing part is that Seth calls the creature by name: 'Silas.'
real_text: Objective - If Silas Bishop is defeated: (→R1) Objective - If there are no clues in the Hidden Chamber, advance.

back_flavor: 롤라는 지금껏 세계를 순회하며 연일 매진된 공연에서 훌륭한 연기를 펼쳐왔다. 하지만 『황색의 왕』 만큼 기이하고도 기억에 남는 공연은 없었다. 심지어 예행 연습을 할 때조차, 그 작품과 관련된 모든 것은 재난과 공포로 끝맺고야 말았다. 끝내 롤라와 함께 공동 주연을 맡고 있던 미리엄이 센 강에서 시신으로 발견되었고, 더 이상 참을 수 없었던 롤라는 다음 공연을 마지막으로 하차하겠다고 감독에게 편지로 통보했다. 이제 롤라는 마침내 이 지긋지긋하고 끔찍한 연극에서 발을 뗄 수 있으리라 생각하며 마지막 공연이 열리는 고향 도시 아컴으로 향했다.
real_text: Forced - After you draw your opening hand: Choose a role ([survivor], [guardian], [seeker], [rogue], [mystic], or Neutral). You can only play, commit, or trigger abilities on Neutral cards or cards of your role. [fast]: Switch your role. (Limit once per round.) [elder_sign] effect: +2. You may switch roles.

name: 즉흥 연기
text:
롤라 헤이즈 덱 전용.
신속. 당신의 차례에만 플레이할 수 있습니다.
당신의 배역을 바꿉니다. 지금부터 당신의 차례가 끝날 때까지, 당신이 배역과 일치하는 카드를 처음 플레이할 때, 그 카드 1장에 한해 자원 비용이 3만큼 줄어듭니다. 카드를 1장 뽑습니다.
real_text:
Lola Hayes deck only.
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Switch your role. Until the end of your turn, reduce the resource cost of the next card you play of your role by 3. Draw 1 card.

name: 정체성의 위기
text: 폭로 - 당신이 조종하는 카드 중에서 당신의 현재 배역과 일치하는 카드를 모두 버립니다. 그런 다음, 당신의 덱 맨 위 카드 1장을 버립니다. 당신의 배역을 이렇게 버린 카드의 역할군으로 바꿉니다(약점 카드를 버렸다면 당신의 배역을 중립으로 바꿉니다).
flavor: “전 수많은 배역을 연기해 왔어요. 미쳐버린다 해도 이상하지 않을 정도로요.”
real_text: Revelation - Discard all cards you control of your current role. Then, discard the top card of your deck. Switch your role to the class of the discarded card (if the discarded card is a weakness, switch your role to neutral).

flavor: 약간의 위안거리일뿐이었으나, 어쨌든 마음의 안정을 찾았습니다.

당신이 수행하는 능력 테스트에서만 소모할 수 있습니다.

name: 날뛰는 괴물
text: Forced - At the end of the enemy phase: Move each Brood of Yog-Sothoth enemy once toward a random location.
back_text:
Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck.
Spawn 1 of the set-aside Brood of Yog-Sothoth enemies at a random location, if able.
flavor: Reports of terrifying entities wreaking havoc across the countryside have caused the citizens of Dunwich to panic. Worse, the creatures seem to be invisible to the naked eye.
back_flavor:
An old pickup truck rolls to a stop along the weathered trails of Dunwich. The driver - Joe Osborn - calls out to you through a shattered driver-side window, the truck's engine still running. "IT's over at the Ericks' farm!" he shouts. "Done blasted their place apart. Poor Henry and Martha..."
You ask Osborn for the location of the Ericks' homestead, and it confirms your worst fear. For that attack to have occurred recently, there must be more of the monsters on the loose.
real_text: Forced - At the end of the enemy phase: Move each Brood of Yog-Sothoth enemy once toward a random location.

name: 때를 기다리다
text: Forced - At the end of the enemy phase: Move each Brood of Yog-Sothoth enemy once toward a random location.
back_text: Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck. If there is a set-aside Brood of Yog-Sothoth, the lead investigator reads the following (out loud): Bleak storm clouds churn overhead and a blanket of rain pelts the countryside. As the downpour grows in intensity, you take refuge in a half-ruined shack nearby. There is a flash of lightning, and in the brief illumination, you spot the outline of something large in the rain. Without warning, the distant trees bend, though nothing seems to be bending them. Moments later, a force with the strength of a truck crashes into your refuge. Spawn 1 of the set-aside Brood of Yog-Sothoth enemies at the lead investigator's location, if able. Then, each investigator at that location tests [agility] (4). The newly spawned Brood of Yog-Sothoth makes an attack against each investigator who fails this skill test.
flavor:
Once in a while a wind, sweeping up out of Cold Spring Glen, would bring a touch of ineffable foetor to the heavy night air... But the looked-for terror did not appear. Whatever was down there in the glen was biding its time, and Armitage told his colleagues it would be suicidal to try to attack it in the dark.
-H.P. Lovecraft, "The Dunwich Horror"
real_text: Forced - At the end of the enemy phase: Move each Brood of Yog-Sothoth enemy once toward a random location.

name: 고삐 풀린 공포
text: Each [[Abomination]] enemy gets +1 fight and +1 evade. Forced - At the end of the enemy phase: Move each Brood of Yog-Sothoth enemy once toward a random location.
flavor:
It was no joke tracking down something as big as a house that one could not see, but that had all the vicious malevolence of a daemon.
-H.P. Lovecraft, "The Dunwich Horror"
back_flavor: There is a monstrous rumbling throughout the countryside, though it is impossible to tell whether its source is the creatures you hunt or the very mountains themselves. Soon after, you find more of the creatures' tracks leading up toward the hills: a thirty-foot path of crushed underbrush and trees snapped like twigs. Exhausted from battle, and with night fast approaching, you decide to head to safety rather than follow these hellish tracks.
real_text: Each [[Abomination]] enemy gets +1 fight and +1 evade. Forced - At the end of the enemy phase: Move each Brood of Yog-Sothoth enemy once toward a random location.

name: 사라센 인이 남긴 문서
text: Objective - Only investigators at Whateley Ruins may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.
back_text:
Check Campaign Log. If Dr. Armitage survived The Dunwich Legacy:
"There!" Armitage sighs a breath of relief, jotting down the last phrases of the formula. "I have translated the last of it." He shudders as he hands you the script, the words conjuring forth memories of his battle with the creature. "I hope this is the last time I'll have to read it," he admits. "But if we do nothing, the end result will be much, much worse."
Each investigator puts into play 1 set-aside Esoteric Formula. If Dr. Armitage is listed under "Sacrificed to Yog-Sothoth":
Using the information contained within the ruins of the Whateley homestead, you are able to transcribe the remainder of the formula previously used by Dr. Armitage to destroy the beast that plagued Dunwich. However, the endeavor sets you back several hours.
Each investigator puts into play 1 set-aside Esoteric Formula. Place 1 doom on the current agenda.
flavor: The monsters tearing through Dunwich county are immune to traditional weapons. Only by reciting a particular incantation can the creatures be defeated. First you must search the ruins of Wilbur Whateley’s home in order to find the final sections of the otherworldly script.
real_text: Objective - Only investigators at Whateley Ruins may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.

name: 놈들을 파괴해야 한다!
text: Objective - Defeat as many Brood of Yog-Sothoth enemies as you can. If there are no copies of Brood of Yog-Sothoth in play or set aside, advance.
flavor: With the formula in hand, you finally have the means to destroy the creatures wreaking havoc in Dunwich... but only if you can survive long enough.
back_flavor: As you complete the incantation, the foul creature cries out with a raucous, inhuman voice. It rumbles and cracks, the syllables of its croaking far from English. As its cry plays out, the creature shrinks upon itself, and then, with little warning, it is gone. All that remains is a foul stench and a repulsive mark that mars the vegetation where the beast once stood.
real_text: Objective - Defeat as many Brood of Yog-Sothoth enemies as you can. If there are no copies of Brood of Yog-Sothoth in play or set aside, advance.

It is always a relief to get clear of the place, and to follow the narrow road around the base of the hills and across the level country beyond till it rejoins the Aylesbury pike. Afterward one sometimes learns that one has been through Dunwich.
-H.P. Lovecraft, "The Dunwich Horror"
