name: 고대의 존재를 불러들이다
back_text: Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck.
flavor: As you approach Sentinel Hill, you hear ancient Latin rites bellowed across the night. The time for action has come. If you cannot stop the sorcerers in Dunwich, who knows what terrors they might unleash upon the world?
back_flavor:
As you explore the paths surrounding Sentinel Hill, the chanting at the hilltop rises to a crescendo and takes an otherworldly quality, reverberating through the trees as if carried by unseen currents.
The world begins to change. The grass and trees dissolve like sugar in a cup of tea. A vast endless sky slices through the reality you see before you, and you feel drawn to it, terrified and awestruck. The arcane power becomes distorted and seeps around you, creating strange alterations in the land.

name: 힘을 부르다
flavor: The Old Ones were, the Old Ones are, and the Old Ones shall be. Not in the spaces we know, but between them, They walk serene and primal, undimensioned and to us unseen. Yog-Sothoth knows the gate. Yog-Sothoth is the gate. Yog-Sothoth is the key and guardian of the gate. Past, present, future, all are one in Yog-Sothoth. He knows where the Old Ones broke through of old, and where They shall break through again. He knows where They have trod earth’s fields, and where They still tread them, and why no one can behold Them
back_flavor:
The chanting reaches its climax, and at the summit of Sentinel Hill, a tear opens across the fabric of the sky, parting the clouds and slicing through the very air itself.
You watch as an indescribable entity - spheres, eyes, mouths, ooze - pours out of the rift. The sorcerers call its name as its form seeps into the sky, spreading forth above the earth."Ia! Ia! Yog-Sothoth! Ia! Ia! Yog-Sothoth!"
Before their jubilant chant can continue, they are smothered by the growing mass, and are heard no more.
To your horror, the expansion of the mass does not cease.

name: 언덕으로 가는 길
text: Objective - When the investigators have collected the requisite number of clues, they must immediately spend them and advance.
back_text: Remove all clues from each location in play. The arcane presence masking the path further up the hill has faded. Reveal Ascending Path.
flavor: A vibrant arcane energy fills the air with a bone-rattling chill. The energy swirls along the crushed trail before you, and seeps down several other paths before disappearing.
back_flavor:
During your search through the wooded paths around the base of Sentinel Hill, you come across a startling sight. A herd of sheep lays dead upon the ground in a secluded clearing, their bloodied carcasses placed in a strange but careful pattern. Holding your nose against the stench of death, you step over mangled sheep on your way to the center of the odd formation.
In the center of the sheep lies the corpse of a man. A clear jewel has been firmly pressed into his forehead, caving in the front of his skull. His eyes are wide, his face contorted in a vision of fear, as if beseeching you for mercy. Though you know better, you check for a pulse. As you touch the man's skin, the jewel in his forehead dissolves, and the woods around you seem to clear.
real_text: Objective - When the investigators have collected the requisite number of clues, they must immediately spend them and advance.

name: 언덕을 오르다(v. I)
text: Clues cannot be placed on non-[[Altered]] locations. Objective - When an investigator enters Sentinel Peak, advance.
back_text: Remove the set-aside Seth Bishop enemy from the game.
flavor: As you ascend the hill, the environment around you grows increasingly strange and otherworldly. The arcane energy feels even stronger here, crackling in the air and crawling on your skin.
back_flavor: Approaching the peak of Sentinel Hill, you are confronted by several citizens of Dunwich. The man in the center of their circle chants in Latin while the others bow their heads in reverence. "Seth Bishop?" you ask presumptively. The man in the center raises his gaze in response, confirming your suspicions. You plead with the man to stop this madness, but he doesn't respond. You draw forth the silver constellation pendant you'd found on Silas's body and present it to Seth. "This is all we found of your brother," you shout over the howling wind. "Is this the fate you want for yourself? For all of us?" You throw the pendant onto the ground. Staggered by the sight of it, he stumbles backwards and trips over his incantation, eyes widened. As he falls, the altar behind him splits open, and a torrent of energy pours from the stone, swirling into an open gate that swallows the man whole. You barely manage to dig your heels in and grab hold of a nearby rock to resist the pull of the gate.
real_text: Clues cannot be placed on non-[[Altered]] locations. Objective - When an investigator enters Sentinel Peak, advance.

name: 언덕을 오르다(v. II)
text: Clues cannot be placed on non-[[Altered]] locations. Objective - When an investigator enters Sentinel Peak, advance.
back_text: Put the set-aside Seth Bishop enemy into play at Sentinel Peak.
flavor: As you ascend the hill, the environment around you grows increasingly strange and otherworldly. The arcane energy feels even stronger here, crackling in the air and crawling on your skin.
back_flavor: Approaching the peak of Sentinel Hill, you are confronted by several citizens of Dunwich. The man in the center of their circle lets out a crazed laugh. You recognize the man - Seth Bishop - from the description given to you by the townsfolk earlier. Behind him, several other men and women bow their heads in reverence, chanting in Latin. "We've done it!" he cackles. "We've accomplished what Old Whateley and 'is git couldn't!" You watch in revulsion as his eyes glaze over and twitch, as though he were reading something invisible. "I can see now… I can finally see!" He raises his hands to the sky and the headstone of the altar behind him splits open. A torrent of energy pours out of the stone, coalescing into the form of an open gate. Seth holds onto the stone in front of him to prevent himself from being sucked into the gate, but several of the others are startled and pulled through it. You barely manage to dig your heels in and grab hold of a nearby rock in time to resist the pull of the gate. Seth rises to his feet, wearing an expression of pride.
real_text: Clues cannot be placed on non-[[Altered]] locations. Objective - When an investigator enters Sentinel Peak, advance.

name: 언덕을 오르다(v. III)
text: Clues cannot be placed on non-[[Altered]] locations. Objective - When an investigator enters Sentinel Peak, advance.

flavor: As you ascend the hill, the environment around you grows increasingly strange and otherworldly. The arcane energy feels even stronger here, crackling in the air and crawling on your skin.
back_flavor: Approaching the peak of Sentinel Hill, you are confronted by several citizens of Dunwich. The man in the center of their circle is desperately trying to complete a Latin incantation. "It's not working, Seth!" one of the other men cries out. "What're we gonna do?" The man in the center stops his chant and pulls out a cobbler's knife. "The father demands a blood sacrifice," he declares, and his face twists into a crazed expression. Before you can react, he slits his left wrist with the knife, dropping to his knees in agony. The headstone of the altar behind him splits open. A torrent of energy pours out of the stone, coalescing into the form of an open gate. Seth holds onto the stone in front of him to prevent himself from being sucked into the gate, but several of the others are startled and pulled through it. You barely manage to dig your heels in and grab hold of a nearby rock in time to resist the pull of the gate. Seth rises, wounded but alive. An expression of pride spreads across his pained face.

A force like a hurricane erupts from the gate, bending trees and pulling debris into it. The howling of the gale drowns out all other sound. Somehow, you must find a way to close the gate.
back_flavor: You don't know how to close the swirling gate before you, and with each passing moment, the force from within it grows in strength. You fear that whatever entity the sorcerers have summoned from beyond approaches. With no time to spare, you turn to the open tome on the stone altar, desperate for answers.

back_flavor: A light shimmers in the distance, and you head toward it to investigate. The wispy light drifts away from you, floating through the realm's strange gateways, ascending looping staircases, and crossing through barriers you dared not cross earlier. With little chance of finding the nexus on your own, you follow the light, hoping it is guiding you in the right direction.

name: 저 너머로

back_flavor: You reach an impossibly dense pitch-black void, and realize that this place is where all of reality - all that is and all that ever will be - ends. In its center, you see a minuscule rift, suspended just out of reach. When you peer through the tear, you are surprised to see the peak of Sentinel Hill. Somehow, you've reached the other side of the rift. Now you must find a way to close it for good.

Remove the Edge of the Universe from the game.
Put the set-aside Tear Through Time location into play.
flavor: The unearthly stones on the ground are inscribed with some sort of seal. Approaching them causes a voice to enter your mind, speaking in an alien tongue.
back_flavor: You are utterly exhausted, with no idea as to what can be done to close the rift. It is too distant to touch, and nothing you do has any effect. There is nothing here to guide you apart from the unearthly words that are seeping into your mind. Just then, you hear a familiar voice within the echoing chorus, and feel yourself compelled to repeat it. "Claude ostium…" You whisper at first, the words on the tip of your tongue. You close your eyes to concentrate, and the echo grows louder. When it ends and you open your eyes, you face nothing but an inky abyss, and the tear has vanished.

back_flavor: You discover a path that looks somewhat familiar and follow it. Even though your task is complete, you now understand that in closing the tear, you may never make it home. The fear of being lost here forever spurs you onward, through an archway leading into an overgrown corridor. A damp wooden door leads you out into a pocket of thin rain and dark sky. Cement turns to gravel, then marble, then steel, then grass. You cross impossibly long meadows and make your way through dense woods before fatigue finally sets in. Drained of all energy, you cannot go on any further. Your body gives out.

text: Revelation - Discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until a location is discarded. Resolve that location's 'revelation' ability, then move to that location.
real_text: Revelation - Discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until a location is discarded. Resolve that location's 'revelation' ability, then move to that location.

text: Revelation - If there are no [[Extradimensional]] locations in play, Vast Expanse gains surge. Otherwise, test [willpower] (X), where X is the number of [[Extradimensional]] locations in play (max 5). For each point you fail by, take 1 horror.
real_text: Revelation - If there are no [[Extradimensional]] locations in play, Vast Expanse gains surge. Otherwise, test [willpower] (X), where X is the number of [[Extradimensional]] locations in play (max 5). For each point you fail by, take 1 horror.

name: 마크 해리건
text:
당신은 ‘소피(사랑했던 기억)’를 플레이 영역에 두고 게임을 시작합니다.
[reaction] 당신이 조종하는 카드에 피해가 놓인 후: 카드를 1장 뽑습니다(단계 당 1번 한정).
[elder_sign] 효과: ‘마크 해리건’이 가진 피해마다 +1.
back_text: 덱 크기: 30장. 덱 구성 선택지: 레벨 0-5 수호자 카드([guardian]), 레벨 0-5 중립 카드, 레벨 0 [[전술]] 카드. 덱 구성 요구조건 (덱 크기에 포함되지 않습니다): 후방 전선, 전쟁 후유증, 소피, 무작위 기본 약점 카드 1장.
flavor: 마크라면 마을을 죄다 태웠으면 태웠지, 저 괴물이 다른 이를 데려가게 두진 않을 겁니다.
back_flavor: 전쟁으로 몸과 마음이 망가진 이는 하나둘이 아니지만, 그중에서도 마크 해리건은 전쟁통에 가히 형언할 수 없는 끔찍한 것을 목도했다. 인간이라 할 수 없는 존재가 다른 이들을 학살했다는 그의 편지를, 마크의 연인이었던 소피는 기꺼이 믿어주었다. 마침내 전쟁이 끝나고 마크가 연인의 품으로 돌아오자, 그제서야 소피가 왜 그의 말을 전적으로 믿어주었는지 알게 되었다. 소피의 안에 들어간 괴물이 그녀를 안에서부터 파먹고 나왔으며, 마크는 공포에 질려 아무런 대처도 못하고 그 참상을 바라만 보았다. 소피는 계속해서 비명을 질렀고, 마침내 놈이 식사를 끝내자 더이상 세상에 소피의 육신은 남지 않았다. 이제는 모두가 마크 해리건이 미쳤다고 생각한다. 어쩌면 그가 정신이 나간 게 사실일지도 모른다. 하지만 마크는 괴물이 실재한다는 것을 알고 있으며, 마지막 한 놈까지 무덤에 처박아 버리기 전까지는 절대 멈추지 않겠노라고 맹세했다.
real_text: You begin the game with Sophie (In Loving Memory) in play. [reaction] After damage is placed on a card you control: Draw 1 card. (Limit once per phase.) [elder_sign] effect: +1 for each damage on Mark Harrigan.

name: 민 티 판
text:
[reaction] 당신이 위치한 장소에 있는 조사자가 능력 테스트에 카드 1장을 소모한 후: 이번 능력 테스트가 끝날 때까지 그 카드는 [wild] 아이콘 1개를 획득합니다(라운드당 각 조사자마다 1번 한정).
[elder_sign] 효과: +1. 이번 능력 테스트가 끝난 후, 이번 능력 테스트에 소모된 능력 카드 1장을 선택해서 소유자의 손으로 가져가게 해도 됩니다.
back_text: 덱 크기: 30장. 덱 구성 선택지: 레벨 0-5 탐구자 카드([seeker]), 레벨 0-5 중립 카드, 레벨 0-2 생존자 카드([survivor]). 덱 구성 요구조건 (덱 크기에 포함되지 않습니다): 분석적인 사고, 황색의 왕(제1막), 무작위 기본 약점 카드 1장.
flavor: “미지로 가는 거라면 절 믿고 따라오셔도 됩니다.”
back_flavor: 민은 단 한 번도 본인이 미국인이라는 생각을 한 적이 없었다. 미국으로 넘어 오기 전, 일제강점 하에 있는 한국에서 민의 가족이 베트남인으로 살아간다는 것은 지금보다도 훨씬 더 가혹한 일이었다. 민은 부모님이 미국에 오기 위해 얼마나 많은 희생을 치렀는지 떠올리면서 불철주야로 공부하여 학위를 취득했다. 마침내 민의 아버지는 아컴 시에서 온 토마스 씨라는 남자와 안면을 트게 되었고, 그는 자신의 사무실에 민을 고용했다. 토마스 씨는 친절한 사람이었다. 하지만 『황색의 왕』이라는 연극 대본을 읽기 시작한 이래로, 그는 완전히 다른 사람이 되고야 말았다. 토마스 씨는 민에게도 대본을 빌려주면서 읽어보라 했지만, 민은 도저히 1막을 넘길 수가 없었다. 그리고 3주 후, 자살한 토마스 씨의 시신이 발견되었다... 이 불가사의한 사건을 풀기 위한 열쇠는 『황색의 왕』에 있으리라.
real_text:
[reaction] After an investigator at your location commits a card to a skill test: That card gains a [wild] icon until the end of the test. (Limit once for each investigator per round.)
[elder_sign] effect: +1. You may choose a skill card committed to this skill test to return to its owner's hand after this test ends.

name: 후방 전선
text:
마크 해리건 덱 전용.
이번 능력 테스트가 성공하고 그것이 공격이라면, ‘마크 해리건’이 가진 피해 1을 공격받은 적에게 이동시킵니다.
flavor: 진정한 전쟁은 이제 막 시작되었을 뿐.
real_text:
Mark Harrigan deck only.
If this skill test is successful during an attack, move 1 damage from Mark Harrigan to the attacked enemy.

name: 전쟁 후유증
text: 폭로 - 당신이 가진 피해 2마다 공포를 1 받습니다.
flavor: 전쟁은 결코 변하지 않는다.
real_text: Revelation - For every 2 damage on you, take 1 horror.

name: 소피
text: 마크 해리건 덱 전용. ‘소피’는 플레이 영역에서 나갈 수 없습니다. [free] 직접적인 피해를 1 받습니다: 이번 능력 테스트에서 당신의 능력값에 +2를 얻습니다. 강제 - ‘마크 해리건’이 가진 피해가 5 이상이면: ‘소피’를 뒤집습니다.
real_text: Mark Harrigan deck only. Sophie cannot leave play. [fast] Take 1 direct damage: You get +2 to your skill value for this skill test. Forced - If Mark Harrigan has 5 or more damage on him: Flip Sophie.

name: 분석적인 사고
text:
민 티 판 덱 전용.
당신은 다른 장소에 있는 조사자가 수행하는 능력 테스트마다 카드를 1장씩 소모해도 됩니다.
[reaction] 당신이 능력 테스트에 정확히 카드 1장만을 소모한 후, ‘분석적인 사고’를 소진합니다: 카드를 1장 뽑습니다.
real_text:
Minh Thi Phan deck only.
You may commit 1 card to each skill test performed by an investigator at another location.
[reaction] After you commit exactly 1 card to a skill test, exhaust Analytical Mind: Draw 1 card.

name: 황색의 왕
text: 폭로 - ‘황색의 왕’을 플레이 영역 중 당신의 위협 영역에 둡니다. 이 카드는 아래의 [reaction] 기능 외의 방법으로는 플레이 영역에서 나갈 수 없습니다. 당신은 능력 테스트에서 카드를 정확히 1장 또는 2장만 소모할 수는 없습니다. [reaction] ‘민 티 판’이 한 번의 능력 테스트에 일치하는 능력 아이콘이 6개 이상 되도록 카드를 소모했다면, 그 능력 테스트가 성공한 후: ‘황색의 왕’을 버립니다.

text: 당신이 위치한 장소에 있는 다른 조사자는 자신이 받는 피해를 ‘진정한 기개’에 할당해도 됩니다.
flavor: 이런 생채기쯤이야.
real_text: True Grit may be assigned damage dealt to other investigators at your location.

name: “이건 내가 처리하지!”
text:
신속. 다른 조사자가 ‘위험’ 키워드를 갖지 않는 조우 카드를 뽑은 후, 그 조우 카드의 효과를 해결하기 전에 플레이할 수 있습니다.
당신이 대신 그 조우 카드를 뽑은 것으로 간주합니다. 당신은 그 조우 카드의 폭로 효과를 해결하는 동안 모든 능력값에 +2를 얻습니다.

Fast. Play after another investigator draws a non-peril encounter card, but before resolving that card's effects.
You are considered to have drawn that encounter card, instead. You get +2 to each of your skills while resolving that card's revelation effect.

name: 갖은 수단과 방법을 동원해서
text: 당신이 위치한 장소에 있는 조사자 한 명을 선택합니다. 그 조사자는 자신의 덱 맨 위 카드 6장 중에서 카드 1장을 찾은 뒤, 그 카드를 뽑습니다. 남은 카드들은 그 조사자의 덱에 다시 넣고, 덱을 섞습니다.
real_text: Choose an investigator at your location. That investigator searches the top 6 cards of his or her deck for a card, draws it, and shuffles his or her deck.

name: 사정에 밝다
text: 사용(비밀 3개). [action] 비밀 1개를 소비합니다: 조사. 플레이 상태이며 공개된 아무 장소 한 곳을 (당신이 마치 그 장소에 있는 것처럼) 조사합니다.
real_text: Uses (3 secrets). [action] Spend 1 secret: Investigate. Investigate any revealed location in play as if you were at that location.

name: 세피나 루소
text: 강제 - 당신이 시작 카드를 뽑으려 할 때: 카드를 5장 대신 13장 뽑습니다. 그중에서, 이벤트 카드를 최대 5장까지 선택해서 이 카드 밑에 놓고, 8장을 시작 카드로 손에 듭니다. 나머지 카드는 버립니다. (당신은 멀리건을 할 수 없습니다.) [action]: 이 카드 밑에 있는 이벤트 카드를 1장 선택해서 뽑습니다. 이 행동은 틈새 공격을 유발하지 않습니다. [elder_sign] 효과: +3. 이 카드 밑에 있는 이벤트 카드를 1장 선택해서 뽑아도 됩니다.
back_text: 덱 크기: 33장. 덱 구성 선택지: 레벨 0-5 무법자 카드([rogue]), 레벨 0-5 중립 카드, 레벨 0-2 신비주의자 카드([mystic]). 덱 구성 요구조건 (덱 크기에 포함되지 않습니다): 그림 속 세계 사본 3장, 히아데스 성단 사본 1장, 무작위 기본 약점 카드 1장.
back_flavor: 세피나가 어렸을 때부터 그녀가 그린 매혹적인 그림은 세간의 눈을 끌었다. 파리에서 타히티로 찾아온 미술품 수집상은 세피나의 재능을 눈여겨 보면서, 자금을 후원해줄 테니 모작을 그려달라고 요청했다. 날선 안목과 지칠 줄 모르는 손을 지닌 세피나는 예상했던 것 이상으로 잘 맞는 일이라고 생각하고서 모작에 묘한 매력을 느꼈다. 최근 세피나는 정체불명의 재력가로부터 의뢰를 받았다. 기괴한 외계 도시의 파노라마를 재창조해 달라는 의뢰였다. 마침내 마지막 붓질을 끝낸 순간, 세피나는 그림 안의 세계로 빨려들어갔다. 그림 속 외계 도시에서 갖은 고초를 겪으며 죽음의 문턱까지 갔다가 간신히 살아남는 과정에서 그녀는 녹초가 되고 말았다. 다시 눈을 떴을 때는 자신의 화랑 안이었지만, 세피나는 그림 속에서 벌어진 일이 실제로 일어났다는 것을 알고 있다.
real_text: Forced - When you would draw your opening hand: Draw 13 cards, instead. Choose up to 5 events to place beneath this card and keep 8 cards as your opening hand. Discard the rest. (You cannot mulligan.) [action]: Choose an event beneath this card and draw it. Does not provoke attacks of opportunity. [elder_sign] effect: +3. You may choose an event beneath this card and draw it.

name: 아카치 오넬레
text:
“사용(충전)”기능을 갖는 당신의 자산은 추가로 충전 1회가 더 놓인 채로 플레이 영역에 들어옵니다.
[elder_sign] 효과: +1. 당신이 조종하는 “사용(충전)” 기능을 갖는 자산 1장에 충전 1회를 추가합니다.
back_text: 덱 크기: 30장. 덱 구성 선택지: 레벨 0-5 신비주의자 카드([mystic]), 레벨 0-5 중립 카드, 레벨 0-4 “사용(충전)”기능을 갖는 카드, 레벨 0 비술 카드. 덱 구성 요구조건 (덱 크기에 포함되지 않습니다): 영매, 성난 영혼, 무작위 기본 약점 카드 1장.
flavor: “저 너머의 땅을 탐험하리. 난 저들이 두렵지 않아.”
back_flavor: 나이지리아에서 나고 자란 아카치는 어릴적부터 쭉 혼자였다. 허공을 향해서 이야기를 나눈다든가 다른 아이들과 동떨어져 지내는 아카치의 모습을 보면서 마을 사람들은 아카치가 제정신이 아니라고 생각했다. 하지만 마을의 영적 지도자인 디비아는 아카치의 잠재력을 알아보았다. 그는 영혼들이 아카치를 위대한 일을 할 재목으로 삼았다고 믿었기에 영혼과 소통하는 방법을 알려주었다. 디비아의 후견 아래 아카치는 젊고 현명한 지도자로 성장했으며 자신의 마을뿐만 아니라 그녀가 도움을 준 모든 공동체로부터 존경받는 존재로 발돋움했다. 이제 아카치는 숙명을 향해 나아가려 한다. 오직 자신의 지식으로만 막아낼 수 있는 불가사의한 문제를 해결하기 위하여.
real_text:
Your assets with "uses (charges)" enter play with 1 additional charge on them.
[elder_sign] effect: +1. Add 1 charge to an asset with "uses (charges)" you control.

name: 그림 속 세계
text:
세피나 루소 덱 전용.
이 카드는 ‘세피나 루소’ 밑에 놓을 수 없습니다.
‘그림 속 세계’를 ‘세피나 루소’ 밑에 있지만 ‘특별’ 키워드가 없는 이벤트 카드 1장의 사본인 것처럼 플레이합니다. ‘그림 속 세계’를 버리는 대신 게임에서 제거합니다.
real_text:
Sefina Rousseau deck only.
Cannot be placed beneath Sefina Rousseau.
Play The Painted World as an exact copy of a non-exceptional event that is beneath Sefina Rousseau. Remove The Painted World from the game instead of discarding it.

name: 히아데스 성단
text: 폭로 - ‘세피나 루소’ 밑에서 이벤트 1장을 무작위로 선택하여 게임에서 제거합니다. 그렇게 할 수 없다면, 피해 1과 공포 1을 받습니다. 당신의 덱에 카드가 5장 이상 있다면, ‘히아데스 성단’을 버리는 대신 당신의 덱에 합친 후 섞습니다.
real_text: Revelation - Randomly choose an event beneath Sefina Rousseau and remove it from the game. If you cannot, take 1 damage and 1 horror. If your deck has 5 or more cards in it, shuffle Stars of Hyades back into your deck instead of discarding it.

name: 영매
text: 아카치 오넬레 덱 전용. [free] ‘영매’를 소진합니다: 당신이 조종하고 있으며 “사용(충전)” 기능을 가진 자산 하나를 선택합니다. 그 자산을 당신의 손으로 가져옵니다 (또는) 그 자산에 놓인 모든 충전을 당신의 자원 저장소로 이동시키고 그 자산을 버립니다(이렇게 이동시킨 토큰은 자원으로 사용됩니다).
real_text: Akachi Onyele deck only. [fast] Exhaust Spirit-Speaker: Choose an asset you control with "uses (charges)." Either return that asset to your hand, or move all charges from that asset to your resource pool (as resources) and discard that asset.

name: 성난 영혼
text: 폭로 - ‘성난 영혼’을 플레이 영역 중 당신의 위협 영역에 둡니다. [free] [[마법]] 자산 하나를 소진합니다: 그 자산에 놓인 충전 1회를 ‘성난 영혼’으로 이동시킵니다. 강제 - 게임이 끝날 때, ‘성난 영혼’에 놓인 충전이 4회 미만이면: 당신은 육체적 트라우마 1을 겪습니다.
real_text: Revelation - Put Angered Spirits into play in your threat area. [fast] Exhaust a [[Spell]] asset: Move 1 charge from that asset to Angered Spirits. Forced - When the game ends, if Angered Spirits has fewer than 4 charges on it: You suffer 1 physical trauma.

name: 고대 상형문자판
text: [action] 당신의 손에서 [intellect] 능력 아이콘이 1개 이상 있는 카드를 1장 버립니다: 토큰 저장소에서 자원을 1개 가져와 ‘고대 상형문자판’에 올려놓습니다. 이 자원 토큰은 ‘비밀’로 간주합니다. 강제 - ‘고대 상형문자판’에 세 번째 비밀이 놓인 후: ‘고대 상형문자판’을 버리고 자원을 5개 획득합니다. 캠페인 기록지에 “당신은 상형문자를 해석했다”라고 기록합니다.
real_text: [action] Discard a card with at least 1 [intellect] skill icon from your hand: Place 1 resource on Archaic Glyphs from the token pool, as a secret. Forced - After the third secret is placed on Archaic Glyphs: Discard Archaic Glyphs and gain 5 resources. Record in your Campaign Log that "you have translated the glyphs."

name: 교묘한 술책
text:
신속. 당신의 차례에만 플레이할 수 있습니다.
당신의 손에 있는 [[물품]] 자산 1장을 플레이 영역에 둡니다. 당신의 차례 끝에, 그 자산이 여전히 플레이 상태라면 그 자산을 당신의 손으로 가져옵니다.
real_text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Put an [[Item]] asset into play from your hand. At the end of your turn, if that asset is still in play, return it to your hand.

name: 대담한 방책
text:
신속. 당신이 능력 테스트에서 성공하려 할 때 플레이할 수 있습니다.
당신은 이번 능력 테스트에서 +2 능력값을 얻습니다.
flavor:
“맥글렌, 우릴 둘 다 죽일 셈이야?”
“아니, 친구. 일단 지금은 아니야.”
real_text:
Fast. Play when you would succeed at a skill test.
You get +2 skill value for this test.

name: 연금술 변환
text:
사용(충전 3회).
[action] ‘연금술 변환’을 소진하고, 충전 1회를 소비합니다: [willpower] (1)를 테스트합니다. 성공하면, 난이도를 넘어선 차이만큼 자원을 획득합니다(최대 3개). 이번 테스트에서 [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], [auto_fail] 기호가 공개되면, 피해를 1 받습니다.
real_text:
Uses (3 charges).
[action] Exhaust Alchemical Transmutation, spend 1 charge: Test [willpower] (1). For each point you succeed by, gain 1 resource (to a maximum of 3). If a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol is revealed during this test, take 1 damage.

name: 영혼 해방
text: 당신의 손에서 [[마법]] 또는 [[의식]] 카드 1장을 플레이합니다. 그 카드의 자원 비용이 3만큼 줄어듭니다.
flavor: 그녀는 힘에 사로잡혀 벌벌 떨며 경련했다. 마침내 그 힘이 그녀와 합쳐지고, 그녀가 눈을 떴다...
real_text: Play a [[Spell]] or [[Ritual]] card from your hand, reducing its resource cost by 3.

name: 유체 이탈
text: 이동. 아무 공개된 장소 한 곳으로 이동하고 혼돈 주머니에서 무작위 토큰을 1개 공개합니다. [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], [auto_fail] 기호가 공개되면, 당신은 자신이 조종하는 [[물품]] 또는 [[조력자]] 자산을 하나 버려야 합니다(그렇게 할 수 없다면, 피해를 1 받습니다).
flavor: 차원을 넘어선 이동에는 위험이 따른다는 것쯤은 그도 잘 압니다. 그렇다 한들, 시공을 뛰어넘는 흥미진진한 능력을 거부할 사람이 어디 있겠습니까?
real_text: Move. Move to any revealed location and reveal a random token from the chaos bag. If you reveal a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol, you must discard an [[Item]] or [[Ally]] asset you control (if you cannot, take 1 damage).

name: 뒤따라 오는 존재
text: 출현 - 당신의 위치에서 가장 먼 장소. 먹잇감 - 오직 이 약점의 보유자만 쫓습니다. 사냥꾼. 강제 - ‘뒤따라 오는 존재’가 쓰러지려 할 때: 그 대신 이 카드를 보유자의 덱에 섞어넣습니다.
flavor: 이 세상 어디에 있든 따라옵니다.
real_text: Spawn - Location farthest from you. Prey - Bearer only. Hunter. Forced - When The Thing That Follows would be defeated: Instead shuffle it into its bearer's deck.

name: 지나친 열정
text: 폭로 - 조우 덱 맨 위 카드 1장을 뽑습니다. 그 카드는 ‘급증’ 키워드를 획득합니다.
flavor: “걱정 마, 내가 다 처리할 수 있어!”
real_text: Revelation - Draw the top card of the encounter deck. That card gains surge.

name: 황색 표식을 그리다
text: 폭로 - ‘황색 표식을 그리다’를 플레이 영역 중 당신의 위협 영역에 둡니다. 당신의 손에 들 수 있는 카드 장수 제한이 5만큼 줄어듭니다. [action][action]: ‘황색 표식을 그리다’를 버립니다.
real_text: Revelation - Put Drawing the Sign into play in your threat area. Your maximum hand size is reduced by 5. [action] [action]: Discard Drawing the Sign.

name: 윌리엄 요릭
text: [reaction] 당신이 적 하나를 쓰러뜨린 후: 당신의 버린 카드 더미에서 자산 하나를 플레이합니다(비용은 지불합니다). (라운드당 1번 한정) [elder_sign] 효과: +2. 성공하면, 당신의 버린 카드 더미에서 카드를 1장 손으로 되돌립니다.
back_text: 덱 크기: 30장. 덱 구성 선택지: 레벨 0-5 생존자 카드([survivor]), 레벨 0-5 중립 카드, 레벨 0-2 수호자 카드([guardian]). 덱 구성 요구조건 (덱 크기에 포함되지 않습니다): 깊이 묻다, 묘지의 구울, 무작위 기본 약점 카드 1장.
flavor: “난 이 드라마에서 단순한 배역에 불과하네만, 운이 좋다면 살아남아서 막이 내리는 걸 볼 수도 있겠지.”
back_flavor: 윌리엄 요릭은 한번도 묘지기라는 직업을 원한 적이 없었다. 그는 배우 지망생이었고, 몇 년간 보스턴에서 일하면서 맡을 수 있는 모든 배역을 맡아보았다. 요릭은 그중에서도 셰익스피어 작품에 출연하는 것을 가장 좋아했지만, 몇 년 후 결국 무대는 자신의 운명과 동떨어져 있다는 사실을 인정할 수밖에 없었다. 배우를 포기한 후 시작한 묘지기 일은 매우 따분했지만 망자들이 훌륭한 청중이 되어준 덕에 윌리엄은 일인극을 즐겨 펼치곤 했다. 하지만, 무덤에서 시체를 파내서 먹는 피폐한 괴물을 발견한 후로 그의 묘지기 일도 어두운 국면을 맞게 되었다. 그날 밤 이후, 요릭은 망자를 지키기 위하여 수단과 방법을 가리지 않고 괴물을 막아내고 있다.
real_text: [reaction] After you defeat an enemy: Play an asset from your discard pile (paying its cost). (Limit once per round.) [elder_sign] effect: +2. If this test is successful, return 1 card from your discard pile to your hand.

name: 깊이 묻다
text: 윌리엄 요릭 덱 전용. 신속. 당신이 위치한 장소에서 [[정예]]가 아닌 적 하나가 쓰러진 후에 플레이할 수 있습니다. 그 적을 (그리고 이 카드도) 승점 더미에 추가합니다.
flavor:
“미친 짓 같겠지만, 그 안에 길이 있는 법이지.”
- 윌리엄 셰익스피어, “햄릿”
real_text: William Yorick deck only. Fast. Play after a non-[[Elite]] enemy at your location is defeated. Add that enemy (and this card) to the victory display.

name: 묘지의 구울
text: 먹잇감 - 오직 ‘윌리엄 요릭’만 쫓습니다. 사냥꾼. ‘묘지의 구울’이 당신과 교전 중인 동안, 당신의 버린 카드 더미에 있는 카드는 버린 카드 더미에서 나올 수 없습니다.
flavor:
“지옥은 비어 있고, 악마는 모두 여기 있네.”
 - 윌리엄 셰익스피어, “폭풍우”
real_text: Prey - William Yorick only. Hunter. While Graveyard Ghouls is engaged with you, cards cannot leave your discard pile.

name: 랜턴
text: [action]: 조사. 이번 조사에서 당신이 위치한 장소는 -1 장막값을 얻습니다. [action] ‘랜턴’을 버립니다: 당신과 같은 장소에 있는 적 하나에게 피해를 1 줍니다. 이 행동은 틈새 공격을 유발하지 않습니다.
real_text: [action]: Investigate. Your location gets -1 shroud for this investigation. [action] Discard Lantern: Deal 1 damage to an enemy at your location. This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

name: 묘지기의 삽
text: [action]: 전투.당신은 이번 공격에서 +2 [combat]을 얻습니다. [action] ‘묘지기의 삽’을 버립니다: 당신이 위치한 장소에서 단서를 1개 발견합니다.
flavor: 하지 말아야 할 일인지 알지만, 파는 것을 멈출 수가 없다.
real_text: [action]: Fight. You get +2 [combat] for this attack. [action] Discard Gravedigger's Shovel: Discover 1 clue at your location.

name: 32구경 콜트
text: 사용(탄약 6발). [action] 탄약을 1발 소비합니다: 전투. 이번 공격은 +1 피해를 줍니다.
flavor: “경찰관이나 개인 총기 소지자 중 상당수는 반자동 권총이 등장한 이후에도 리볼버를 선호했습니다. 더 안정적이라는 이유에서였죠.”
real_text: Uses (6 ammo). [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You deal +1 damage for this attack.

name: 만사에 대비하라
text: 당신의 손에서 자산을 (한 번에 1장씩) 최대 3장까지 플레이합니다. 이렇게 플레이하는 모든 자산의 자원 비용이 1씩 줄어듭니다.
flavor: 그는 로건을 믿어야만 했습니다. 로건이라면 종말에 대한 대처법을 잘 알 테니 말입니다.
real_text: One at a time, play up to 3 assets from your hand, reducing the resource cost of each by 1.

name: 현장 조사
text: [reaction] 당신이 장소 한 곳으로 이동한 후, 그 장소에 단서가 하나라도 있다면, ‘현장 조사’를 소진합니다: 이번 단계에 당신이 수행하는 다음 능력 테스트에서 능력값에 +2를 얻습니다.
flavor: 이렇게까지 했는데도 ‘제네’가 탐험가 연맹에 가입할 수 없다면, 대체 누가 연맹에 들어갈 수 있단 말입니까?
real_text: [reaction] After you move to a location, if that location has at least 1 clue on it, exhaust Fieldwork: You get +2 skill value for the next skill test you perform this phase.

name: 잠행
text: [action] ‘잠행’을 소진합니다: 회피. 선택된 적은 이번 회피 시도에서 -2 회피값을 얻습니다. 당신이 성공적으로 그 적을 회피하면, 그 적과의 교전은 풀리지만 그 적을 소진시키지는 않습니다. 당신의 차례가 끝날 때까지, 그 적은 당신과 교전할 수 없습니다.
real_text: [action] Exhaust Stealth: Evade. The chosen enemy gets -2 evade for this evasion attempt. If you successfully evade the enemy, disengage with it but do not exhaust it. Until the end of your turn, that enemy cannot engage you.

name: 자물쇠 따개
text: 사용(소모품 3개). ‘자물쇠 따개’에 더 이상 소모품이 없으면, 이 카드를 버립니다. [action] ‘자물쇠 따개’를 소진합니다: 조사. 이번 조사에서 당신의 능력값에 당신의 [agility] 값을 추가합니다. 당신이 ‘난이도를 넘어선 차이 2 이상으로 성공’하지 못하면, ‘자물쇠 따개’에서 소모품을 1개 제거합니다.
real_text: Uses (3 supplies). If Lockpicks has no supplies, discard it. [action] Exhaust Lockpicks: Investigate. Add your [agility] value to your skill value for this investigation. If you do not succeed by at least 2, remove 1 supply from Lockpicks.

name: 영혼이 깃든 의식용 단검
text: [free] [[마법]] 카드에 있는 능력 테스트를 하는 동안, ‘영혼이 깃든 의식용 단검’을 소진합니다: 당신은 이번 능력 테스트에서 +2 능력값을 얻습니다. [action] ‘영혼이 깃든 의식용 단검’을 소진합니다: 전투. 당신은 이번 공격에서 +2 [combat]을 얻습니다.
real_text: [fast] During a skill test on a [[Spell]] card, exhaust Spirit Athame: You get +2 skill value for this test. [action] Exhaust Spirit Athame: Fight. You get +2 [combat] for this attack.

name: 은신처
text: 신속. ‘은신처’를 아무 장소 한 곳에 부착합니다. 부착된 장소에 있는 [[정예]]가 아닌 모든 적은 ‘냉담한’ 키워드를 획득합니다. 강제 - 적 단계 끝에, 부착된 장소에 준비 상태인 적이 있다면: ‘은신처’를 버립니다.
real_text: Fast. Attach Hiding Spot to any location. Each non-[[Elite]] enemy at attached location gains aloof. Forced - At the end of the enemy phase, if a ready enemy is at attached location: Discard Hiding Spot.

name: 임기응변
text: 이번 능력 테스트에 성공하면, 당신의 버린 카드 더미에서 ‘임기응변’이 아닌 [survivor] 카드 1장을 선택합니다. 선택한 카드를 당신의 손으로 가져옵니다.
real_text: If this skill test is successful, choose a [survivor] card not named Resourceful in your discard pile. Add the chosen card to your hand.

name: 커튼콜
text:
쉬움 / 보통
[skull]: -1(당신이 가진 공포가 3 이상이라면, -1 대신 -3).
[cultist] [tablet] [elder_thing]: -4. 당신이 위치한 장소에 공포가 1개 이상 놓여 있다면, 공포를 1 받습니다(받는 공포 토큰은 그 장소가 아니라 토큰 저장소에서 가져옵니다). 당신이 위치한 장소에 공포가 하나도 없다면, 그 대신 그곳에 공포를 1개 올려놓습니다.
back_text:
어려움 / 전문가
[skull]: -X. X는 당신이 가진 공포 개수입니다(가진 공포가 없다면 X는 1입니다).
[cultist] [tablet] [elder_thing]: -5. 당신이 위치한 장소에 공포가 1개 이상 놓여 있다면, 공포를 1 받습니다(받는 공포 토큰은 그 장소가 아니라 토큰 저장소에서 가져옵니다). 당신이 위치한 장소에 공포가 하나도 없다면, 그 대신 그곳에 공포를 1개 올려놓습니다.
real_text: Easy / Standard [skull]: -1 (-3 instead if you have 3 or more horror on you). [cultist] [tablet] [elder_thing]: -4. If your location has at least 1 horror on it, take 1 horror (from the token pool). If your location has no horror on it, place 1 horror on it instead.

name: 제3막
back_text: Search all set-aside cards and the victory display for the Royal Emissary enemy, and spawn it in the Theatre.
flavor: The theatre is eerily silent. The old wooden floor creaks beneath your feet, and a light rain gently patters on the roof as you explore the auditorium. There are more rotting corpses among the seats, and the rest of the crowd has vanished…
back_flavor: Abruptly, the malformed body of an unnatural nightmare slams onto the stage, its slithering tendrils reaching into the aisles. It opens its maw and lets out a shrill, piercing song. The melody is uncanny; the notes sear into your mind. Pain pounds in your forehead, and blood runs from your ears.

name: 앙코르
text: Forced - After Royal Emissary is added to the victory display: Remove all doom from play and reset the agenda deck to agenda 1a. Then, place 3 doom on that agenda.
back_text: Each investigator takes 100 horror (cannot be prevented).
flavor: The creature’s song echoes relentlessly throughout the halls of the theatre. The melody repeats again and again, yet somehow, never the same note twice.
back_flavor: The song grows louder and louder, until it drowns out all of your thoughts. You collapse to the floor and cover your ears, but try as you might, you cannot muffle the intensity of the creature's awful voice. The whole world threatens to close around you, until at last you hear a discordant phrase throughout the melody: "EXIT NOW."
real_text: Forced - After Royal Emissary is added to the victory display: Remove all doom from play and reset the agenda deck to agenda 1a. Then, place 3 doom on that agenda.

name: 깨어나다
back_text: Choose one of the set-aside locations, at random. Put that location into play, and spawn the set-aside The Man in the Pallid Mask enemy at that location (instead of his normal spawn location). Advance to one of the 3 copies of act 2a, at random. Remove the other 2 copies of act 2a from the game without looking at them.
flavor: You pinch yourself to see if you are dreaming, and sure enough, your skin stings and reddens. You take a few deep breaths and try to think rationally. Whatever is going on, you must explore the theatre to learn the truth of the matter.
back_flavor:
A shadow creeps along the wall beside you, and your heart leaps into your throat. You turn, and a figure flits away just out of sight. Either your mind is playing tricks on you, or someone else is in the theatre.
You follow the direction of the shadow, rounding a nearby corner. At the far end of the hall, he stands awaiting you: a man in an elegant black suit, his face covered by a pale mask. Though his attire has changed, you instantly recognize him as the actor who played the role of the Stranger - one of the characters from <u>The King in Yellow</u>. He turns and disappears through an open doorway, as if taunting you to follow.

flavor: Mr. Perry is indifferent to your questions at first, but he grows more talkative as you express interest in his many investments. You learn that he has financed several productions of <u>The King in Yellow</u> in the past - not just tonight's performance. "It was the director, Mr. Engram, who convinced me to invest," he explains. "The first time I met him was in Paris, at a café in Montparnasse. What was the name?" He ruminates for some time, trying to remember. "Anyway, he convinced me that not every investment is about capital gain. One might consider me a fool to believe him, but I don't regret my decision. I've been financing his productions ever since." He smiles and pauses for some time, lost in memory. "L'agneau Perdu, that was the place. Yes, yes. What a night."

For whatever reason, Mr. Engram would not allow me to change his outfit, not one bit. And that mask!" She scoffs. "Did you know, one time I found that actor - I don't even know his name! - I found him drawing a strange pattern behind the backdrop for the second act. You know the one, with the two suns. Her re-creation is much more detailed than you expected: rings of concentric semicircles lined with strange runes, and at the center is a pair of wavy lines. You ask her what it means, and she shrugs. "Haven't the slightest clue."

name: 진실은 숨겨져 있다

flavor: Surprisingly, the front doors of the Historical Society’s Georgian manor are cracked halfway open when you arrive. Who else could be here at this hour?
back_flavor:
A phrase in a language you cannot describe whispers through the building, and without warning all of the electric lights shatter at once. You light a nearby candle and continue your search.
The building is quite different once plunged into darkness. Shadows and silhouettes dance along the walls. Crevices you hadn't noticed before draw your wary eye. What other secrets does this building hold?

text: Skip the 'Place 1 doom on the current agenda' step of the Mythos phase. Forced - After 1 or more clues are placed on an enemy in play: Flip those clues to their doom side.

flavor: Though the whispering has ceased, the sounds of rummaging and furniture shifting is unmistakable. Whoever is here, they’re searching just as thoroughly as you are...
back_flavor:
The front door of the manor opens, letting in a howl of chill wind and the pitter-patter of soft rain, then it suddenly slams shut. You find a place to hide and eavesdrop, wondering who else might have entered the building this late. "No, I swear, I swear I don't know where the door is!" A man cries out. "You'll have to find the Path on your own, I cannot help you!" He sounds panicked and disorientated.
"You spoke the Oath," a man's voice responds. "You spoke His name." The man stammers. "No! No, I cannot! I will not!" Then, his voice becomes distorted, and he speaks no more. You hear footsteps on the staircase - heavy and wet.

text: Skip the 'Place 1 doom on the current agenda' step of the Mythos phase. Forced - After 1 or more clues are placed on an enemy in play: Flip those clues to their doom side.
flavor: Whoever these people are, they must be involved with the conspiracy behind The King in Yellow. You can’t let them find whatever it is they’re looking for!
back_flavor: There is a rush of footsteps along the manor's central stairway, and the front door opens once more. "Have you found it?" A muffled voice asks. "Yes. We can embark immediately. The Path will be opened." The door closes, and the manor returns to being quiet and lonely. For the remainder of your search, you find no further traces of the mysterious robed figures, nor do you find any information to answer your many questions about The King in Yellow...

name: 답을 향한 경주
back_text: For each revealed Historical Society location, add 1 [per_investigator] clues to it (to a maximum of its clue value).
flavor: Each of the Historical Society’s many rooms contains records and documents that may aid you in your search for answers about The King in Yellow. There must be something here that can guide you toward the truth.
back_flavor: You find a record kept by one of the society's historians pertaining to the "dreadful events" surrounding the closing of an old theatre in Arkham, the Cedar Playhouse. Though there is no explicit mention of The King in Yellow, you believe you are on the right track. The historian's notes are cut short, and there is a faded, handwritten page clipped to the final entry. This matter is too ghastly for the public eye. I am placing the remainder of this record in the hidden library. All further inquiries should be done away from prying eyes, for this is a dangerous matter, and not one to be researched lightly.

name: 과거의 과오
back_text:
For each revealed Historical Society location, add 1 [per_investigator] clues to it (to a maximum of its clue value).
Choose an investigator to take control of the set-aside Mr. Peabody asset.
Put the set-aside Hidden Library location into play.
flavor: Somewhere in the manor is a "hidden library" where you might be able to find more information about The King in Yellow. You must find the way in if you are to continue your investigation.
back_flavor:
As you rummage through a desk drawer, you are startled when you hear a voice behind you. "Excuse me! Can I help you?" You are relived to find the voice belonging to a thin, elderly man wearing wide-rimmed glasses - a member of the Historical Society, no doubt. You explain to him that you are searching for a hidden library somewhere in the manor, though you purposely leave out why.
He introduces himself as Mr. Peabody, the Historical Society's curator. "I'll help you find what you are looking for," he explains, "but only if you tell me what this is all about once we get there." You hope it doesn't come to that.

name: 맹세
text: Locations with the [[Passageway]] trait are connected to one another. Objective - Only investigators in the Hidden Library may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.
back_text: The investigators must decide (choose one): - This is an important discovery! We should take it with us. (→R1). - It's just a silly trinket, and it would be wrong to steal from the Historical Society. Leave it behind. (→R2)
flavor: "This building is very old, and filled with all manner of secret passageways," Mr. Peabody explains. "Perhaps one of them will lead to this library you’re looking for."
back_flavor: As you study the hidden library, you find a few pieces of information that stand out. As with the recent production, the previous performance of The King in Yellow came to Arkham from overseas, and was performed by a French acting troupe. You don't recognize any of the cast members' names, and of course the actor who played the role of the Stranger is anonymous. However, it seems that a member of the Historical Society has done some of your work for you; there are several old newspaper clippings gathered together along with information about the play. Headlines include: Cedar Playhouse Closes Due To Fire, Experts Baffled Over Freak Floods, and the like. Hidden amongst this information, you also find a strange object - A clasp of onyx with an alien inscription.

If a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] token is revealed during this attack, deal 1 damage to each investigator at the attacked enemy's location.

name: 제니 반즈
text:
당신은 정리 단계마다 추가로 자원을 1개 획득합니다.
[elder_sign] 효과: 당신이 가진 자원마다 +1.
back_text: 덱 크기: 30장. 덱 구성 선택지: 레벨 0-5 무법자 카드([rogue]), 레벨 0-5 중립 카드, 이외의 레벨 0 다른 역할군([guardian], [seeker], [mystic], [survivor]) 카드 최대 5장. 덱 구성 요구조건(덱 크기에 포함되지 않습니다): 제니의 45구경 쌍권총, 이자벨을 찾아서, 무작위 기본 약점 카드 1장.
flavor: “당신에게 ‘반즈양’이라고 불리긴 싫네요. 제 친구들처럼 제니라고 불러주세요.”
back_flavor: 제니 반즈는 젊은 시절을 육체적인 쾌락과 멋진 저녁 식사, 그리고 최신 유행을 찾아다니는 데에 보냈다. 하지만 그러한 삶도 동생 이자벨이 보낸 편지를 받고 난 이후로 변하고 말았다. 편지에서, 이자벨은 불가사의한 힘이 자신에게 가해지고 있으며 그로 인해 어떤 초자연적인 위협의 희생양이 될까봐 두렵다고 적어 놓았다. 그것이 제니가 사랑하는 동생으로부터 받은 마지막 편지였다. 그 후, 제니는 미국으로 돌아와 오컬트와 관련 사건을 닥치는 대로 추적하고 조사했다. 꽃이 쉽사리 시들지 않듯, 제니는 명사수이자 동시에 미지에 대한 두려움이 없는 명석한 조사자로서 활약했다. 이자벨의 실종을 밝혀내기 전까지 제니는 결코 수색을 멈추지 않을 것이다.
real_text:
You collect 1 additional resource during each upkeep phase.
[elder_sign] effect: +1 for each resource you have.

name: 숲정령 메달
text:
제니 반즈 덱 전용. 대체물.
[free] 자원을 3개까지 소비하고 ‘숲정령 메달’을 소진합니다: 이렇게 소비한 자원을 이 카드에 공물로서 올려놓습니다.
[reaction] 당신이 후퇴하거나 게임이 끝날 때: ‘숲정령 메달’에 놓인 공물 6개마다, 다음 시나리오로 진행하기 전에 당신이 구입하는 다음 카드의 경험치 비용을 1 줄입니다.
real_text:
Jenny Barnes deck only. Replacement.
[fast] Spend up to 3 resources and exhaust Green Man Medallion: Place those resources on it, as offerings.
[reaction] When you resign or the game ends: For every 6 offerings on Green Man Medallion, reduce the experience cost of the next card you purchase before the next scenario by 1.

name: 제물로 바쳐진 야수
text: 제니 반즈 덱 전용. 대체물. 출현 - 당신에게서 가장 먼 장소. 제니 반즈'는 카드의 효과로 자원을 획득할 수 없습니다.
flavor: Thick limbs like wet branches yearned skyward, high above the platform. They swayed, whether in agony or exaltation Jenny could not tell. - Dave Gross, Hour of the Huntress
real_text: Jenny Barnes deck only. Replacement. Spawn - Location farthest from you. Jenny Barnes cannot gain resources via card effects.

name: 비전 통찰
text:
사용(충전 3회).
[free] 아무 조사자 한 명이 차례를 갖는 동안 충전을 1회 소비합니다: 이번 차례가 끝날 때까지, 당신이 위치한 장소는 -2 장막값을 얻습니다(차례당 1번 한정).
real_text:
Uses (3 charges).
[fast] While an investigator is taking his or her turn, spend 1 charge: Your location gets -2 shroud until the end of this turn. (Limit once per turn.)

name: 주의 돌리기
text: 사용(충전 3회). [action] ‘주의 돌리기’를 소진합니다: 회피. 이번 회피 시도에서 당신의 능력값에 당신의 [willpower]값을 추가합니다. 당신이 ‘난이도를 넘어선 차이 2 이상으로 성공’하지 못하면, ‘주의 돌리기’에서 충전 1회를 제거합니다. [reaction] [[정예]]가 아닌 적이 당신을 공격하려 할 때, 충전을 1회 소비합니다: 그 공격을 취소합니다.
real_text: Uses (3 charges). [action] Exhaust Suggestion: Evade. Add your [willpower] value to your skill value for this evasion attempt. If you do not succeed by at least 2, remove 1 charge from Suggestion. [reaction] When a non-[[Elite]] enemy would attack you, spend 1 charge: Cancel that attack.

name: 비술 입문자
text: 강제 - ‘비술 입문자’가 플레이 영역에 들어온 후: 이 카드에 파멸 1개 또는 공포 2를 올려놓습니다. [free] ‘비술 입문자’를 소진합니다: 당신의 덱 맨 위 카드 3장 중에서 마법 카드를 1장 찾은 뒤, 그 카드를 뽑습니다. 당신의 덱을 섞습니다.
real_text: Forced - After Arcane Initiate enters play: Place 1 doom or 2 horror on it. [fast] Exhaust Arcane Initiate: Search the top 3 cards of your deck for a [[Spell]] card and draw it. Shuffle your deck.

name: “그냥 당하진 않아!”
text:
당신이 적과 교전하고 있을 경우에만 능력 테스트에 소모할 수 있습니다.
‘그냥 당하진 않아!’는 당신과 교전 중인 적 하나당 [willpower] [combat] [agility]을 획득합니다.
real_text:
Commit to a skill test only if you are engaged with an enemy.
For each enemy engaged with you, "Not without a fight!" gains [willpower] [combat] [agility].

name: 고무적인 존재
text: 이번 능력 테스트에 성공하면, 당신이 위치한 장소에 있는 [[조력자]] 자산 1장이 준비 상태가 되고 그 카드가 피해 1 또는 공포 1을 회복합니다.
flavor: “앤더슨은 정말 융통성이라곤 꽝이에요. 럼주는 입에도 안 대는 데다 꼭두새벽이면 우릴 깨우니까 말입니다. 그렇지만 지금 이런 외지에서 믿고 따르기엔 그만한 사람이 없죠.”
real_text: If this skill test is successful, ready an [[Ally]] asset at your location and heal 1 damage or 1 horror from it.

name: 비상 물자
text: 자원을 4개 획득하거나 당신이 위치한 장소에 있는 조사자들이 조종하는 자산들에 소모품 4개를 원하는 대로 분배해서 올려놓습니다. (혹은) 원한다면 두 효과를 원하는 조합으로 섞어서 해도 됩니다(총량만 4개가 되게끔).
flavor: 아무리 준비해도 부족하다.
real_text: Gain 4 resources or place 4 supply tokens among assets controlled by investigators at your location, or any combination thereof.

name: 백병전 단검
text: 당신이 실시하는 교전 행동은 틈새 공격을 유발하지 않습니다. [action]: 전투. 당신은 이번 공격에서 +X [combat]을 얻습니다. X는 당신이 교전 중인 적의 수입니다.
flavor: 대부분의 사람이 일생 동안 보는 것 보다 더 많은 폭력을 야기한다.
real_text: Engage actions you perform do not provoke attacks of opportunity. [action]: Fight. You get +X [combat] for this attack. X is the number of enemies engaged with you.

name: 매복
text: 당신이 위치한 장소에 부착합니다. 부착된 장소에 조사자가 한 명도 없다면, ‘매복’을 버립니다. 강제 - 부착된 장소에 적 하나가 출현한 후: 그 적에게 피해를 2 주고 ‘매복’을 버립니다.
real_text: Attach to your location. If there are no investigators at attached location, discard Ambush. Forced - After an enemy spawns at attached location: Deal 2 damage to that enemy and discard Ambush.

name: 기습
text: 당신과 같은 장소에 있고, 당신과 교전 중이 아닌 적 하나에게 피해를 2 줍니다.
real_text: Deal 2 damage to an enemy not engaged with you at your location.

name: 그림자의 서
text: [action] ‘그림자의 서’를 소진하고 자원을 1개 소비합니다: 당신이 조종하는 [[마법]] 자산 하나에 충전을 1회 추가합니다.
real_text: [action] Exhaust Book of Shadows and spend 1 resource: Add 1 charge to a [[Spell]] asset you control.

name: 투쟁 혹은 도피
text:
신속. 당신의 차례에만 플레이할 수 있습니다.
라운드가 끝날 때까지, 당신은 +X [combat]과 +X [agility]을 얻습니다. X는 당신이 가진 공포 개수입니다.
real_text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Until the end of the round, you get +X [combat] and +X [agility], where X is the amount of horror on you.

name: 끝내주는 운
text:
신속. 당신이 피해 그리고/또는 공포를 받을 때 플레이할 수 있습니다.
당신이 방금 받은 피해 그리고/또는 공포를 도합 10까지 취소합니다. ‘끝내주는 운’을 추방합니다.
flavor: “내가 제일 아끼는 모자인데!”
real_text:
Fast. Play when you are dealt damage and/or horror.
Cancel up to 10 damage and/or horror just dealt to you. Exile Devil's Luck.

name: 도움 요청
text: 당신이 조종하는 [[조력자]] 자산 하나를 선택하고 그 카드를 당신의 손으로 가져옵니다. 그런 다음, 당신의 덱 맨 위 카드 9장 중에서 [[조력자]] 자산 1장을 찾아서 자원 비용을 X만큼 낮춰 플레이합니다. X는 손으로 가져온 [[조력자]] 자산의 비용입니다. 당신의 덱을 섞습니다.
flavor: “이봐요, 교환원. 이제 전화 끊어주세요.”
real_text: Choose an [[Ally]] asset you control and return it to your hand. Then, search the top 9 cards of your deck for an [[Ally]] asset and play it, reducing its cost by X. X is the cost of the [[Ally]] asset returned to your hand. Shuffle your deck.

name: 입에 담아선 안 될 맹세
text:
쉬움 / 보통
[skull]: -1. 실패하면, 치워 두었던 [[괴물]] 적 중에서 무작위로 1장을 선택하여 앞면을 보지 않고 주요목적 덱 밑에 놓습니다.
[cultist]: -X. X는 당신이 가진 공포 개수입니다.
[tablet]: -X. X는 당신이 위치한 장소의 기본 장막값입니다.
[elder_thing]: 0. 둘 중 하나를 선택합니다. 치워 두었던 [[괴물]] 적 중에서 무작위로 1장을 선택하여 앞면을 보지 않고 주요목적 덱 밑에 놓습니다 (또는) 이번 능력 테스트에 자동으로 실패합니다.
back_text:
어려움 / 전문가
[skull]: 다른 혼돈 토큰을 하나 더 공개합니다. 실패하면, 치워 두었던 [[괴물]] 적 중에서 무작위로 1장을 선택하여 앞면을 보지 않고 주요목적 덱 밑에 놓습니다(테스트당 1번 한정).
[cultist]: -X. X는 당신이 가진 공포 개수입니다. 실패하면, 공포를 1 받습니다.
[tablet]: -X. X는 당신이 위치한 장소의 기본 장막값입니다. 실패하면, 공포를 1 받습니다.
[elder_thing]: 0. 둘 중 하나를 선택합니다. 치워 두었던 [[괴물]] 적 중에서 무작위로 1장을 선택하여 앞면을 보지 않고 주요목적 덱 밑에 놓습니다 (또는) 이번 능력 테스트에 자동으로 실패합니다.
real_text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -1. If you fail, randomly choose an enemy from among the set-aside [[Monster]] enemies and place it beneath the act deck without looking at it.
[cultist]: -X. X is the amount of horror on you.
[tablet]: -X. X is the base shroud value of your location.
[elder_thing]: 0. Either randomly choose an enemy from among the set-aside [[Monster]] enemies and place it beneath the act deck without looking at it, or this test automatically fails instead.

name: 갇히다
back_text:
Shuffle the encounter discard pile and each of the set-aside [[Possessed]] enemies into the encounter deck.
The lead investigator must randomly choose an enemy from among the set-aside [[Monster]] enemies and place it beneath the act deck without looking at it.
flavor: The patient wing of the asylum is far quieter and lonelier than you had expected. The hall reeks of chemicals and body odor. As soon as you are escorted inside, the doors behind you are closed and locked tight.
back_flavor: Speaking with the patients is proving more difficult than you had assumed. They eye you cautiously and refuse to answer any of your questions, backing away or fleeing if confronted. Either they're not used to guests, or something about you is causing them a considerable amount of distress. Some act like animals back into a corner, and you think at any moment they might strike.

name: 고통스럽게 지쳐가다
back_text: The lead investigator must randomly choose an enemy from among the set-aside [[Monster]] enemies and shuffle it into the encounter deck without looking at it. Check Campaign Log. If Constance Dumaine is not listed under "VIPs Slain," search the collection for Constance Dumaine (A Little Too Sociable) and spawn her in the Garden.
flavor: The longer you spend in this hellish place, the more you want to leave. Already it has felt like days. You fear that if you are stuck here much longer, you will become like the patients: a husk of your former self, unruly, and dangerous.
back_flavor: In the back of your mind, a force beckons. "Have you seen it?" It calls to you. Glimpsing something in your peripheral vision, you turn, and find a familiar symbol peering back at you wherever you look. It is etched upon the doors. Drawn on the walls. Painted on the patients' canvases. You cannot escape it.

name: 그의 영역
text: Forced - When you would place an enemy beneath the act deck: Shuffle that enemy into the encounter deck, instead.
back_text: Each investigator who has not resigned is defeated. (If any investigators resigned, those investigators may immediately advance to act 4b.)
flavor:
Flee.
Flee while you still can.
back_flavor:
The walls close in. Your vision blurs. There is screeching in your ears. You are grabbed and cannot fight back. You call for help but nobody comes to your aid.
You look for a way to escape, but instead you see the pallid mask of the Stranger staring back at you. Around every corner, behind every door, staring at you through every window. That mask… That damned mask…


Or… Perhaps it is you who wears the mask…?
real_text: Forced - When you would place an enemy beneath the act deck: Shuffle that enemy into the encounter deck, instead.

name: 아컴 정신병원
back_text:
The investigators must decide (choose one):
- Any investigator tests [combat] (4) to intimidate her into giving you the keys. If successful, advance to act 2a. If failed, you must choose an option you have yet to choose.
- Any investigator tests [agility] (4) to steal the keys from her. If successful, advance to act 2a. If failed, you must choose an option you have yet to choose.
- Any investigator tests [intellect] (4) to persuade her to give you the keys. If successful, advance to act 2a. If failed, you must choose an option you have yet to choose.
- You knock her over and grab the keys. Remember that "you took the keys by force." Advance to act 2a.
flavor: Aside from the few patients giving you a wide berth, there aren’t any orderlies or doctors around to speak with. Looks like you’ll have to find Mr. Chesterfield on your own.
back_flavor: Turning a corner, you nearly bump into a nurse with light brown hair and sharp features. You tell her about the violent patients and the strange things you've seen, but she doesn't listen. When you inquire about Daniel, she informs you that he is a patient of Dr. Mintz and that he resides in the secured basement level. Unfortunately, she refuses to let you into that area of the asylum.

name: “중증 환자”(v. I)
text: Ignore the text on the unrevealed side of [[Arkham Asylum]] locations. Objective - Find the Patient Confinement location with Daniel Chesterfield. (You will be instructed when to advance.)
back_text: Choose an investigator at Patient Confinement (Daniel's Cell). Put the set-aside Daniel Chesterfield card (asset side faceup) into play under that investigator's control. Shuffle the encounter discard pile and each enemy beneath the act deck into the encounter deck.
flavor: Daniel is somewhere in the secured basement where the most dangerous patients are kept. Now that you have the key, you can explore this area of the asylum.
back_flavor:
When you enter his cell, you find Daniel huddled in a corner of the room, sobbing and rocking back and forth on the ground. "No mask, no mask…" he stammers over and over. You help him to his feet and try to console him, telling him that he is not crazy - that strange events have been occurring throughout town ever since <u>The King in Yellow</u> returned to Arkham. "It's Nigel!" he exclaims, gripping you tightly. "Nigel made us speak his name… He made us speak the Oath, and now He lives inside us, controlling us, don't you understand?" he rambles on. "We spoke His name and the price was paid! Hastur! Hastur! O King!"
You believe you might understand more about the situation if you can calm him down, but you'll have to get him out of this asylum if you are to accomplish that.
real_text: Ignore the text on the unrevealed side of [[Arkham Asylum]] locations. Objective - Find the Patient Confinement location with Daniel Chesterfield. (You will be instructed when to advance.)

name: “중증 환자”(v. II)
text: Ignore the text on the unrevealed side of [[Arkham Asylum]] locations. Objective - Find the Patient Confinement location with Daniel Chesterfield. (You will be instructed when to advance.)
back_text: Spawn the set-aside Daniel Chesterfield (enemy side faceup) at Patient Confinement (Daniel's Cell).
flavor: Daniel is somewhere in the secured basement where the most dangerous patients are kept. Now that you have the key, you can explore this area of the asylum.
back_flavor:
When you enter his cell, you find Daniel huddled in a corner of the room, sobbing and rocking back and forth on the ground. "No mask, no mask…" he stammers over and over. You help him to his feet and ask him what he remembers about <u>The King in Yellow</u>, but he interrupts you. "Don't speak His name!" he exclaims frantically, his eyes wide with a yellow glow. "Nigel made us speak his name… He made us speak the Oath, and now He lives inside us, controlling us, don't you understand?" he rambles on.
The man approaches wearing a crazed expression, and you take a wary step backward. "We spoke His name and the price was paid! Hastur! Hastur! O King! - " Then, suddenly, he transforms before your very eyes. His bones twist and snap. His body warps grotesquely. The symbol carved into his forehead burns bright, and a yellow glow emanates from within his body. He lunges to attack you.
real_text: Ignore the text on the unrevealed side of [[Arkham Asylum]] locations. Objective - Find the Patient Confinement location with Daniel Chesterfield. (You will be instructed when to advance.)

name: 탈출을 계획하다
text: Ignore the text on the unrevealed side of [[Arkham Asylum]]locations. Objective - If investigators have performed 4 of the following, you must advance. - "Know the guards' patrols." - "Set a fire in the kitchen." - "Incited a fight amongst the patients." - "Released a dangerous patient." - "Recalled the way out." - "Distracted the guards."
back_text:
Shuffle the encounter discard pile and each enemy beneath the act deck into the encounter deck.
If at least 3 [[Monster]] enemies were shuffled into the encounter deck by this effect, the investigator with the lowest [willpower] discards cards from the top of the encounter deck until a [[Monster]] enemy is discarded and draws that enemy.
flavor: With or without Daniel, you have to get out of this place as soon as you can.
back_flavor: An orderly's scream echoes across the hall. Within moments, an alarm rings loudly throughout the institution. Nurses and guards rush through the asylum in a desperate attempt to control the situation. You feel dazed, and your vision is spotty, as though you've been struck by something heavy. The walls blur together and twist. Creatures begin to emerge out of the crevices and corners that did not exist moments before.
real_text: Ignore the text on the unrevealed side of [[Arkham Asylum]]locations. Objective - If investigators have performed 4 of the following, you must advance. - "Know the guards' patrols." - "Set a fire in the kitchen." - "Incited a fight amongst the patients." - "Released a dangerous patient." - "Recalled the way out." - "Distracted the guards."

name: 이곳은 정신병원이 아니라
text: Ignore the text on the unrevealed side of Arkham Asylum locations. Garden gains: "[action] If there is no ready enemy in the Garden: Resign. Finally, a way out!" Objective - If each undefeated investigator has resigned, advance.

name: 로랜드 뱅크스
text:
[reaction] 당신이 적을 하나 쓰러뜨린 후: 당신이 위치한 장소에서 단서를 1개 발견합니다 (라운드당 1번 한정).
[elder_sign] 효과: 당신이 위치한 장소에 있는 단서마다 +1
back_text: 덱 크기: 30장. 덱 구성 선택지: 레벨 0-5 수호자 카드([guardian]), 레벨 0-2 탐구자 카드([seeker]), 레벨 0-5 중립 카드. 덱 구성 요구조건(덱 크기에 포함되지 않습니다): 로랜드의 38구경 특제 권총, 은폐, 무작위 기본 약점 카드 1장.
flavor: 모든 일은 정확한 규칙과 절차에 따라야 한다. “ㄱ”은 꺾어 써야 하고, “ㅇ”은 왼쪽에서 오른쪽으로 동그라미를 그려야 한다. 지금까지는 이 방법이 잘 먹혔다.
back_flavor: 로랜드는 절차와 규칙을 지키는 것에서 안정감을 느껴왔다. 로랜드는 요원이라는 직업이 어떤 주어진 상황 속에서도 따를 수 있는 지침이 있다는 점에 안도했다. 하지만 최근, 그의 연방 요원 수첩에서는 적혀 있지 않는 케이스를 맡게 되었다. 기괴한 괴물, 시간과 공간을 통하는 차원문, 마법 주문을 맞닥뜨렸을 때 어떻게 해야 하는지는 그의 연방 수첩 어디에도 없었다. 그의 눈으로 보지 못했다면, 결코 믿지 않았을 일들이 일어나고 있었다 …. 그리고 이것들을 그의 윗선에서 이해할리도 없었다. 로랜드는 자신의 힘만으로 이 사건을 해결해야 함을 직감했다.

name: 첫째 밤
text: While you have more Conviction than Doubt, this agenda gains: "When checking the doom threshold, doom on cards other than this agenda subtract from the total doom in play instead of adding to it."
back_text: Each investigator disengages from each enemy engaged with him or her and may move to a connecting location. Move The Organist 1 location away from the nearest investigator (to a location with no investigators, if possible).
flavor: As you step off the train in Gare d’Orsay, the sun sinks below the Paris skyline. You cannot waste any time. If Nigel Engram is somewhere in Paris, you have to find him and wring the answers from him one way or another.
back_flavor: Birds start to chirp eagerly. An orange tint slowly spreads across the sky as the creatures of the night shrink back into the darkness. You spend most of the day resting, and the daylight passes quickly with very little to show for it. Before you are able to fully recover from the previous night's events, it is evening once more

name: 파리에서의 음모(v. I)
text: Objective - Spend the requisite number of clues to advance. Objective - At the end of the round, if there are 3 or more doom in play, advance.
back_text:
If you spent clues to advance:
You nearly bump into a tall man, his coat and hat as black as his skin is pale. You remember seeing him through the windows of St. Barnabé Church. His organ playing continues to haunt you…
Spawn the set-aside The Organist enemy at the lead investigator's location, (Draped in Mystery) side face-up. Advance to Act 2a - Pursuing Shadows.
Otherwise:
The organ you heard earlier continues to haunt you. No matter where you are, the torturous chords play over and over in your head. Startled, you ask a passerby about the church. "St. Barnabé?" she replies in a thick accent. "There is no such place."
Each investigator takes 2 horror. Spawn the set-aside The Organist enemy at the location farthest from all investigators, (Draped in Mystery) side face-up. Advance to Act 2a - Pursuing Shadows.
flavor: You pass the Church of St. Barnabé as you exit the train station and cannot help but overhear the organ playing. Is there a sermon this late in the evening? You marvel at the wild and strange chords for a moment before continuing. Paris is a big city, and you have very few leads…
real_text: Objective - Spend the requisite number of clues to advance. Objective - At the end of the round, if there are 3 or more doom in play, advance.

name: 파리에서의 음모(v. II)
text: Objective - Spend the requisite number of clues to advance. Objective - At the end of the round, if there are 3 or more doom in play, advance.

If you spent clues to advance:
The organ you heard earlier continues to haunt you. No matter where you are, the torturous chords play over and over in your head. The sensation that you are being watched tugs at your mind.
Spawn the set-aside The Organist enemy at the location farthest from all investigators, (Hopeless, I Defied Him) side face-up. Advance to Act 2a - Stalked by Shadows.
Otherwise:
You nearly bump into a tall man, his coat and hat as black as his skin is pale. He gives you a look of hatred, as intense and as deadly as you have ever seen. You recoil at the mere sight of him, and shadows gather around his feet as he marches towards you.
Each investigator takes 2 horror. Spawn the set-aside The Organist enemy at the lead investigator's location, (Hopeless, I Defied Him) side face-up. Advance to Act 2a - Stalked by Shadows.

name: 그림자를 쫓아서
text: [reaction] After you successfully attack The Organist: An investigator at your location may place 1 of his or her clues on The Organist. (Group limit 1 [per_investigator] times per round.) Objective - If there are 3 [per_investigator] clues on The Organist, advance.
back_text: Check Campaign Log. - If you intruded on a secret meeting, proceed to (→R2). - Otherwise, proceed to (→R1).
flavor: The chords that echo in your mind, the infernal man whose organ-playing intrigues and terrifies you… Perhaps there is a connection between this shadowy presence and <u>The King in Yellow</u>?
back_flavor: You pursue your quarry through a narrow avenue, passing a set of heavy iron gates. You are in a dead end - a court with tall, old houses on either side. You close the gates behind you and turn back toward the shadowed figure just as day begins to break. Rays of light peek out over the skyline, and you lift your hand to block the gaze of the sun. Then, as though dispersed by the sunlight, the figure you had been chasing folds into the shadows and vanishes. You search the court for the mysterious figure, but there is no sign of him anywhere. Just as you are about to leave, you spot a plaque next to a red-brown door atop a steep, narrow staircase. It reads: "N. Engram."

flavor:
I knew that every time I met him brought him nearer to the accomplishment of his purpose and my fate. And still I tried to save myself.
-Robert W. Chambers, "In the Court of the Dragon," <u>The King in Yellow</u>
back_flavor: You lose track of yourself within the city as you flee for your life. Your feet move of their own accord. The beating of sinewy wings and screeching of creatures above you spurs you onward. Soon you find yourself running down a narrow avenue, passing a set of heavy iron gates. You are in a dead end - a court with tall, old houses on either side. You turn back toward the entrance and breathe a sigh of relief as you see the sun rising once more over the skyline of Paris. As though dispersed by the sunlight, the figure that had been chasing you folds into the shadows and vanishes. Just as you are about to leave, you spot a plaque next to a red-brown door atop a steep, narrow staircase. It reads: "N. Engram."

name: 갖은 수단과 방법을 동원해서
text:
신속. 아무 ‘[free] 플레이어의 행동 기회’에 플레이할 수 있습니다.
당신이 위치한 장소에 있는 조사자 한 명을 선택합니다. 그 조사자는 자신의 덱에서 카드를 1장 찾아서 뽑습니다. 그리고 그 조사자의 덱을 섞습니다.
real_text:
Fast. Play during any [fast] player window.
Choose an investigator at your location. That investigator searches his or her deck for a card, draws it, and shuffles his or her deck.

name: 죽음 모면
text:
신속. 당신이 쓰러지려 할 때 플레이할 수 있습니다.
당신은 교전 중인 모든 적과의 교전이 풀리고, 당신의 위협 영역에 있는 모든 카드를 버리며, 공포 2와 피해 2를 회복한 뒤, 적이 없는 아무 공개된 장소 한 곳으로 이동합니다. 지금이 당신의 차례라면 당신의 차례를 즉시 끝냅니다. ‘죽음 모면’을 게임에서 제거합니다.
real_text:
Fast. Play when you would be defeated.
Disengage from each enemy engaged with you, discard all cards in your threat area, heal 2 horror and 2 damage, and move to any revealed location with no enemies. If it is your turn, end your turn. Remove Cheat Death from the game.

name: 정면 대결
text:
당신의 첫 번째 행동으로만 플레이할 수 있습니다.
당신과 교전 중인 적 하나에게 피해를 1 줍니다. 이 행동은 틈새 공격을 유발하지 않습니다.
real_text:
Play only as your first action.
Deal 1 damage to an enemy engaged with you. This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

name: 응급 처치
text:

name: 지름길
text: 신속. 당신의 차례에만 플레이할 수 있습니다. 당신이 위치한 장소에 부착합니다. 부착된 장소는 다음 기능을 획득합니다: “[free] ‘지름길’을 소진합니다: 이동(이어진 장소로). 이 장소에 위치한 조사자라면 누구나 이 기능을 격발해도 됩니다.”
flavor: 손바닥 들여다보듯, 당신은 이 마을 구석구석을 훤히 알고 있습니다.

name: “잘 봐!”
text:

name: 망자의 제국
text: Each location is connected to each location adjacent to it.
flavor: The dank, chill air of the catacombs penetrates your clothes and causes you to shiver. Everywhere you look, the remains of the dead greet you - a grim reminder of your own mortality.
real_text: Each location is connected to each location adjacent to it.

name: 죽음의 악령
text: Spawn - The starting location. Hunter. Retaliate. While Specter of Death is exhausted, it takes 1 less damage from each attack made against it. Forced - After you fail a skill test while attempting to evade Specter of Death: It attacks you.
real_text: Spawn - The starting location. Hunter. Retaliate. While Specter of Death is exhausted, it takes 1 less damage from each attack made against it. Forced - After you fail a skill test while attempting to evade Specter of Death: It attacks you.

name: 불사자의 제국
text: Each location is connected to each location adjacent to it.
back_text: Each investigator is defeated and suffers 1 physical trauma.
flavor: All around you, the eyes of skulls glow with an otherworldly hue. A ghostly voice echoes throughout the labyrinthine catacombs. You sense a threatening presence looming around you. It is just outside of your vision, past the dim fog that permeates through the catacombs, around every corner…
back_flavor: The ghostly presence that menaces you grows with each minute you spend exploring these dreadful catacombs. You walk faster, glancing behind you nervously every few steps. Why does it hound you? What is its purpose? It tugs and pulls on the periphery of your senses. You turn a sharp corner and its shapeless umbral form stares back at you. You spin and flee, passing through a narrow stone corridor you do not recognize. At every intersection, every corner, its shadowy arms reach for you, its many faces contorted in agony. You cannot escape. Resigned to your fate, you drop to your knees in hopelessness and stare down at the cold stone floor. You feel the presence approaching you and cannot bear to look up. Everything goes black.
real_text: Each location is connected to each location adjacent to it.

name: 카타콤을 지나서
text: Objective - Find The Man in the Pallid Mask. He is somewhere in the Catacombs. (Do not advance until you are instructed.)
back_text: Spawn the set-aside The Man in the Pallid Mask weakness in the Tomb of Shadows (instead of its normal spawn location). Check the Campaign Log. If Ishimaru Haruko is not listed under "VIPs Slain," search the collection for Ishimaru Haruko (Just Skin and Bones) and spawn her at the starting location.
flavor: At the end of the long tunnel next to you, the Stranger steps through the darkness, his pale mask glinting in the candlelight. "Wait!" you call out. He glances your way before vanishing into the shadows. Once more, you are forced to track him down to find answers…
back_flavor: Rows of skulls chatter their teeth endlessly as you pass through a narrow stone archway, into a round chamber illuminated by firelight. In the center of the tomb stands the Stranger, peering into the blaze. Across the wall, shadows dance and twist with the flickering of the flame. The Stranger turns to face you, and his own shadow spreads across the wall. Where his shadow's arms should be, tentacle shapes emerge, enveloping the walls in darkness. He lifts his hands toward the wall, as if trying to show you something.
real_text: Objective - Find The Man in the Pallid Mask. He is somewhere in the Catacombs. (Do not advance until you are instructed.)

name: 길이 막히다
text: Objective - "Tell us how to stop the path from opening!" If The Man in the Pallid Mask is defeated, advance. Objective - "What is he trying to show us?" Investigators in the Tomb of Shadows may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.
back_text:
If The Man in the Pallid Mask was defeated:
The Stranger drops to one knee, visibly wounded. Your knuckles whiten with anger, and you shout, "We know about Carcosa and Hastur. Now tell us how to stop this madness!" The Stranger digs his fingers into the cold stone floor, and the catacombs shake…
Mark two Conviction in your Campaign Log. Remove The Man in the Pallid Mask from the game. Advance to Act 3a - The Way Out.
If you spent clues to advance:
Recognizing that the Stranger poses no immediate danger to you, you study your surroundings and the strange shadows twist and distort once more, revealing a strange diagram…
Mark two Doubt in your Campaign Log. Remove The Man in the Pallid Mask from the game. Advance to Act 3a - Leading the Way.
flavor: The shadows cast along the bone walls shift into the shapes of several figures, acting out a macabre parody of <u>The King in Yellow</u>.
real_text: Objective - "Tell us how to stop the path from opening!" If The Man in the Pallid Mask is defeated, advance. Objective - "What is he trying to show us?" Investigators in the Tomb of Shadows may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.

name: 탈출구
text: Forced - At the end of the round, if The Gate to Hell is in play: Discard the location that is farthest from The Gate to Hell. Move each investigator and enemy that was at that location to a connecting location and deal 2 damage to each of them. Objective - If each undefeated investigator is at The Gate to Hell, advance.
flavor: Bones rattle to the floor, dislodged by the shaking and crumbling of the caverns around you. The Stranger grabs a skull from within the flames in the center of the chamber and flees.
back_flavor: The catacombs rumble and collapse behind you as you make your escape. You are able to follow the Stranger's shadow, tracing his steps to find your way through the labyrinthine passages. You cross the threshold of the catacombs entrance, a wave of rubble and bone chips following in your wake. The deafening noise of falling debris crashes behind you, and you turn to find the entrance blocked by a newly-formed wall of bone and rock. Just as you are ready to depart, a partially-charred skull bearing a strange diagram rolls to a stop at your feet. There is no sign of the Stranger anywhere.
real_text: Forced - At the end of the round, if The Gate to Hell is in play: Discard the location that is farthest from The Gate to Hell. Move each investigator and enemy that was at that location to a connecting location and deal 2 damage to each of them. Objective - If each undefeated investigator is at The Gate to Hell, advance.

name: 이방인을 따라서
text: Ignore the Forced ability on Blocked Passage. Objective - If each undefeated investigator is at Blocked Passage, advance.
flavor: The shadows along the walls of the tomb begin to coalesce. Strange runic symbols twist into the image of a building with a tall tower, its spire reaching up toward the ceiling. Then the Stranger beckons for you to follow, and disappears through the stone archway behind you.
back_flavor: Following the Stranger's lead, you take a circuitous route through the underground passageways. Finally you are confronted by a dead end - a tunnel blocked by an impossibly thick wall of collapsed bone and rubble. The Stranger stands nearby, holding the partially-charred skull he pulled from the fire in the Tomb of Shadows. "What now?" you ask, confused. He holds the skull aloft, and the floor begins to collapse into a pit of dark emptiness below. Bones and rubble from the wall fall into the pit, and it grows larger with each moment. The Stranger bows, then falls backwards into the pit before you can grab him. "Wait!" you call out, but it is too late. With the pit growing and threatening to swallow the catacombs entirely, you have no choice but to follow him.
