flavor: Waves slam against the stone walls, water spraying onto the pathways above. If you don't act quickly, even these stalwart walls won't be able to stop the rising tide.
back_flavor: The outer wall of the city defends it from the wrath of the tides, and also from conquering invaders.
real_text: Forced - After 1 or more doom is placed on the "a" agenda deck: Each investigator at the Outer Wall takes 1 damage.

name: 외벽
text: While the current "c" agenda has more doom on it than the current "a" agenda, double the number of skill icons on cards committed to skill tests at the Outer Wall.
flavor: Waves slam against the stone walls, water spraying onto the pathways above. If you don't act quickly, even these stalwart walls won't be able to stop the rising tide.
back_flavor: The outer wall of the city defends it from the wrath of the tides, and also from conquering invaders.
real_text: While the current "c" agenda has more doom on it than the current "a" agenda, double the number of skill icons on cards committed to skill tests at the Outer Wall.

name: 북쪽 탑
text: Forced - After 1 or more doom is placed on the "c" agenda deck: Each investigator at North Tower takes 1 horror.
flavor: Wet, stone steps lead higher up the path, toward the abbey. Above, black storm clouds threaten to overtake the island.
back_flavor: The north tower along the outer wall overlooks the town on one side and the tumultuous waters on the other. Freezing rain has made this path slippery and dangerous to follow.
real_text: Forced - After 1 or more doom is placed on the "c" agenda deck: Each investigator at North Tower takes 1 horror.

name: 북쪽 탑
text: While the current "a" agenda has more doom on it than the current "c" agenda, reduce the difficulty of each skill test at North Tower by 1.
flavor: Wet, stone steps lead higher up the path, toward the abbey. Above, black storm clouds threaten to overtake the island.
back_flavor: The north tower along the outer wall overlooks the town on one side and the tumultuous waters on the other. Freezing rain has made this path slippery and dangerous to follow.
real_text: While the current "a" agenda has more doom on it than the current "c" agenda, reduce the difficulty of each skill test at North Tower by 1.

name: 부서진 층계
text: Forced - After you enter Broken Steps: You must either lose 1 action or draw the topmost [[Omen]] treachery in the encounter discard pile.
back_flavor: Bolts of lightning silhouette the abbey above. A path of long, winding steps leads up the hill, branching into multiple routes as you draw nearer to the abbey.
real_text: Forced - After you enter Broken Steps: You must either lose 1 action or draw the topmost [[Omen]] treachery in the encounter discard pile.

name: 부서진 층계
text: Forced - After you enter Broken Steps: You must either discard an asset you control or draw the topmost [[Cultist]] enemy in the encounter discard pile.
back_flavor: Bolts of lightning silhouette the abbey above. A path of long, winding steps leads up the hill, branching into multiple routes as you draw nearer to the abbey.
real_text: Forced - After you enter Broken Steps: You must either discard an asset you control or draw the topmost [[Cultist]] enemy in the encounter discard pile.

name: 수도원 성당
text: If there are two agendas in play with different agenda numbers, Abbey Church gets +2 shroud. Forced - When Abbey Church is revealed: Put the set-aside Chœur Gothique, Knight's Hall, Cloister, Chapel of St. Aubert, and Abbey Tower locations into play.
back_text: The path leading to the Abbey Church is blocked. As an additional cost for you to enter the Abbey Church, investigators at Broken Steps must spend 3 [per_investigator] clues, as a group.
back_flavor: You’ll have to find a path not blocked by debris and rubble in order to reach the abbey.
real_text: If there are two agendas in play with different agenda numbers, Abbey Church gets +2 shroud. Forced - When Abbey Church is revealed: Put the set-aside Chœur Gothique, Knight's Hall, Cloister, Chapel of St. Aubert, and Abbey Tower locations into play.

name: 고딕 양식의 성가대석
text: [action] Place 1 doom on the current "a" agenda: Heal 2 damage. (Group limit once per game).
flavor: Lightning flashes through the windows of the abbey, thunder quickly answering in a booming voice all around the island.
back_flavor: A long pool of blood spreads slowly across the floor, leading toward the chœur gothique.
real_text: [action] Place 1 doom on the current "a" agenda: Heal 2 damage. (Group limit once per game).

name: 고딕 양식의 성가대석
text: [action] Place 1 doom on the current "c" agenda: Heal 2 horror. (Group limit once per game).
flavor: Lightning flashes through the windows of the abbey, thunder quickly answering in a booming voice all around the island.
back_flavor: A long pool of blood spreads slowly across the floor, leading toward the chœur gothique.
real_text: [action] Place 1 doom on the current "c" agenda: Heal 2 horror. (Group limit once per game).

name: 성직자 회랑
text: [action] If there are no clues on Cloister: Parley. Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, remember that you have "found a guide."
flavor: A lone monk patrols the covered walk, surrounding himself in whispered prayer. He doesn't seem to notice the storm threatening to tear the abbey down.
back_flavor: The open arcade of the cloister is normally restricted to the monastery’s monks and religious leaders, but with the abbey seemingly abandoned, it takes little effort for you to sneak your way in.
real_text: [action] If there are no clues on Cloister: Parley. Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, remember that you have "found a guide."

name: 기사의 전당
text: [action] If there are no clues on Knight's Hall: Investigate. Investigate using [agility] instead of [intellect]. If you succeed, instead of discovering clues, remember that you have "found the tower key."
back_flavor: Rows of symmetrical stone pillars give this hall a sense of calm serenity that clashes with the torrent outside.
real_text: [action] If there are no clues on Knight's Hall: Investigate. Investigate using [agility] instead of [intellect]. If you succeed, instead of discovering clues, remember that you have "found the tower key."

name: 생 오베르 예배당
text:
You can only discover clues in the Chapel of St. Aubert if you have 3 or fewer remaining sanity.
[action]: Take up to 3 horror.
back_text: The way to the Chapel of St. Aubert is hidden. You cannot enter the Chapel of St. Aubert unless you have "found a guide."
flavor: In the water below, you can see the spires of Carcosa. You are almost there - you need only open the gate.
back_flavor: Waves crash violently upon the rocks. The chapel stands lonely against the rain, barely able to survive the storm’s onslaught.
real_text:
You can only discover clues in the Chapel of St. Aubert if you have 3 or fewer remaining sanity.
[action]: Take up to 3 horror.

name: 생 오베르 예배당
back_text: The way to the Chapel of St. Aubert is hidden. You cannot enter the Chapel of St. Aubert unless you have "found a guide."
flavor: As you peer into the water below, you can see the hooded shape of Hastur looming beyond, hand outstretched. His laughter echoes throughout your mind.
back_flavor: Waves crash violently upon the rocks. The chapel stands lonely against the rain, barely able to survive the storm’s onslaught.

name: 수도원 탑
text:
You can only discover clues in the Abbey Tower if you have no cards in your hand.
[action]: Discard up to 3 cards from your hand.
back_text: The door leading up to the Abbey Tower is locked. You cannot enter the Abbey Tower unless you have "found the tower key."
flavor: In the vortex above, you can see the spires of Carcosa. You are almost there - you need only open the gate.
back_flavor: Dark lightning crashes throughout the air. Surrounding the top of the tower is a whirlwind of black clouds and bellowing wind.
real_text:
You can only discover clues in the Abbey Tower if you have no cards in your hand.
[action]: Discard up to 3 cards from your hand.

name: 수도원 탑
back_text: The door leading up to the Abbey Tower is locked. You cannot enter the Abbey Tower unless you have "found the tower key."
flavor: As you peer into the vortex above, you can see the hooded shape of Hastur looming beyond, hand outstretched. His laughter echoes throughout your mind.
back_flavor: Dark lightning crashes throughout the air. Surrounding the top of the tower is a whirlwind of black clouds and bellowing wind.

name: 파도의 습격자
text: Spawn - Porte de l'Avancée or Chapel of St. Aubert. Hunter.
flavor: When the tide is high, they emerge from the sea to feed.
real_text: Spawn - Porte de l'Avancée or Chapel of St. Aubert. Hunter.

name: 균열을 찾는 자
text: Forced - After Rift Seeker attacks you: You must either take 1 additional damage and 1 additional horror, or place 1 doom on each agenda in play. [action] Place 1 doom on each agenda in play and take 2 horror: Parley. Discard Rift Seeker.
real_text: Forced - After Rift Seeker attacks you: You must either take 1 additional damage and 1 additional horror, or place 1 doom on each agenda in play. [action] Place 1 doom on each agenda in play and take 2 horror: Parley. Discard Rift Seeker.

name: 파괴적인 홍수
text: Revelation - Test [agility] (3). If you fail: - If agenda 1a is in play, take 1 damage and lose 1 action. - If agenda 2a is in play, take 2 damage and lose 2 actions. - If act 3a or agenda 3a is in play, take 3 damage and lose 3 actions.
real_text: Revelation - Test [agility] (3). If you fail: - If agenda 1a is in play, take 1 damage and lose 1 action. - If agenda 2a is in play, take 2 damage and lose 2 actions. - If act 3a or agenda 3a is in play, take 3 damage and lose 3 actions.

name: 합쳐지는 세계
text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). If you fail: - If agenda 1c is in play, take 1 horror and discard 1 card from your hand. - If agenda 2c is in play, take 2 horror and discard 2 cards from your hand. - If act 3c or agenda 3c is in play, take 3 horror and discard 3 cards from your hand.
real_text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). If you fail: - If agenda 1c is in play, take 1 horror and discard 1 card from your hand. - If agenda 2c is in play, take 2 horror and discard 2 cards from your hand. - If act 3c or agenda 3c is in play, take 3 horror and discard 3 cards from your hand.

name: 시간 왜곡
text:
신속. 당신이 위치한 장소에 있는 조사자 한 명이 자신의 차례 동안 행동 해결을 마친 후에 즉시 플레이할 수 있습니다.
그 행동을 되돌립니다(그 행동이 실시되기 전으로 모든 게임 상태를 되돌립니다. 단, ‘시간 왜곡’을 플레이했다는 행위와 이에 따른 비용 지불은 되돌리지 않습니다).
real_text: Fast. Play immediately after an investigator at your location finishes resolving an action during his or her turn. Undo that action (return the game state to exactly the way it was before that action was performed, except for the playing of Time Warp and its costs).

name: 재빠른 분석
text: 영속. 덱당 1장 한정. 언제든 당신이 (정체불명) 또는 (미해석본) 카드 별칭이 붙은 카드를 향상할 때, 그 카드의 두 번째 사본을 경험치 비용의 지불 없이 향상해도 됩니다. 그렇게 하면, 향상하려는 카드 2장 모두를, 유효한 선택지 중에서 무작위로 선택하여 향상합니다 (반드시 덱 구성 제한은 지켜야 합니다).
real_text: Permanent. Limit 1 per deck. Anytime you upgrade a card with the (Unidentified) or (Untranslated) subtitle, you may upgrade a second copy of that card at no experience cost. If you do, the two upgraded versions are chosen at random from among the eligible options. (You must still meet all deckbuilding restrictions.)

name: 불가사의한 연구
text:
영속.
당신이 ‘불가사의한 연구’를 구입할 때, 정신적 트라우마 1을 겪습니다.
캠페인 모드에서 매 시나리오를 마친 후, 다음 시나리오를 시작하기 전에 당신이 처음으로 향상하는 [[마법]] 카드 1장의 경험치 비용을 1 줄입니다.
real_text:
Permanent.
When you purchase Arcane Research, suffer 1 mental trauma.
After each scenario of a campaign, reduce the experience cost of the first [[Spell]] card you upgrade before the next scenario by 1.

name: 아르덴의 갑주
text: [reaction] ‘아르덴의 갑주’에 피해가 할당될 때, ‘아르덴의 갑주’를 소진합니다: 할당된 피해 중에서 1만큼을 취소합니다.
real_text: [reaction] When damage is assigned to Armor of Ardennes, exhaust Armor of Ardennes: Cancel 1 of that damage.

name: 완전기억능력
text: ‘완전기억능력’을 아무 조사자 한 명의 버린 카드 더미에 있는 [[통찰]] 이벤트 1장의 사본인 것처럼 플레이합니다(비용도 그 이벤트와 동일하게 소비합니다). 그 이벤트를 게임에서 제거합니다. ‘완전기억능력’은 버리는 대신 게임에서 제거합니다.
real_text: Play Eidetic Memory as an exact copy of an [[Insight]] event in any investigator's discard pile (including its resource cost). Remove that event from the game. Remove Eidetic Memory from the game instead of discarding it.

name: 카론의 은화
text: 영속. 특별. 시나리오의 결말에서 경험치를 얻을 때, 당신이 그 시나리오에서 쓰러지지 않았다면 경험치를 추가로 2만큼 얻습니다. 당신이 그 시나리오에서 쓰러졌다면, 당신은 사망합니다.
real_text: Permanent. Exceptional. When earning experience during the resolution of a scenario, if you were not defeated during that scenario, you earn 2 additional experience. If you were defeated during that scenario, you are killed.

name: 루파라
text: 사용(탄약 2발). ‘루파라’를 플레이하는 행동은 틈새 공격을 유발하지 않습니다. [action] 탄약을 1발 소비합니다: 전투. 당신은 이번 공격에서 +1 [combat]을 얻고 +1 피해를 줍니다. ‘루파라’가 이번 차례에 플레이 영역에 들어왔다면, 당신은 이번 공격에서 +1 [combat]을 추가로 얻고 +1 피해를 추가로 줍니다.
real_text: Uses (2 ammo). Playing Lupara does not provoke attacks of opportunity. [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You get +1 [combat] and deal +1 damage for this attack. If Lupara entered play this turn, you get an additional +1 [combat] and deal an additional +1 damage for this attack.

name: 고대 표식의 봉인
text:
이번 능력 테스트에서는 혼돈 주머니에서 혼돈 토큰을 공개하지 않습니다. 이번 테스트에서 [elder_sign] 토큰이 공개된 것으로 간주합니다.
이번 능력 테스트가 끝날 때, ‘고대 표식의 봉인’을 게임에서 제거합니다.
real_text:
Do not reveal chaos tokens from the chaos bag for this test. Treat the chaos token revealed for this test as an [elder_sign].
When this test ends, remove Seal of the Elder Sign from the game.

name: 신문
text:
당신이 단서를 하나도 갖고 있지 않으면, 당신은 조사하는 동안 +2 [intellect]을 얻습니다.
[reaction] 당신이 위치한 장소에서 당신이 단서를 1개 이상 발견하려 할 때, 당신이 단서를 하나도 갖고 있지 않으면: 당신이 위치한 장소에서 추가로 단서를 1개 더 발견합니다.
flavor: 신문 1면 어디에도 당신이 목격한 공포의 존재와 관련된 내용은 없습니다. 하지만 불안하게도 부고란은 어마어마하게 깁니다.
real_text:
You get +2 [intellect] while investigating if you have no clues.
[reaction] When you would discover 1 or more clues at your location, if you have no clues: Discover an additional clue at your location.

name: 내분
text:
신속. 적 단계가 시작된 후 플레이할 수 있습니다.
이번 단계에 [[정예]]가 아닌 적이 당신에게 가하는 공격을 모두 취소합니다.
real_text:
Fast. Play after the enemy phase begins.
Cancel all attacks made by non-[[Elite]] enemies against you this phase.

name: 이스의 열쇠
text: 당신은 ‘이스의 열쇠’에 놓인 공포마다 모든 능력값에 +1을 얻습니다. 강제 - 당신에게 공포가 하나라도 놓이려 할 때: 그 공포 중에서 하나를 ‘이스의 열쇠’에 올려놓습니다. 강제 - ‘이스의 열쇠’가 플레이 영역에서 나갈 때: 당신의 덱 맨 위 카드 10장을 버립니다.
real_text: You get +1 to each of your skills for each horror on Key of Ys. Forced - When any amount of horror would be placed on you: Place 1 of that horror on Key of Ys. Forced - When Key of Ys leaves play: Discard the top 10 cards of your deck.

name: 선수치기
text:
당신이 수행하는 능력 테스트에서만 소모할 수 있습니다.
‘선수치기’는 이번 단계에 (그 누구든 상관없이) 각 조사자가 완료한 행동마다 [wild]를 1개씩 잃습니다.
real_text:
Commit only to a skill test you are performing.
Take the Initiative loses [wild] for each action that has been completed by any investigator this phase.

name: 속성 학습
text: [free] 당신이 가진 단서 1개를 당신이 위치한 장소에 올려놓고 ‘속성 학습’을 소진합니다: 당신은 이번 능력 테스트에서 +3 능력값을 얻습니다.
real_text: [fast] Place 1 of your clues on your location and exhaust Quick Study: You get +3 skill value for this skill test.

name: 미래를 떠올리다
text: [reaction] 당신이 수행하는 능력 테스트가 시작될 때, ‘미래를 떠올리다’가 준비 상태라면, 혼돈 토큰 하나를 호명합니다: 이번 능력 테스트 동안 호명한 혼돈 토큰이 공개되면, ‘미래를 떠올리다’를 소진합니다. 그런 다음, 당신은 이번 능력 테스트에서 +2 능력값을 얻습니다.
real_text: [reaction] When a skill test you are performing begins, if Recall the Future is ready, name a chaos token: If the named chaos token is revealed during this skill test, exhaust Recall the Future. Then, you get +2 skill value for this skill test.

name: 캘빈 라이트
text:
당신은 당신이 가진 공포마다 +1 [willpower]와 +1 [intellect]을 얻습니다.
당신은 당신이 가진 피해마다 +1 [combat]과 +1[agility]을 얻습니다.
[elder_sign] 효과: +0. 당신은 피해나 공포를 1 회복하거나, 직접적인 피해나 직접적인 공포를 1 받아도 됩니다.
back_text: 덱 크기: 30장. 덱 구성 선택지: 레벨 0-5 생존자 카드([survivor]), 레벨 0-3 [[영혼]] 카드, 레벨 0-5 중립 카드. 덱 구성 요구조건 (덱 크기에 포함되지 않습니다): 최후의 순간까지, 전령의 목소리, 무작위 기본 약점 카드 1장.
flavor: “그 사람의 털끝 하나라도 건드리면 널 죽여버리겠어.”
back_flavor: 이따금씩 삶은 선택을 강요하곤 한다. 주어진 운명에 순응하거나, 아니면 스스로 일어서 신념에 따라 운명을 개척하거나. 캘빈은 후자를 택했다. 흙투성이 길가에서 피 흘리며 죽음의 끝자락을 오가던 캘빈의 앞에 환상이 펼쳐졌다. 갈라진 지구… 그리고 평생 사랑해온 주앙이 일렁이는 지옥불의 소용돌이 속에서 잿더미가 되는 끔찍한 광경. 결국 캘빈은 또 다른 선택을 했다. 어둠 속으로 손을 뻗어 어둠을 끌어안은 것이다. 캘빈은 죽지 않을 것이다, 적어도 오늘은. 세계가 캘빈을 원하기에, 그리고 주앙이 그를 원하기에.
real_text:
You get +1 [willpower] and +1 [intellect] for each horror on you.
You get +1 [combat] and +1 [agility] for each damage on you.
[elder_sign] effect: +0. You may either heal 1 damage or horror, or take 1 direct damage or direct horror.

name: 최후의 순간까지
text:
캘빈 라이트 덱 전용.
직접적인 피해 및 직접적인 공포를 ‘최후의 순간까지’에 할당해도 됩니다.
flavor: 캘빈은 자신의 운명 앞에 결연히 우뚝 섰다. 흔들림 없이, 타협도 없이.
real_text:
Calvin Wright deck only.
Direct damage and direct horror may be assigned to Until the End of Time.

name: 전령의 목소리
text: 폭로 - 당신은 다음 둘 중 하나를 선택해야 합니다: - 직접적인 피해를 1 받고 육체적 트라우마 1을 겪습니다. - 직접적인 공포를 1 받고 정신적 트라우마 1을 겪습니다.
real_text: Revelation - You must either (choose one): - Take 1 direct damage and suffer 1 physical trauma. - Take 1 direct horror and suffer 1 mental trauma.

name: 캐롤린 펀
text:
[reaction] 당신의 카드 효과로 조사자 한 명 또는 [[조력자]] 자산 하나가 공포를 회복한 후: 회복된 카드의 조종자는 자원을 1개 획득합니다.

back_text: 덱 크기: 30장. 덱 구성 선택지: 레벨 0-3 수호자 카드([guardian]), 레벨 0-5 중립 카드, 레벨 0-5 “공포를 회복”하는/시키는 카드, 이외의 레벨 0-1 다른 탐구자([seeker]) 그리고/또는 신비주의자([mystic]) 카드 최대 15장. 덱 구성 요구조건(덱 크기에 포함되지 않습니다): 최면 요법, 이성적인 사고, 무작위 기본 약점 카드 1장 추가 제한조건: 레벨 1-5 [[무기]] 카드 포함 불가.
flavor: “정신이란 유약하지만, 잘 이해만 한다면 망가지지 않게 지킬 수 있어요.”
back_flavor: 캐롤린 펀은 남들의 정신세계를 들여다보는 게 일상이다. 복잡한 최면요법을 써서 환자를 재우고 그 꿈을 통해 심리를 엿보는 기법을 사용하면서 캐롤린은 온갖 해괴한 것들에 대해 보고 들어왔다. 어떤 환자는 꿈속에서 다른 세계에 가 보았다고 주장했고, 또 어떤 환자는 무시무시한 괴물이 꿈속에 출몰한다고도 했다. 이런 괴이한 건들은 연구가 이어질수록 꼬리에 꼬리를 물었는데도 여전히 캐롤린은 자신이 사는 세계에 공포스러운 것들이 존재한다는 사실을 제대로 이해하지 못했다. 물론 그렇다고 해도 캐롤린은 이 광기의 근원을 밝혀내는 작업을 멈추지 않을 것이다.

And now, far away, over leagues of tossing cloud-waves, I saw the moon dripping with spray; and beyond, the towers of Carcosa rose behind the moon.

text: Objective - When the investigators have collected the requisite number of clues, they must immediately spend them and advance.
back_text: Spawn the set-aside The Man in the Pallid Mask enemy at the Palace of the King.
flavor: You have opened the path to Carcosa in order to stop those who wish to free Hastur from his prison in the stars. Only you can put an end to this madness!
back_flavor:
A shadow creeps along the wall beside you, and your heart leaps into your throat. You turn, and a figure flits away just out of sight. Either your mind is playing tricks on you, or someone else is in the theatre.
You follow the direction of the shadow, rounding a nearby corner. At the far end of the hall, he stands awaiting you: the man who wears the Pallid Mask, the Stranger whose steps you have haunted for so many weeks. You remember that you have been here before.
The theatre dissolves around you. The bright glare of two suns pierce into your eyes from above. "Do you remember now?" he asks. He turns and vanishes into the aether, as if taunting you to follow.

This world is but a remnant of what it once was. The grand majesty of Carcosa spoken of in <u>The King in Yellow</u> is lost in this expanse of endless desolation. Dead, twisted trees, starving animals, and barren fields greet you everywhere you turn.
You begin to look for evidence of what might have caused such devastation. Across the lake, you see dark, twisted structures similar to those in Carcosa. At least one appears as large and as grand as Hastur's domain. You wonder if perhaps some kind of conflict took place between the two cities.

You encounter a man among the ruins of the city, haggard and tired. "Good stranger," he says, "I am ill and lost. Direct me, I beseech you, to Carcosa." You tell him that you believe you are in the realm of Carcosa right now, and he falls to his knees in despair. "No... But that cannot be!"
The man cries and raves, telling you more of the ancient and famous city. Though his words have little meaning to you, deep within your mind, you begin to understand.

flavor: In the outskirts of the city, you find a ruined mausoleum. Its entrance is not unlike the entrance to the Catacombs of Paris: archways of stone decorated with bone and mocking skulls. The Yellow Sign is inscribed in the stone above the final archway. The narrow, cluttered passageway leads into a circular chamber with a domed ceiling. In the center of the chamber lies an egg-shaped coffin made of stone, unmarked and firmly sealed. Curious, you attempt to open the coffin. It takes all of your strength to pull the heavy lid off, and it slides to the floor with a resounding thud. Inside, you see a familiar face - a woman in a tattered dress, her countenance noble and grim.

Remove this card from the game, and replace it with another set-aside copy of Dim Streets (move all investigators, enemies, and attachments from this location to the new copy of Dim Streets). Add clues to that copy of Dim Streets until it has clues on it equal to its clue value.
flavor: You pass under an archway of ebony stone linking two spires. The inscription on the archway is written in a language you have never seen before, but somehow you are able to understand it. When you read the inscription aloud, the portal of stone shimmers, and you see a glimpse into an alternate vision of the city of Carcosa. It is vibrant and mesmerizing, like no place you have ever seen before. The vision dissolves shortly after, and you find yourself back in the ruined streets.

name: 배낭
text:
[reaction] ‘배낭’이 플레이 영역에 들어온 후: 당신의 덱 맨 위 카드 6장 중에서 약점이 아닌 [[물품]] 또는 [[보급]] 카드를 최대 3장까지 찾아서, ‘배낭’에 뒷면으로 부착합니다. 당신의 덱을 섞습니다.
‘배낭’에 부착된 카드를 당신의 손에 있는 카드처럼 플레이해도 됩니다. ‘배낭’에 부착된 카드가 더 이상 없으면, 이 카드를 버립니다.
real_text:
[reaction] After Backpack enters play: Search the top 6 cards of your deck for up to 3 non-weakness [[Item]] or [[Supply]] cards, and attach them facedown to Backpack. Shuffle your deck.
Cards attached to Backpack may be played as if they were in your hand. If there are no cards attached to Backpack, discard it.

name: 롤라 산티아고
text:
당신은 +1 [intellect], +1 [agility]을 얻습니다.
[free] ‘롤라 산티아고’를 소진하고 자원을 X개 소비합니다: 당신이 위치한 장소에서 단서를 1개 발견합니다. X는 당신이 위치한 장소의 장막값입니다.
flavor:
“이 일을 하다 보면 소위 ‘저주’란 것들을 자주 접하지.
 그런 이야기는 가급적 하지 말자고.”
real_text:
You get +1 [intellect] and +1 [agility].
[fast] Exhaust Lola Santiago and spend X resources: Discover 1 clue at your location. X is the shroud value of your location.

name: 올리브 맥브라이드
text: [reaction] 당신이 혼돈 토큰을 공개하려 할 때, ‘올리브 맥브라이드’를 소진합니다: 1개의 혼돈 토큰을 대신하여 3개의 혼돈 토큰을 공개합니다. 이렇게 공개한 혼돈 토큰 가운데서 2개를 선택해서 해결하고, 나머지 하나는 무시합니다.
flavor:
어떤 마법이든 제대로 발동시키려면 목숨 걸고 임해야 해.
말 그대로 목숨이 걸릴 때도 있어.
real_text: [reaction] When you would reveal a chaos token, exhaust Olive McBride: Reveal 3 chaos tokens instead of 1. Choose 2 of those tokens to resolve, and ignore the other.

name: 모든 역경을 딛고서
text:
신속. 당신이 수행하는 능력 테스트의 난이도가 당신의 기본 능력값보다 높을 때 플레이할 수 있습니다.
이번 능력 테스트에서 혼돈 토큰을 추가로 X개 더 공개합니다. 이렇게 공개한 혼돈 토큰 가운데서 1개를 선택해서 해결하고, 나머지는 모두 무시합니다. X는 당신의 기본 능력값이 난이도에 모자란 차이입니다.
real_text:
Fast. Play when you perform a skill test with a difficulty higher than your base skill value.
Reveal X additional chaos tokens for this skill test. Choose one to resolve and ignore the rest. X is the difference between the test's difficulty and your base skill value.

name: 마테오 신부
text:
[reaction]  아무 조사자 한 명이 [auto_fail] 혼돈 토큰을 공개할 때: 그 토큰을 취소하고, 대신 그 토큰을 [elder_sign] 토큰으로 취급합니다. (게임당 1번 한정.)
[elder_sign] 효과: 당신은 자동 성공합니다. 이번 능력 테스트가 끝난 후, 다음 중 하나를 선택합니다:
 - 카드를 1장 뽑고 자원을 1개 획득합니다.
 - 당신의 차례 도중이었다면, 당신은 이번 차례에 추가로 행동을 1번 더 해도 됩니다.
back_text: 덱 크기: 30장. 덱 구성 선택지: 레벨 0-5 신비주의자 카드([mystic]), 레벨 0-3 [[축복받은]] 카드, 레벨 0-5 중립 카드. 덱 구성 요구조건 (덱 크기에 포함되지 않습니다): 시대의 고서, 이그의 뱀, 무작위 기본 약점 카드 1장. 추가 경험치: 당신은 추가 경험치 5점을 가지고 캠페인을 시작합니다(이 추가 경험치는 독립 시나리오 모드에서 경험치에 따라 받아야 하는 약점 개수에 영향을 미치지 않습니다).
back_flavor: 사제로 임명된 이래로 마테오 카스티야의 삶은 그리 순탄치 않았다. 지난 수십 년 동안 멕시코는 분쟁과 갈등을 겪으며 망가지고 있었다. 마테오 신부는 신념의 실천과 정부가 정한 전도 금지법의 테두리 사이에서 균형을 잡으려 노력했다. 그러나 마테오의 신앙을 근간부터 흔드는 문제는 따로 있었다. 최근 벌어진 수많은 살인과 납치 사건을 조사하던 마테오는 이 사건들이 자신이 애초에 우려했던 정치 폭력과는 거리가 멀다는 사실을 알아냈다. 이 사건 중 대부분은 들끓고 있는 전쟁의 핵심에 자리잡은 끔찍하고 무시무시한 이단 종교 집단이 저지른 범죄였던 것이다. 마테오는 의문을 품었다. 어찌하여 선하고 자비로우신 신께서는 마테오 자신이 그날 밤 본 끔찍한 사태가 일어나게 두신단 말인가?
real_text:
[reaction] When an investigator reveals an [auto_fail] chaos token: Cancel that token and treat it as an [elder_sign] token, instead. (Limit once per game.)
[elder_sign] effect: You automatically succeed. After this test ends, either (choose one):
 - Draw 1 card and gain 1 resource.
 - If it is your turn, you may take an additional action this turn.

name: 시대의 고서
text: 마테오 신부 덱 전용. 봉인([elder_sign]). 이 카드에 토큰이 봉인되어 있는 동안 당신은 +1 [willpower]를 얻습니다. [reaction] 당신이 혼돈 주머니에서 혼돈 토큰을 1개 공개하려 할 때, ‘시대의 고서’를 버립니다: (혼돈 주머니에서 토큰 1개를 공개하는 대신) 이 카드에 봉인되어 있던 [elder_sign] 토큰을 방금 혼돈 주머니에서 공개한 것처럼 간주하여 해결합니다.
real_text: Father Mateo deck only. Seal ([elder_sign]). You get +1 [willpower] while there is a token sealed here. [reaction] When you would reveal a chaos token from the chaos bag, discard The Codex of Ages: Resolve the [elder_sign] token that was sealed here as if it were just revealed from the chaos bag (instead of revealing a token from the chaos bag).

name: 이그의 뱀
text: 먹잇감 - 오직 ‘마테오 신부’만 쫓습니다. 사냥꾼. 폭로 - 혼돈 주머니에서 [elder_sign] 토큰을 찾아서 ‘이그의 뱀’에 봉인합니다.
flavor: “이그란 게 뭔지는 모르겠지만, 내가 그의 자손에게 해를 끼쳤다는 건 알고 있다네.” - 마테오 신부, <u>아컴 호러의 조사자들</u>
real_text: Prey - Father Mateo only. Hunter. Revelation - Search the chaos bag for the [elder_sign] chaos token and seal it on Serpents of Yig.

name: 크토니안 석판
text: 봉인([skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing] 중 1개) 강제 - 당신이 능력 테스트에서 [auto_fail] 기호를 공개한 후: ‘크토니안 석판’을 당신의 손으로 가져옵니다.
flavor: 이게 여기 있는 건 다 이유가 있을 것이다.
real_text: Seal ([skull], [cultist], [tablet], or [elder_thing]). Forced - After you reveal an [auto_fail] symbol during a skill test: Return The Chthonian Stone to your hand.

name: 레오 앤더슨
text:
[reaction] 당신의 차례를 시작한 후: [[조력자]] 자산 하나를 자원 비용 1 줄여서 플레이합니다.
[elder_sign] 효과: +2. 당신의 덱 맨 위 카드 3장 중에서 [[조력자]] 자산 하나를 찾아서 뽑습니다. 당신의 덱을 섞습니다.
back_text: 덱 크기: 30장. 덱 구성 선택지: 레벨 0-5 수호자 카드([guardian]), 레벨 0-2 무법자 카드([rogue]), 레벨 0-5 중립 카드. 덱 구성 요구조건 (덱 크기에 포함되지 않습니다): 미치 브라운, 피의 대가를 치르다, 무작위 기본 약점 카드 1장.
flavor: “제명에 죽고 싶다면, 멈추지 말고 계속 가.”
back_flavor: 레오 앤더슨은 평생 동안 전 세계에서 가장 위험한 벽지를 누벼왔으며, 그 과정에서 좋은 동료를 많이 잃었다. 그동안 많은 이들의 희생으로 얻어낸 학술적인 성과가 과연 그 목숨만큼의 가치가 있었는지, 레오는 종종 스스로에게 묻곤 한다. 얼마 전 레오는 『올로소파의 책력』이라 불리는 유물을 찾기 위해 난 마돌로 탐사를 다녀왔지만, 그 여정은 비극으로 끝나 버렸다. 레오와 함께한 탐험대원 중에서 생존한, 아니 인간의 몰골이라도 하고서 살아남은 이는 미치 브라운밖에 없었다. 레오는 자신을 믿고 따랐던 사람들을 땅에 묻는 일이 지긋지긋해졌다. 하지만 레오는 이러한 탐사를 그저 학구적인 것으로 순진하게 볼 일이 아니라는 걸 잘 알고 있으며, 이 일을 끝맺기 전까지는 감히 그만두지 않을 것이다.
real_text:
[reaction] After your turn begins: Play an [[Ally]] asset, reducing its cost by 1.
[elder_sign] effect: +2. Search the top 3 cards of your deck for an [[Ally]] asset and draw it. Shuffle your deck.

name: 우르술라 다운즈
text:
[reaction] 당신이 장소 한 곳으로 이동한 후: 조사 행동을 1번 수행합니다. (라운드당 1번 한정.)
[elder_sign] 효과: +1. 이번 능력 테스트가 끝난 후, 당신은 이어진 장소로 이동해도 됩니다.
back_text: 덱 크기: 30장. 덱 구성 선택지: 레벨 0-5 탐구자 카드([seeker]), 레벨 0-4 [[유물]] 카드, 레벨 0-5 중립 카드. 덱 구성 요구조건 (덱 크기에 포함되지 않습니다): 제이크 윌리엄스, 미지의 부름, 무작위 기본 약점 카드 1장.
flavor: “발견이야 아무나 하는 거야. 그게 뭔지 이해하는 게 어려운 거지.”
back_flavor: 모든 대륙에 있는 산을 등반해 본 사람이 얼마나 되겠는가? 식인 부족으로부터 황금 우상을 훔쳐낸 이는 그보다도 더 적을 것이다. 남성이 지배적으로 군림해 온, 모험과 탐험의 세계에서 이런 업적을 당당히 이뤄냈다는 점에서 우르술라는 독보적인 존재라 할 만하다. 소싯적부터 우르술라는 여자가 따라야 하는 규범 따위 보란 듯이 무시하면서 나무에 오르고, 진탕에서 구르고, 숲을 탐험하면서 “숙녀가 해선 안 될” 일을 수도 없이 해왔다. 우르술라는 보스턴에서 고고학 학위를 받은 이래로, 세계를 여행하며 잊힌 문명을 찾아다니고 있다.
real_text:
[reaction] After you move to a location: Take an investigate action. (Limit once per round.)
[elder_sign] effect: +1. After this test ends, you may move to a connecting location.

name: 핀 에드워즈
text:
당신의 차례 도중, 당신은 추가로 행동을 1번 더 해도 됩니다. 단, 이 추가 행동은 회피에만 사용할 수 있습니다.
[elder_sign] 효과: 플레이 상태인 소진된 적마다 +1. 난이도를 넘어선 차이 2 이상으로 성공하면, 당신이 위치한 장소에서 단서를 1개 발견해도 됩니다.
back_text: 덱 크기: 30장. 덱 구성 선택지: 레벨 0-5 [[불법]] 카드, 레벨 0-3 무법자 카드([rogue]), 레벨 0-5 중립 카드, 이외의 레벨 0 탐구자 그리고/또는 생존자([seeker] 그리고/또는 [survivor]) 카드 최대 5장. 덱 구성 요구조건 (덱 크기에 포함되지 않습니다): 밀반입 상품, 핀의 든든한 38구경 권총, 현행범으로 붙잡히다, 무작위 기본 약점 카드 1장.
flavor: “달아날 길도, 상품도, 나는 절대 놓치는 법이 없지.”
back_flavor: 핀 에드워즈에게 있어 금주법이야말로 최고의 기회였다. 술이 금지되기 전까지만 하더라도, 핀은 여기저기 떠돌아다니며 손닿는 대로 괴상한 일이나 하고 다녔다. 하지만 금주법이 선포된 후로는 오히려 술에 대한 수요가 어마어마하게 증가하면서, 핀은 법망을 피해서 사람들이 원하는 것을 충족시켜주는 삶을 살게 되었다. 이러한 새로운 삶은 위험과 돈을 추구하는 핀의 성격에 특히나 잘 맞아떨어졌다. 지금껏 핀은 한 번도 잡힌 적이 없을 뿐더러, 배달을 실패한 적조차 없었다. 이제 핀은 모종의 초자연적인 음모에 사로잡히고 말았지만, 그렇더라도 두 가지 원칙은 달라지지 않는다. 1. 상품을 배달한다. 2. 붙잡히지 않는다.
real_text:
You may take an additional action during your turn, which can only be used to evade.
[elder_sign] effect: +1 for each exhausted enemy in play. If you succeed by 2 or more, you may discover 1 clue at your location.

name: 미치 브라운
text:
레오 앤더슨 덱 전용.
당신에게 조력자 슬롯이 2칸 추가됩니다. 이 조력자 슬롯에는 고유가 아닌 조력자만 놓을 수 있습니다.
flavor:
“레오, 넌 이제 나 없인 아무 데도 못 가.
그러니 무슨 사정인지 다 털어놓으라고!”
real_text:
Leo Anderson deck only.
You have 2 additional ally slots, which can only be used to hold non-unique allies.

name: 피의 대가를 치르다
text: 폭로 - 당신은 플레이 영역에서 자신이 조종하는 [[조력자]] 자산 하나를 버려야 합니다 (또는) 당신의 손에 있는 모든 [[조력자]] 자산을 버려야 합니다. 이 효과로 자산을 하나도 버리지 못했다면, ‘피의 대가를 치르다’를 당신의 덱에 합친 후 섞습니다.
flavor: 이 지식을 찾기 위해 우린 끔찍한 대가를 치르고야 말았다. 정말 그럴 가치가 있었을까…
real_text: Revelation - You must either discard an [[Ally]] asset you control from play, or discard each [[Ally]] asset from your hand. If no assets are discarded by this effect, shuffle Bought in Blood back into your deck.

name: 밀반입 상품
text:
핀 에드워즈 덱 전용.
당신이 위치한 장소에 준비 상태인 적이 없을 경우에만 플레이할 수 있습니다.
당신의 덱 맨 위 카드 9장 중에서 또는 당신의 버린 카드 더미에서 [[불법]] 카드를 1장 찾아서 뽑습니다. 당신의 덱을 찾아봤다면, ‘밀반입 상품’을 당신의 덱에 합친 후 섞습니다.
real_text:
Finn Edwards deck only.
Play only if there are no ready enemies at your location.
Search either your discard pile or the top 9 cards of your deck for an [[Illicit]] card and draw it. If you searched your deck, shuffle Smuggled Goods into your deck.

name: 핀의 든든한 38구경 권총
text: 핀 에드워즈 덱 전용. 신속. 사용(탄약 3발). [action] 탄약을 1발 소비합니다: 전투. 당신은 이번 공격에서 +2 [combat]을 얻습니다. 공격받은 적이 당신과 교전 중이 아니라면, 이번 공격은 +1 피해를 줍니다.
flavor: 이것은 오래된 총이다. 닳았고, 많이 긁혔고, 오래 사용되었다. 그러나 그는 이것을 내려놓는 일이 없었다.
real_text: Finn Edwards deck only. Fast. Uses (3 ammo). [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You get +2 [combat] for this attack. If the attacked enemy is not engaged with you, you deal +1 damage for this attack.

name: 현행범으로 붙잡히다
text: 폭로 - 당신이 위치한 장소 및 이어진 각 장소에 있는 모든 적이 준비 상태가 됩니다. 이어진 각 장소에 있는 ‘사냥꾼’ 키워드를 가진 모든 적이 당신을 향해 1칸 이동합니다. 이 효과로 이동한 적이 하나도 없다면, ‘현행범으로 붙잡히다’를 당신의 덱에 합친 후 섞습니다.
real_text: Revelation - Ready each enemy at your location or a connecting location. Each hunter enemy at a connecting location moves 1 location toward you. If no enemies move as a result of this effect, shuffle Caught Red-Handed back into your deck.

name: 생존용 단도
text: [action]: 전투. 당신은 이번 공격에서 +1 [combat]을 얻습니다. [reaction] 적 단계 동안 적의 공격이 당신에게 피해를 준 후, ‘생존용 단도’를 소진합니다: 전투. 방금 공격해온 적을 대상으로 공격합니다. 당신은 이번 공격에서 +2 [combat]을 얻고 +1 피해를 줍니다.
real_text: [action]: Fight. You get +1 [combat] for this attack. [reaction] After an enemy attack deals damage to you during the enemy phase, exhaust Survival Knife: Fight. This attack targets the attacking enemy. You get +2 [combat] and deal +1 damage for this attack.

name: 모험가
text:
사용(소모품 3개).
[free] 소모품을 1개 소비하고 ‘모험가’를 소진합니다: 당신이 위치한 장소에 있는 조사자가 조종하는 자산 하나에 소모품 1개 또는 탄약 1발을 올려놓습니다.
real_text:
Uses (3 supplies).
[fast] Spend 1 supply and exhaust Venturer: Place 1 supply or ammo on an asset controlled by an investigator at your location.

name: 믿음직한
text:
신속. 당신의 차례에만 플레이할 수 있습니다.
당신이 조종하는 [[조력자]] 자산 하나에 부착합니다.
부착된 자산은 +1 체력과 +1 정신력을 얻습니다.
real_text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Attach to an [[Ally]] asset you control.
Attached asset gets +1 health and +1 sanity.

name: 든든한
text:
신속. 당신의 차례에만 플레이할 수 있습니다.
당신이 조종하는 [[물품]] 자산 하나에 부착합니다.
부착된 자산의 격발 기능을 해결하는 동안, 당신은 모든 능력에 +1을 얻습니다.
real_text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Attach to an [[Item]] asset you control.
While resolving a triggered ability on attached asset, you get +1 to each of your skills.

name: 엘리 호로비츠 박사
text: [reaction] ‘엘리 호로비츠 박사’가 플레이 영역에 들어온 후: 당신의 덱 맨 위 카드 9장 중에서 [[유물]] 자산 하나를 찾아서 그녀에게 부착합니다. 당신의 덱을 섞습니다. ‘엘리 호로비츠 박사’에게 부착된 모든 [[유물]] 자산은 아무 슬롯도 차지하지 않습니다(하지만 이렇게 부착된 자산 역시 플레이 상태이며 당신이 조종하는 것으로 간주합니다).
real_text: [reaction] After Dr. Elli Horowitz enters play: Search the top 9 cards of your deck for a [[Relic]] asset and attach it to her. Shuffle your deck. Each [[Relic]] asset attached to Dr. Elli Horowitz does not take up any slots (it is still considered to be in play and under your control).

name: 고대 석판
text: [action]: 조사. 당신이 위치한 장소는 이번 조사에서 +3 장막값을 얻습니다. 성공하면, 당신이 위치한 장소에서 추가로 단서를 1개 더 발견하고 ‘고대 석판’을 버립니다. 그리고 캠페인 기록지에 “당신은 석판의 정체를 밝혀냈다”라고 기록합니다. 그 문장 다음에 괄호를 치고 이번 능력 테스트의 난이도를 함께 기록합니다.
real_text: [action]: Investigate. Your location gets +3 shroud for this investigation. If you succeed, discover 1 additional clue at your location, discard Ancient Stone, and record in your Campaign Log that "you have identified the stone." Next to this, in parentheses, record the difficulty of this skill test.

name: 에스틀리의 이빨
text:
당신은 음모 카드의 기능을 해결하는 동안 +1 [willpower]와 +1 [agility]을 얻습니다.
[reaction] 당신이 음모 카드의 기능을 해결하는 동안 능력 테스트에 성공한 후, ‘에스틀리의 이빨’을 소진합니다: 카드를 1장 뽑습니다.
real_text:
You get +1 [willpower] and +1 [agility] while resolving an ability on a treachery card.
[reaction] After you succeed at a skill test while resolving an ability on a treachery card, exhaust Tooth of Eztli: Draw 1 card.

name: 유물 발굴
text: 조사. 당신의 손에 있는 [seeker] 자산 하나를 선택합니다. 이번 능력 테스트의 난이도는 선택한 자산의 인쇄된 자원 비용과 같습니다. 성공하면, 단서를 발견하는 대신 선택한 자산을 플레이 영역에 둡니다. 이렇게 플레이 영역에 둔 자산이 [[유물]] 특성을 갖고 있다면, 카드를 1장 뽑습니다.
real_text: Investigate. Choose a [seeker] asset in your hand. The difficulty of this skill test is equal to the chosen asset's printed cost. If you succeed, instead of discovering clues, put the chosen asset into play. If that asset has the [[Relic]] trait, draw 1 card.

name: 보물 사냥꾼
text: 당신은 +1 [intellect]을 얻습니다. 강제 - 정리 단계 끝에: 당신은 자원을 1개 지불하거나 ‘보물 사냥꾼’을 버려야 합니다.
real_text: You get +1 [intellect]. Forced - At the end of the upkeep phase: You must either pay 1 resource or discard Treasure Hunter.

name: 치장된 해골
text:
사용(충전 0회).
[reaction] 당신이 위치한 장소에 있는 (조사자/[[조력자]] 자산/적)이 쓰러진 후: 토큰 저장소에서 자원을 1개 가져와 ‘치장된 해골’에 올려놓습니다. 이 자원은 ‘충전’으로 간주합니다. 가져온 자원은 충전으로 사용합니다.
[action] 충전을 1회 소비합니다: 카드를 1장 뽑고 자원을 1개 획득합니다.
real_text: Uses (0 charges). [reaction] After an investigator, [[Ally]] asset, or enemy at your location is defeated: Place 1 resource (from the token bank) on Decorated Skull, as a charge. [action] Spend 1 charge: Draw 1 card and gain 1 resource.

name: 엿듣기
text: 당신이 위치한 장소에 있지만 아무 조사자와도 교전 중이 아닌 적을 하나 선택합니다. [intellect] (X)을 테스트합니다. X는 선택한 적의 회피값입니다. 성공하면, 당신이 위치한 장소에서 단서를 2개 발견합니다.
real_text: Choose an unengaged enemy at your location. Test [intellect] (X), where X is the evade value of the chosen enemy. If you succeed, discover 2 clues at your location.

name: “네가 처리해!”
text:
신속. 당신이 ‘위험’ 키워드를 갖지 않는 조우 카드를 뽑은 후, 그 카드의 효과를 해결하기 전에 플레이할 수 있습니다.
다른 조사자 한 명을 선택합니다. 선택한 조사자가 당신 대신 그 조우 카드를 뽑은 것으로 간주합니다. 자원을 1개 획득합니다.
real_text:
Fast. Play after you draw a non-peril encounter card, but before resolving that card's effects.
Choose another investigator. That investigator is considered to have drawn that encounter card instead. Gain 1 resource.

name: 르리에의 안개
text: 사용(충전 4개). [action] 충전을 1회 소비합니다: 회피. 이번 회피 시도는 [agility] 대신 [willpower]를 사용합니다. 성공하면, 선택한 적을 회피한 후 당신은 이어진 장소로 이동해도 됩니다. 이번 회피 시도에서 [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], [auto_fail] 기호가 공개되면, 당신의 손에서 카드를 1장 선택해서 버립니다.
real_text: Uses (4 charges). [action] Spend 1 charge: Evade. This evasion attempt uses [willpower] instead of [agility]. If you succeed, after evading the chosen enemy, you may move to a connecting location. If a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol is revealed during this evasion attempt, choose and discard a card from your hand.

name: 수호의 주문
text: 플레이 상태인 ‘수호의 주문’ 사본 2장 그룹 한정. 봉인([auto_fail]를 제외한 아무 혼돈 토큰 1개) 강제 - 당신의 차례 끝에: 당신은 자원을 1개 소비하거나 ‘수호의 주문’을 버려야 합니다.
real_text: Group limit 2 copies of Protective Incantation in play. Seal (any except [auto_fail]). Forced - At the end of your turn: You must either spend 1 resource or discard Protective Incantation.

name: 어두운 예언
text:
신속. 당신이 혼돈 토큰을 공개하려 할 때 플레이할 수 있습니다.
1개의 혼돈 토큰을 대신하여 5개의 혼돈 토큰을 공개합니다. 이렇게 공개한 혼돈 토큰 가운데서 [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], [auto_fail] 중 하나를 선택해서 해결하고, 나머지는 모두 무시합니다. (이러한 토큰이 하나도 공개되지 않았다면, 공개한 토큰 중 1개를 선택해서 해결하고, 나머지는 모두 무시합니다.)
flavor: 별들 사이에 비밀이 쓰여 있나니.
real_text:
Fast. Play when you would reveal a chaos token.
Reveal 5 chaos tokens instead of 1. Choose one of those tokens with a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol to resolve, and ignore the rest. (If no such token is revealed, choose any one of those tokens to resolve, and ignore the rest.)

name: 급조 무기
text: 당신은 자신의 버린 카드 더미에 있는 ‘급조 무기’를 플레이해도 됩니다. 그렇게 한다면, 이 카드의 효과를 해결한 후에, 이 카드를 당신의 덱에 합친 후 섞습니다. 전투. 공격받은 적은 이번 공격에서 -1 전투값을 얻습니다 (자신의 버린 카드 더미에 있는 ‘급조 무기’를 플레이했다면, 이번 공격은 +1 피해를 줍니다).
real_text: You may play Improvised Weapon from your discard pile. If you do, shuffle it into your deck after resolving its effects. Fight. The attacked enemy gets -1 fight for this attack. (If you played Improvised Weapon from your discard pile, this attack deals +1 damage.)

name: 뜻밖의 행운
text:
신속. [[정예]]가 아닌 적을 대상으로 한 회피 시도 동안, 난이도에 모자란 차이가 2 이하로 능력 테스트에 실패한 후 플레이할 수 있습니다.
그 적을 조우 덱 맨 위에 놓습니다.
flavor: 행운이란 기대하지도 않았던 순간에 찾아오는 법이다.
real_text:
Fast. Play after you fail a skill test by 2 or less during an evasion attempt against a non-[[Elite]] enemy.
Place that enemy on top of the encounter deck.

name: 야오틀
text:
[free] ‘야오틀’을 소진합니다: 이번 능력 테스트 동안, 당신의 버린 카드 더미 맨 위 카드에 나와 있는 능력 아이콘([wild] 아이콘 제외)마다 그와 일치하는 능력값에 +1씩을 얻습니다.
[free]: 당신의 덱 맨 위 카드를 1장 버립니다(단계당 1번 한정).
real_text:
[fast] Exhaust Yaotl: During this skill test, you get a bonus to each skill equal to the number of matching skill icons on the top card of your discard pile (not counting [wild] icons).
[fast]: Discard the top card of your deck. (Limit once per phase.)

name: 마지막 기회
text:
이 카드 외에 다른 카드가 1장도 소모되지 않은 능력 테스트에만 소모할 수 있습니다. 이번 능력 테스트에는 누구도 다른 카드를 소모할 수 없습니다.
‘마지막 기회’는 당신의 손에 있는 카드마다 [wild]를 1개씩 잃습니다.
real_text:
Commit only to a skill test with no other cards committed to it. Other cards cannot be committed to this skill test.
Last Chance loses [wild] for each card in your hand.

name: 어둠의 계약
text: 캠페인 모드 전용. 당신이 위치한 장소에 있는 조사자 한 명에게 피해를 2 줍니다. 강제 - 게임이 끝나거나 당신이 탈락할 때, ‘어둠의 계약’이 당신의 손에 있다면: ‘어둠의 계약’을 당신의 덱에서 제거합니다. 보유 게임에서 ‘실패의 대가’를 찾아와 당신의 덱에 추가합니다.
real_text: Campaign Mode only. Deal 2 damage to an investigator at your location. Forced - When the game ends or you are eliminated, if Dark Pact is still in your hand: Remove Dark Pact from your deck. Search the collection for The Price of Failure and add it to your deck.

name: 실패의 대가
text: 폭로 - 피해 2와 공포 2를 받습니다. 현재 주요사건에 파멸을 1개 올려놓습니다(이 효과는 현재 주요사건을 진행시킬 수 있습니다). ‘실패의 대가’를 당신의 덱에서 제거합니다. 보유 게임에서 ‘어둠의 계약’을 찾아와 당신의 버린 카드 더미에 놓습니다.
real_text: Revelation - Take 2 damage and 2 horror. Place 1 doom on the current agenda (this effect can cause the current agenda to advance). Remove The Price of Failure from your deck. Search the collection for Dark Pact and place it in your discard pile.

name: 비운
text: 캠페인 모드 전용. 폭로 - 공포를 1 받습니다. 캠페인 기록지에서, 당신의 조사자 항목의 ‘얻은 이야기 자산/약점’에 “파멸이 다가온다”라고 기록합니다. 이미 기록되어 있다면, ‘비운’을 당신의 덱에서 제거하고, 보유 게임에서 ‘저주받은 운명’을 찾아와 당신의 덱 맨 밑에 놓습니다.
real_text: Campaign Mode only. Revelation - Take 1 horror. In your Campaign Log, under your investigator's earned story assets/weaknesses, record that "doom approaches." If this was already recorded, remove Doomed from your deck, search the collection for Accursed Fate, and place it on the bottom of your deck.

name: 저주받은 운명
text: 폭로 - 공포를 2 받습니다. 캠페인 기록지에서, 당신의 조사자 항목의 ‘얻은 이야기 자산/약점’에 “시간이 얼마 남지 않았다”라고 기록합니다. 이미 기록되어 있다면, ‘저주받은 운명’을 당신의 덱에서 제거하고, 보유 게임에서 ‘종이 울리다’를 찾아와 당신의 덱 맨 밑에 놓습니다.
real_text: Revelation - Take 2 horror. In your Campaign Log, under your investigator's earned story assets/weaknesses, record that "the hour is nigh." If this was already recorded, remove Accursed Fate from your deck, search the collection for The Bell Tolls, and place it on the bottom of your deck.

name: 종이 울리다
text: 폭로 - 당신의 최후가 도래했습니다. 당신은 사망합니다.
flavor:
언젠가는 죽을 운명이었다. 
언제라도 그러했다.
real_text: Revelation - The hour of your demise has arrived. You are killed.

name: 길들지 않은 야생
text:
쉬움 / 보통
[skull]: -X. X는 승점 더미의 복수 점수입니다.
[cultist]: -X. X는 플레이 상태인 장소 개수입니다(최대 5).
[tablet]: -X. X는 탐사 덱에 있는 카드 장수입니다(최대 5).
[elder_thing]: -2. 당신이 중독되어 있다면, -2 대신 이번 능력 테스트가 자동 실패합니다.
back_text:
어려움 / 전문가
[skull]: -X. X는 승점 더미의 복수 점수에 1을 더한 값입니다.
[cultist]: -X. X는 플레이 상태인 장소 개수입니다.
[tablet]: -X. X는 탐사 덱에 있는 카드 장수입니다(최소 3).
[elder_thing]: -3. 당신이 중독되어 있다면, -2 대신 이번 능력 테스트가 자동 실패합니다. 당신이 중독되어 있지 않았고 이번 능력 테스트에 실패했다면, 치워 두었던 ‘중독’ 약점 하나를 가져와 플레이 영역 중 당신의 위협 영역에 둡니다.
real_text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is the number of vengeance points in the victory display.
[cultist]: -X. X is the number of locations in play (max 5).
[tablet]: -X. X is the number of cards in the exploration deck (max 5).
[elder_thing]: -2. If you are poisoned, this test automatically fails instead.

name: 야생의 밀림 속으로
text: [action]: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a connecting location, put it into play and move to it.
back_text:
Shuffle the encounter discard pile and the set-aside Agents of Yig encounter set into the encounter deck.
Each investigator tests [willpower] (3). Each investigator who fails performs the following, in order:
- If you are poisoned, take 1 damage and 1 horror.
- If you are not poisoned, put a set-aside Poisoned weakness into play in your threat area.
flavor: Your expedition has ventured far into the rainforests of southern Mexico in search of a forgotten Aztec city-state. What will you find when you head deeper into the untamed jungle?
back_flavor: After hours of exploration and futile attempts to map out the wilds, you're convinced something is watching your progress, stalking your every move. The shapes of large serpentine creatures slither in the brush all around you. You try to back away, but the creatures have you completely surrounded, hissing at you from all sides. Suddenly, several shapes emerge from the brush: human-sized creatures with the bodies of serpents and arms wielding spears and jagged knives. The creatures are savage, attacking you fiercely. Somehow, you manage to flee to safety, though the sensation that you are being watched remains. Although you survive the encounter, you are confronted with a stark reality: this place is home to creatures beyond your understanding.
real_text: [action]: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a connecting location, put it into play and move to it.

name: 침입자
text: [action]: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a connecting location, put it into play and move to it.
back_text: Each investigator is defeated. Each investigator who is not poisoned adds a set-aside Poisoned weakness to his or her deck.
flavor: What was once excitement has turned to dread. This place is far deadlier than you could have imagined. It is as though the jungle itself wants you out.
back_flavor: You find yourself in an endless loop, traversing the same path through the jungle over and over again. No matter which direction you walk, the result is the same. It has been hours, perhaps even days. Meanwhile, you can hear the serpent creatures hissing in the trees, mocking you from afar. Out of food and exhausted from lack of sleep, you collapse against a half-rotted tree. Your vision becomes hazy.
real_text: [action]: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a connecting location, put it into play and move to it.

name: 우림 탐사
text: Objective - When the round ends, investigators at any non-[[Campsite]] locations may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.
back_text:
Put the set-aside Ichtaca enemy into play at the lead investigator's location.
Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck.
flavor: Today, you depart from your camp in order to find the ruins Alejandro seeks. That is, if they even exist…
back_flavor:
As you explore the dense jungle, you are suddenly confronted by several natives. At first glance, they appear to be warriors of an Aztec city-state: perhaps even the one you seek. But how could they have survived undiscovered for this long?
Even with Alejandro's notes, you are barely able to translate what the warriors say, only that they call you "intruder" and implore you to leave the jungle at once. You try to explain that you are searching for the "Eztli," which causes them to murmur and debate among themselves. Finally, one of them speaks to you in rudimentary Spanish. "Ichtaca will know what to do with you, intruder." He blows on a decorated clay ocarina, producing a shrill note that echoes throughout the jungle. The warriors depart as suddenly as they arrived.
real_text: Objective - When the round ends, investigators at any non-[[Campsite]] locations may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.

name: 에스틀리의 사냥꾼
text: Objective - If Ichtaca is defeated, advance. Objective - If there are 1 [per_investigator] clues on Ichtaca, place her in the victory display and advance.
back_text:
If Ichtaca has 1 [per_investigator] clues on her:
"Interesting. You are not simply here to shed blood," Ichtaca says with a spark of wonder in her voice, and you are stunned to hear her speaking in perfect English.
Remember that "Ichtaca is leading the way." Add 1 [cultist] token to the chaos bag for the remainder of the campaign. Shuffle the 3 set-aside [[Ruins]] locations into the exploration deck and advance to Act 3 - "Search for the Ruins."
If you defeated Ichtaca:
"Fools!" Ichtaca shouts to you with a pained voice. "You do not understand the forces you are meddling with. If you truly wish to die, you will find the temple over the river to the south."
Remember that "you fought with Ichtaca." Choose an investigator to take control of the set-aside Alejandro Vela asset. Add 1 [tablet] token to the chaos bag for the remainder of the campaign. Shuffle the 3 set-aside [[Ruins]] locations into the exploration deck and advance to Act 3a - "The Guarded Ruins."
flavor: "I don't trust them," Alejandro says as soon as the natives are out of earshot. "They mean to kill us, not aid us. If you think this 'Ichtaca' is going to help us find the ruins, be my guest. But I refuse to follow where she leads." You can feel the discomfort and confusion in Alejandro's voice. You can attempt to speak with Ichtaca, or you can take Alejandro's advice and fight your way to the ruins you seek.
real_text: Objective - If Ichtaca is defeated, advance. Objective - If there are 1 [per_investigator] clues on Ichtaca, place her in the victory display and advance.

name: 유적을 찾아서
text: Each Eztli Guardian enemy cannot attack or be attacked. Ignore the effects of each Arrows from the Trees treachery. Objective - Only investigators at the Ruins of Eztli can spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.
flavor: "If I cannot dissuade you, so be it. Follow me, and I will lead you to the place you seek. But heed my warning: Disturb the ruins at your own risk. They have remained hidden for a reason." Alejandro warily keeps a safe distance from Ichtaca as she shows you the way.
back_flavor: What you have found is beyond your wildest expectations. Despite their supposed age, the ruins appear preserved in time. Several aspects of the architecture are strangely futuristic. You set out to investigate at once.
real_text: Each Eztli Guardian enemy cannot attack or be attacked. Ignore the effects of each Arrows from the Trees treachery. Objective - Only investigators at the Ruins of Eztli can spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.

name: 보호받는 유적
text: Each Eztli Guardian enemy gets +1 fight and +1 evade. Each Arrows from the Trees treachery gains surge. Objective - Only investigators at the Ruins of Eztli can spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.
flavor: Ichtaca swiftly retreats, and Alejandro places a hand on your shoulder. "Thank you for taking my advice," he says, relieved. "Now that she's gone, I'll take point from now on. I know the river she speaks of. Come, follow me!"
back_flavor: What you have found is beyond your wildest expectations. Despite their supposed age, the ruins appear preserved in time. Several aspects of the architecture are strangely futuristic. You set out to investigate at once.
real_text: Each Eztli Guardian enemy gets +1 fight and +1 evade. Each Arrows from the Trees treachery gains surge. Objective - Only investigators at the Ruins of Eztli can spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.

name: 탐사대 야영지
text: [action]: Resign. The wilds are too dangerous! [action]: Check your supplies. If you have a map, look at the top 3 cards of the exploration deck. Place 1 on the bottom and the other 2 on top, in any order.
flavor: The expedition has staked its claim on the jungle, and the jungle doesn't seem too happy about it.
back_flavor: The camp is abuzz with both excitement and dread. Some members of the expedition are setting up additional canvas tents for supplies, while others are huddled around an incomplete map of the northern edge of the rainforest.
real_text: [action]: Resign. The wilds are too dangerous! [action]: Check your supplies. If you have a map, look at the top 3 cards of the exploration deck. Place 1 on the bottom and the other 2 on top, in any order.

name: 알레한드로 벨라
text:
당신은 [[고대]] 장소를 조사하는 동안 +1 능력값을 얻습니다.
[action] 당신이 [[고대]] 장소에 있다면, ‘알레한드로 벨라’를 소진합니다: 카드를 2장 뽑습니다.
real_text:
You get +1 skill value while investigating an [[Ancient]] location.
[action] If you are at an [[Ancient]] location, exhaust Alejandro Vela: Draw 2 cards.

name: 이츠타카
text: Alert. Retaliate. [action]: Parley. Test [intellect] (4) to convince Ichtaca you are not her enemy. If you succeed, place 1 clue on her. If you fail and Ichtaca is ready, she attacks you.
real_text: Alert. Retaliate. [action]: Parley. Test [intellect] (4) to convince Ichtaca you are not her enemy. If you succeed, place 1 clue on her. If you fail and Ichtaca is ready, she attacks you.

name: 에스틀리의 유적
text: Forced - After you fail a skill test while investigating Ruins of Eztli: Draw the top card of the encounter deck.
flavor: Serpent statues carved from limestone surround the central temple, glaring at you ominously from afar.
real_text: Forced - After you fail a skill test while investigating Ruins of Eztli: Draw the top card of the encounter deck.

name: 에스틀리의 몰락
text:
쉬움 / 보통
[skull]: -1 (당신이 위치한 장소에 파멸이 있다면, -1 대신 -3).
[cultist] 또는 [tablet]: -X. X는 파멸이 올려진 장소의 개수입니다.
[elder_thing]: 다른 혼돈 토큰을 하나 더 공개합니다. 실패하면, 당신이 위치한 장소에 파멸을 1개 올려놓습니다.
back_text:
어려움 / 전문가
[skull]: -2 (당신이 위치한 장소에 파멸이 있다면, -2 대신 -4).
[cultist] [tablet]: -X. X는 플레이 상태인 모든 장소에 놓인 파멸 개수 총합입니다.
[elder_thing]: 다른 혼돈 토큰을 하나 더 공개합니다. 당신이 위치한 장소에 파멸을 1개 올려놓습니다.
real_text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -1 (-3 instead if there is doom on your location).
[cultist] [tablet]: -X. X is the number of locations with doom on them.
[elder_thing]: Reveal another chaos token. If you fail, place 1 doom on your location.

name: 뭔가가 움직인다…
text: *This agenda gets +1 [per_investigator] doom threshold. Forced - When this agenda advances: Do not remove doom from each location in play.
back_text: Spawn the set-aside Harbinger of Valusia at the location with the most doom.
flavor: Despite Ichtaca's warnings, you've entered the ruins of the temple in search of ancient knowledge and artifacts.
back_flavor: Just then, a sound thrums in the walls of the temple, a dull humming similar to that of a generator. Grooves in the walls and the ceiling flicker and start to glow. It is as though the temple is alive, and it senses your presence. The strange statues and carvings you've seen, coupled with the dim glow and the power coursing through the walls, makes it clear that this temple isn't Aztec in origin. In fact, it appears to be from an even older, more ancient civilization altogether. You feel as though you are an intruder in a world you cannot begin to understand. Confirming your worst fears, a loud hiss and rattling echoes throughout the temple. Whatever you just woke up, it's not happy to see you.
real_text: *This agenda gets +1 [per_investigator] doom threshold. Forced - When this agenda advances: Do not remove doom from each location in play.

name: 사원의 감시자
text: *This agenda gets +1 [per_investigator] doom threshold.
back_text: Each investigator who has not resigned is defeated.
flavor: The serpent creature emerges from the shadows with terrifying speed. It is bedecked in ornate gold feathers, and it wields a golden spear, the blade tip unravaged by time. The rattle at the end of the creature's tail produces a tremendous noise as the creature hunts you throughout the ruins.
back_flavor: The ruins groan and shake with anger. You are not wanted here. The walls and ceiling shift erratically, blocking off corridors and attempting to prevent your escape. Grooves in the stone are now glowing a vibrant red hue. A sinister hiss follows you throughout the temple. The realization dawns on you that you are not making it out of this place alive…
real_text: *This agenda gets +1 [per_investigator] doom threshold.

name: 유적 안으로
text: [action]: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a connecting location, put it into play and move to it.
back_text:
Shuffle the set-aside Chamber of Time location into the exploration deck.
As you pass the strange glyphs in the walls, the ruins groan and creak in protest, and the carvings glow ominously. Years of deterioration have faded the pattern of these glyphs, and the surrounding stones seep with a venomous pus. If only you had some way to restore these glyphs…
Check your supplies. If any investigator has chalk, remove this act from the game. Otherwise, place this act in the victory display. It gains Vengeance 1.
flavor: After your hellish journey through the jungle, the quiet solitude of the temple ruins sows paranoia in your mind. Serpent eyes glare at you from the darkness. Every drop of water and fallen pebble causes you to whirl about in search of danger… But the real danger is yet to come.
back_flavor: The ruins are far more vast than even Alejandro had anticipated. Carvings in the walls and hieroglyphs etched into stone altars suggest the existence of a central chamber underground. Perhaps a hidden passageway will show you the way to this chamber - the very heart of the temple ruins.
real_text: [action]: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a connecting location, put it into play and move to it.

name: 마법과 과학
text: [action]: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a connecting location, put it into play and move to it. Objective - Only investigators in the Chamber of Time may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.
back_text: Choose an investigator in the Chamber of Time to take control of the Relic of Ages. Move the placement of each location to form a straight line, with the Chamber of Time on the left and the Entryway on the right. Each other location is placed from left to right in between these two locations, in order of how much doom is on them, from lowest to highest (in the event of a tie, you may decide the order). Until the end of the scenario, ignore all location connections. Instead, each location is connected to each location to its left and right.
flavor: Whatever is inside this central chamber must be very important; much care was taken to obscure its location.
back_flavor: The relic hums with power and throbs in your hands. Energy from the device seeps into the corridors of the ruins, and the structure of the temple shifts.
real_text: [action]: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a connecting location, put it into play and move to it. Objective - Only investigators in the Chamber of Time may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.

name: 유적을 탈출하라
text: While there are 3 or more vengeance points in the victory display, each [[Serpent]] enemy gets +1 evade. Objective - If each undefeated investigator has resigned, advance.
back_text:
If an investigator resigned with the Relic of Ages under his or her control:
The floor of the temple stops shaking, and the dull humming in the walls goes quiet. Without the relic in its chamber, the ruins appear to be sleeping once more. You still have no idea what the object is or what its purpose may be, but you dare not tarry any longer to find out.
(→R1)
Otherwise:
For a moment, the temple continues to shudder, the architecture twisting and contorting strangely. Pleased that it is once again whole, the temple then returns to its dormant state.
(→R3)
flavor: The ruins are shuddering with a tremendous power. You fear that the structure may collapse if this keeps up. You have to escape with the relic!
back_flavor: As soon as you cross the threshold of the entryway, something inside the temple begins to change…
real_text: While there are 3 or more vengeance points in the victory display, each [[Serpent]] enemy gets +1 evade. Objective - If each undefeated investigator has resigned, advance.

name: 사원 진입로
text: [action]: Resign. You've escaped… for now. [action]: Check your supplies. If you have torches, look at the top 2 cards of the exploration deck. Discard each treachery looked at by this effect. Shuffle the exploration deck.
flavor: Many hundreds of years ago, this temple might have been a bastion of beauty and reverence in this perilous jungle.
back_flavor: The sun sets over the temple ruins, bathing the stone in warm light. The sounds of the rainforest are distant by the time you cross underneath the painted entryway. Inside, the halls are plunged into darkness.
real_text: [action]: Resign. You've escaped… for now. [action]: Check your supplies. If you have torches, look at the top 2 cards of the exploration deck. Discard each treachery looked at by this effect. Shuffle the exploration deck.

name: 시대의 유물
flavor: 이 유물의 정체가 무엇인지, 어디에다 쓰는 것인지 짐작도 가지 않습니다. 하지만 시간을 들여 살펴본다면 유물이 만들어진 진정한 목적을 밝혀낼 수 있을 겁니다.

name: 발루시아의 선봉장
text: Alert. Hunter. Retaliate. Harbinger of Valusia can retaliate while exhausted. Forced - After Harbinger of Valusia is successfully attacked or evaded: Place 1 resource on it. Then, if there are 2 [per_investigator] resources on it, it vanishes with a sinister hiss. (Set it aside, out of play. It keeps all damage tokens.)
real_text: Alert. Hunter. Retaliate. Harbinger of Valusia can retaliate while exhausted. Forced - After Harbinger of Valusia is successfully attacked or evaded: Place 1 resource on it. Then, if there are 2 [per_investigator] resources on it, it vanishes with a sinister hiss. (Set it aside, out of play. It keeps all damage tokens.)

name: 고대의 전당
text: Forced - At the end of the round: Flip 1 of the clues on Ancient Hall to its doom side. Any investigator at Ancient Hall may spend 3 resources to cancel this effect.

text: [action]: Resign. You don't want to risk taking too long, so you head to safety with the information you've gathered.

If there are only 2 act decks in play, place 1 doom on agenda 2a as it is revealed.
flavor: You have three tasks before you and a limited amount of time before the trail goes cold. Where do you search first?
back_flavor: The town is bustling as noon comes and goes. University students travel from class to class, businesspeople take breaks from their busy office lives, and in Easttown, Velma's Diner is abuzz with the lunch rush. Despite this veil of normality, the curtain has been lifted. You see this town for what it really is: an endless mire of secrets.

flavor: This conspiracy runs much deeper than you had imagined. The more time you spend investigating these mysteries, the more you come to realize they are linked to one another. At the center of these secrets is an enigmatic organization, manipulating events behind the scenes...
back_flavor: The streets begin to empty as evening approaches. When the office buildings shut their doors, the clubs open theirs, in places both public and hidden from view. In downtown Arkham, the Ward Theatre is well lit and filled to capacity. The surrounding streets, however, are eerily quiet. Only soft footsteps from nearby alleyways hint at any sign of life, and a cold wind whistles through the air. The workday might have ended, but your work is far from over. The figures walking down the street start to fill you with a sense of dread instead of comfort.
real_text: [action]: Resign. You don't want to risk taking too long, so you head to safety with the information you've gathered.

flavor: Who can you trust in this city of lies? Arkham may be safe from the perils of the jungle, but you are far from safe here. Each passing stranger in the dark of night could be a kidnapper, a thief, or a killer. Each glance they send your way could be the last thing you ever see.
back_flavor: Midnight arrives, but your work is not done. You wander the streets of Arkham for hours, frustrated as the trails you have pursued grow cold over time. When the sun rises, fatigue has wreaked havoc on your body and mind.

flavor: One of the museum security guards, a man named Drew Walker, recognizes you from your prior work with Alejandro and Dr. Horowitz. "Look, I ain’t supposed to be letting anybody into the exhibit... But the coppers don’t know from nothing when it comes to this hokum." He steps aside and lets you pass. "If anybody asks, you slipped in while I was using the john, all right? Don’t take any wooden nickels."
back_flavor: You search the exhibit where the relic was to be on display, looking for signs of where it may have been taken. Though you find no concrete evidence, on the ground near the exhibit entrance, you do notice several recent scuff marks made by men's shoes. You ask Drew who was last to see the exhibit after Alejandro left. "Some suits. Government types," he replies. "They had clearing to see the exhibit from Mr. Walsted, the curator." It's far from proof of the relic's location, but it's a lead - hopefully one that will point you in the right direction.

You search the exhibit where the relic was to be on display, looking for signs of where it may have been taken. As you search, you notice a shadow crawling along the wall. It quickly flits out of sight, and heavy footsteps echo through the halls beyond the gallery. Could it be that the culprit is still here?
You give chase, but the hooded figure has a lead on you and quickly escapes from the museum. At least now you have a trail to follow - and you won't stop until the relic is yours again.

He had no choice but to tell them the truth - that he'd brought the relic to the Curiositie Shoppe and gave it to one of his associates. If the Relic of Ages is attached to the Town Hall:
After an hour of searching Arkham's Town Hall, you notice a faint blue glow emanating from underneath the door to the city planner's office. You break into the office without being noticed. The relic is lying on his desk, along with a map of the city that is covered in strange markings and iconography. Why is it here?
The investigator nearest to the Town Hall takes control of the Relic of Ages. Remove the remainder of the "a/b" act deck from the game. If another act card is in play, continue playing. Otherwise, proceed to (→R1).

The investigator nearest to the Brotherhood Cultist's location takes control of the Relic of Ages. Remove the remainder of the "a/b" act deck from the game. If another act card is in play, continue playing. Otherwise, proceed to (→R1).

Harlan snaps out of his daze and collapses, holding his head in pain. "What was I - ?" His eyes widen as he realizes what he has done, and he pulls the relic out of his coat, offering it to you. "T-take it!" He says. "You can keep it safer than I can."

"Don't know why he and Alejandro would ever be in the same room without my knowing - but last time I saw Alejandro, that's right where he was: walking down the hall with my boss, flanked by a couple of intimidating fellas in black suits." He gets up and puts on his coat, leaving two quarters on the table. "You didn't hear this from me," he insists before departing.

앨리스가 묻자 고양이가 답했다.
“그야 당연하지. 아니면 어떻게 여기 있겠어?”
- 루이스 캐럴, “이상한 나라의 앨리스”

You notice that the wall between the guest bedroom and the bathroom is rotted and stained with what appears to be old blood. With no other way to proceed, you have no choice but to bust through the weak, rotted wall.

name: 박살난 경계
back_text:
Check Campaign Log. If the Harbinger is still alive:
Following no telltale flash of light, a sudden explosion of thunder blasts across the sky, causing you to jump in shock. As though drawn from the sound, a streak of silver lightning crashes down from the clouds, ripping a tear in the world before you. Through this tear, a familiar creature emerges. It hisses in anger and raises its gilded spear to attack.
Search the collection for the Harbinger of Valusia and spawn it at the location farthest from all investigators (if there are 6 or more tally marks under "Yig's Fury" in your Campaign Log, it enters play at the lead investigator's location, instead). It enters play with damage on it equal to the amount of damage recorded in parentheses in your Campaign Log.
flavor:
Ichtaca is already up and about when you awaken, donning her traditional armor, her bow on her back and a long blade at her side. "Something is wrong," she states cryptically. "I only meant to peer through the boundary…"
Her eyes are bloodshot, her face pale as a ghost. You suspect she hasn’t slept all night. "It matters not. It is time you witnessed the fate that will befall humanity if we fail."

name: 방벽이 얇아졌다
back_text:
Find each [[Tenochtitlán]] location in play with no clues on it. Add those locations to the victory display. Then, for each [[Present-Day]] location in play, search the exploration deck for a location with a matching location symbol in the upper-left corner and place it on top of that location, taking its place.
Each investigator loses each of his or her clues.
Spawn the set-aside Padma Amrita enemy in Templo Mayor.
Remove the current act deck from the game. Put the set-aside act 3a and agenda 3a into play as the current act and agenda.
flavor: Ichtaca’s strength continues to wane as you journey through the strange vision. You’ve never seen her this troubled. She is often distracted, peering about as though any moment the answer will appear before her. From time to time, she mutters strange phrases to herself: "…How could this have happened?…The answer will be with the ancients…Someone else is here, I know it…"
back_flavor: The silver flashes of lightning become more frequent, and the sky starts to split open. Thunder rumbles in the distance, and you watch as the skylines of both cities - the Present-Day city and its ancient predecessor - are consumed in a giant stone maw. Six pillars surround the cavernous opening, each glowing vibrantly. A red hue erupts from the center of the opening, and the ground shakes with the force of an earthquake. "We've seen enough. We must get out of here while we still can!" Ichtaca shouts. For the first time since meeting her, you hear a telltale trembling in her voice.

name: 붕괴되어가는 시간
flavor: Alejandro’s former critic stands atop the steps of the main temple, her true self revealed to you. Silver streaks of lightning wind through her open arms. Coiled about her feet is an army of hissing cobras. "Only the chosen can find the Nexus! Only I am worthy!"
back_flavor: "Perhaps an eternity or two will quell your foolish desire to find the truth." Padma's laugh echoes across the sky as she steps through the rift atop the temple. "Not that it matters much. Your kind will not be on this Earth much longer…" She vanishes without a trace. You ask Ichtaca what your next course of action should be, but she too is gone. The storm suddenly quiets, and you are left in deafening silence.

text: Objective - After the first [[Tenochtitlán]] location enters play by exploring successfully, advance.
back_text: The investigator who just put a [[Tenochtitlán]] location into play by exploring successfully must test [willpower] (4). If he or she fails, he or she must search the collection for a random basic [[Madness]] or [[Injury]] weakness and shuffle it into his or her deck. (Note: Be aware that location connections are different on [[Tenochtitlán]] locations.)
flavor:
As you depart the hotel, you realize that the landscape of the city has been altered. Silver lightning crackles in the sky overhead, and the earth rumbles deep below your feet. Monstrous, polypous entities float just below the clouds. "What is going on?" you yell to Ichtaca over the whistling wind. "What is this place?"
"One future," she replies enigmatically.
back_flavor: In the distance, light seeps through a wide crack in the ground. As you approach it, you realize the chasm is not natural at all. Below, you see the sky, as if you were peering into a reflection of the clouds above. Wisps of grey smoke emerge from the chasm, giving off a familiar bittersweet scent. You step through and resist the urge to vomit as the world spins upside-down. When you open your eyes again, you are in another place. Not somewhere, but some<u>when</u>.

flavor: Is this real, or a vision? Either way, the secrets of the ancients may hold the key to finding the Nexus of N’kai…
back_flavor: The silver flashes of lightning become more frequent, and the sky starts to split open. Thunder rumbles in the distance, and you watch as the skylines of both cities - the present-day city and its ancient predecessor - are consumed in a giant stone maw. Six pillars surround the cavernous opening, each glowing vibrantly. A red hue erupts from the center of the opening, and the ground shakes with the force of an earthquake. "We've seen enough. We must get out of here while we still can!" Ichtaca shouts. For the first time since meeting her, you hear trembling in her voice.

"No! You fools!" Padma drops to her knees, bleeding out from her wounds. She looks up into Ichtaca's eyes, pleading with her. "How could you - ?" "No! Come back here!" Padma screams as soon as she figures out your plan. "You can't leave me here! I have been chosen!" Ichtaca looks back at her with a pitying glance. You shake off your fear and step through the rift.
(→R1)

[action]: 활시위에 화살을 맵니다. ‘화려한 활’에 탄약을 1발 올려놓습니다.

text: [action]: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a connecting location, put it into play and move to it.
back_text:
Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck.
The lead investigator chooses one investigator to be the group's lookout. That investigator checks his or her supplies. 
If the lookout has binoculars, he or she is able to see the creature approaching and avoid it. The lookout suffers no ill effects.
If the lookout does not have binoculars, discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until an enemy is discarded. Spawn that enemy at the lookout's location.
flavor: You are deep in the jungle now, surrounded on all sides by the uncharted wilderness. All around you, the rainforest sings, its lyrics found in every chirping insect, every serpent’s hiss, every snapping tree branch.
back_flavor: After exploring the rainforest for hours, you reach the top of a steep ridge, from which you can see much of the surrounding area. Uncanny winged creatures caw at you from above, circling over the cavern entrance like vultures waiting for their meal. From this vantage point, you may be able to see approaching threats as they traverse the brush below. If only you had something to help you see farther…
real_text: [action]: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a connecting location, put it into play and move to it.

name: 해가 저물어가다
text: [action]: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a connecting location, put it into play and move to it.
back_text: Each surviving investigator immediately resigns.
flavor: The day advances quickly. Through the thick canopy of trees, you can tell that the sun is starting to sink closer to the horizon. To the east, the sky grows dim. Soon the jungle will be covered in darkness, and you will have to stop and make camp for the night.
back_flavor:
Night comes swiftly, blanketing the rainforest in dim moonlight. The sounds of the jungle change as nocturnal creatures start to emerge. Soon, the air is filled with the buzzing and chirping of strange insects and even stranger beasts, the identity of which you are unable to determine.
The dangers of nighttime are too great to ignore, and the darkness makes it difficult for you to study the glyphs and patterns necessary to shift the pillars correctly. You have no choice but to set up camp and continue your exploration in the morning.
real_text: [action]: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a connecting location, put it into play and move to it.

name: 패턴을 찾아서
flavor: Six stone pillars surround the entrance to the cavern, each carved with a series of uncanny grooves and hieroglyphs that form an intricate pattern. Touching them causes the grooves to glow brightly, and twisting them causes the patterns to shift and change. Perhaps these patterns match the glyphs found in other regions of the jungle?

name: 날개 돋친 뱀
text: Spawn - Mouth of K'n-yan. Alert. Hunter. Massive. Cannot be defeated. Cannot make attacks of opportunity. Forced - After a pillar token is placed on the Mouth of K'n-yan: Exhaust The Winged Serpent. It does not ready during the upkeep phase this round.

name: 아가리를 열어젖히다
text: [action] Investigators at the Mouth of K'n-yan spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: You solve one piece of the puzzle. Add 1 resource to the Mouth of K'n-yan, as a pillar token. Objective - Solve the puzzle of the six pillars in order to enter K'n-yan. If there are 6 pillar tokens on the Mouth of K'n-yan, advance to act 2b.
flavor: You have discovered that the ruins within the jungle each bear a distinct pattern of glyphs, which match those found on the six pillars. As you turn the pillars to match these patterns, a serpentine creature descends from the clouds…
back_flavor: With a deep rumbling that shakes the ground outside, something inside the cavern shifts. In a distinct sequence, the six obelisks slowly descend into the ground, twisting and turning. The serpent creature that guarded the cavern lets out a shriek of anger and hate before flying off and vanishing behind the treeline. One by one, the stone pillars disappear into the dirt, and the Earth stops shaking.

name: 쓸쓸한 동굴
text: [action] If there are no clues on your location: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a connecting location, put it into play and move to it. Forced - When this agenda advances: Do not remove doom from each location in play.
back_text:
Check Campaign Log. If the Harbinger is still alive:
From the entrance far behind you, a threatening hiss and an all-too-familiar rattling causes you to freeze in terror. You grip the nearest weapon you can find and turn in fright, hands trembling. How has it followed you this far? When will this awful hunt end?
Search the collection for the Harbinger of Valusia and spawn it at the location farthest from all investigators (if there are 8 or more tally marks under "Yig's Fury" in your Campaign Log, it enters play at the lead investigator's location, instead). It enters play with damage on it equal to the amount of damage recorded in parentheses in your Campaign Log.
flavor: Though much of this cavern system is natural and untouched by humans, you are stunned to find signs of an ancient civilization that once inhabited the area.
real_text: [action] If there are no clues on your location: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a connecting location, put it into play and move to it. Forced - When this agenda advances: Do not remove doom from each location in play.

name: 어둠 속의 눈동자
text: [action] If there are no clues on your location: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a connecting location, put it into play and move to it. *This agenda gets +1 [per_investigator] doom threshold.
back_text: Each surviving investigator is defeated and suffers 1 physical trauma.
flavor: Bright-yellow eyes peer at you from all sides as you continue delving deeper into the cavern. The glowing orbs vanish as light is cast on them, reappearing as soon as the darkness returns.
back_flavor: Without warning, a deafening crash echoes throughout the cave, and the ground under your feet rumbles with tremendous force. Stalactites and pieces of crumbling rock begin to fall from the ceiling of the cavern, striking the ground all around you and causing cracks to appear in the stone. "We have to get out of here!" you shout to Ichtaca, but by the time you realize what is coming, it is too late. The ground beneath your feet gives way, and suddenly you are falling, plummeting into the depths below…

name: 잊힌 시대의 동굴
back_text: Shuffle Descent to Yoth into the exploration deck. The lead investigator chooses one investigator to be the group's scout. That investigator checks his or her supplies. If the scout has chalk, you are able to avoid traveling in circles. The scout suffers no ill effects. If the scout does not have chalk, place 1 clue on each location in play (from the token pool). Then, if the scout is on a single-sided location, shuffle that location back into the exploration deck. Move each enemy and investigator that was at that location to a connecting location nearest to the Mouth of K'n-yan.
flavor: The vast underground caverns of K’n-yan are cold and all too quiet. Scattered, forsaken ruins lie undisturbed along your path to the Nexus of N’kai. What happened in this ancient and forgotten place? Were these ruins once occupied by humans? Or by a species far, far older?
back_flavor: With very few landmarks to spot along the dark and lonely tunnels, you must rely on your wits and navigation skills to make your way forward without getting lost. If only you had an easy way to mark the places you have already visited…

flavor: The deeper you descend into the cold darkness, the more you feel the crushing weight of the world above, and the dizzying reality of the world further below. You suddenly long for the surface and wonder if you will ever see the sky again.
back_flavor: Before you lies an ornate and elaborately decorated doorway, a stone disc that has been rolled aside to unveil the hellish realm beyond. The caverns on the other side are bathed in a red glow. The serpent-themed statues and carvings along the walls inform you that you are on the right track.
