text:
당신은 ‘수단 정당화’를 아무 종류의 능력 테스트에 소모해도 됩니다.
‘수단 정당화’를 능력 테스트에 소모하기 위한 추가 비용으로, 이번 테스트의 난이도만큼 혼돈 주머니에 [curse] 토큰을 추가합니다.
이번 테스트가 자동 성공합니다.
real_text:
You may commit Justify the Means to any type of test.
As an additional cost to commit Justify the Means to a skill test, add [curse] tokens to the chaos bag equal to this test's difficulty.
This test automatically succeeds.

name: 행운의 주사위
text:
특별.
[reaction] 당신이 혼돈 토큰을 공개할 때, 그 토큰이 [curse] 도 [auto_fail] 도 아니라면, 혼돈 주머니에 [curse] 토큰을 1개 추가합니다: 방금 공개한 혼돈 토큰을 무시하고 다른 혼돈 토큰을 하나 더 공개하여 해결합니다. 새로 공개한 혼돈 토큰이 [curse] 또는 [auto_fail] 기호면, ‘행운의 주사위’를 당신의 손으로 가져옵니다(이는 무시/취소할 수 없습니다).
real_text:
Exceptional.
[reaction] When you reveal a non-[curse], non-[auto_fail] chaos token, add 1 [curse] token to the chaos bag: Ignore the just revealed chaos token and reveal another one to resolve. If that token has a [curse] or [auto_fail] symbol, return Lucky Dice to your hand (cannot be ignored/canceled).

name: 실험실 조교
text:
당신이 손에 들 수 있는 카드 장수 제한이 2만큼 늘어납니다.
[reaction] ‘실험실 조교’가 플레이 영역에 들어온 후: 카드를 2장 뽑습니다.
real_text:
Your maximum hand size is increased by 2.
[reaction] After Laboratory Assistant enters play: Draw 2 cards.

name: 터무니없는 밑그림
text:
당신이 위치한 장소에 단서가 있을 경우에만 플레이할 수 있습니다.
카드를 3장 뽑습니다.
real_text:
Play only if there is a clue on your location.
Draw 3 cards.

name: 추론
text: 이번 능력 테스트가 성공하고 그것이 장소 조사라면, 그 장소에서 추가로 단서를 1개 더 발견합니다.
flavor: 이 상징을 이전에 본 적이 있는데‧‧‧ 더 늦기 전에 다른 사람들에게 알려줘야 해!
real_text: If this skill test is successful while investigating a location, discover 1 additional clue at that location.

name: 의식용 초
text: [reaction] 당신이 테스트를 수행하는 동안 [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing] 기호가 공개된 후: 이번 테스트에 +1 능력값을 얻습니다.
flavor: 밀랍 양초의 불이 스산하게 빛나고, 불길은 살아 있는 듯이 움직였다.
real_text: [reaction] After a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], or [elder_thing] symbol is revealed during a test you are performing: You get +1 skill value for this test.

name: 유체 이탈
text: 이동. 아무 공개된 장소 한 곳으로 이동하고 혼돈 주머니에서 무작위 토큰을 1개 공개합니다. [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], [auto_fail] 기호가 공개되면, 당신은 자신이 조종하는 [[물품]] 또는 [[조력자]] 자산을 하나 버려야 합니다(그렇게 할 수 없다면, 피해를 1 받습니다).
flavor: 차원을 넘어선 이동에는 위험이 따른다는 것쯤은 그도 잘 압니다. 그렇다 한들, 시공을 뛰어넘는 흥미진진한 능력을 거부할 사람이 어디 있겠습니까?
real_text: Move. Move to any revealed location and reveal a random token from the chaos bag. If you reveal a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol, you must discard an [[Item]] or [[Ally]] asset you control (if you cannot, take 1 damage).

name: 최면을 거는 시선
text:
신속. 적 하나가 당신이 위치한 장소에 있는 조사자 한 명을 공격할 때 플레이할 수 있습니다.
그 공격을 취소합니다. 그런 다음, 혼돈 주머니에서 무작위 토큰을 1개 공개합니다. [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], [auto_fail] 기호가 공개되면, 공격한 적의 피해를 공격한 적 자신에게 줍니다.
real_text:
Fast. Play when an enemy attacks an investigator at your location.
Cancel that attack. Then, reveal a random token from the chaos bag. If it has a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol, deal the attacking enemy's damage to itself.

name: 어두운 예언
text:
신속. 당신이 혼돈 토큰을 공개하려 할 때 플레이할 수 있습니다.
1개의 혼돈 토큰을 대신하여 5개의 혼돈 토큰을 공개합니다. 이렇게 공개한 혼돈 토큰 가운데서 [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], [auto_fail] 중 하나를 선택해서 해결하고, 나머지는 모두 무시합니다. (이러한 토큰이 하나도 공개되지 않았다면, 공개한 토큰 중 1개를 선택해서 해결하고, 나머지는 모두 무시합니다.)
flavor: 별들 사이에 비밀이 쓰여 있나니.
real_text:
Fast. Play when you would reveal a chaos token.
Reveal 5 chaos tokens instead of 1. Choose one of those tokens with a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol to resolve, and ignore the rest. (If no such token is revealed, choose any one of those tokens to resolve, and ignore the rest.)

name: 저항
text: 이번 능력 테스트에서 혼돈 토큰을 공개하기 전, 다음 기호 중 하나를 선택합니다([skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing]). 이번 테스트 동안 선택한 기호의 효과를 무시합니다(보정값도 무시합니다).
flavor: “안 돼.”
real_text: Before revealing chaos tokens for this test, choose one of the following symbols: ([skull], [cultist], [tablet], or [elder_thing]). Ignore the effects of the chosen symbol during this test (including its modifier).

name: 체력 단련
text:
[free] 자원을 1개 소비합니다: 당신은 이번 능력 테스트에서 +1 [willpower]를 얻습니다.
[free] 자원을 1개 소비합니다: 당신은 이번 능력 테스트에서 +1 [combat]을 얻습니다.
real_text:
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [willpower] for this skill test.
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [combat] for this skill test.

name: 재빨리 피하다
text:
신속. 적 하나가 당신이 위치한 장소에 있는 조사자 한 명을 공격할 때 플레이할 수 있습니다.
그 공격을 취소합니다.
real_text:
Fast. Play when an enemy attacks an investigator at your location.
Cancel that attack.

name: 무자비한 일격
text: 이번 능력 테스트가 성공하고 그것이 공격이라면, 이번 공격은 +1 피해를 줍니다.
flavor: 끔찍한 타격음과 함께, 그는 이 혐오스러운 괴물이 움직이지 않을 때까지 때리고 때리고 또 때렸다.
real_text: If this skill test is successful during an attack, that attack deals +1 damage.

name: 접이식 칼
text: 신속. [action]: 전투. 난이도보다 2 이상 높은 차이로 능력 테스트에 성공하면, 이번 공격은 +1 피해를 줍니다.
real_text: Fast. [action]: Fight. If you succeed by 2 or more, this attack deals +1 damage.

name: 행운의 담뱃갑
text: [reaction] 당신이 난이도를 넘어선 차이 2 이상으로 성공한 후, ‘행운의 담뱃갑’을 소진합니다: 카드를 1장 뽑습니다.
flavor: “행운이란 게 뭐 별건가. 담배 한 대 딱 피우기 좋은 그런 거지.”
real_text: [reaction] After you succeed at a skill test by 2 or more, exhaust Lucky Cigarette Case: Draw 1 card.

name: 비겁한 싸움
text: 전투. 이번 공격에서 당신의 능력값에 당신의 [agility] 값을 추가합니다. 난이도를 넘어선 차이 2 이상으로 성공하면, 공격당한 적을 자동으로 회피합니다.
flavor: 그들이 내게 가르쳐 주었다. “눈을 노려라.”
real_text: Fight. Add your [agility] value to your skill value for this attack. If you succeed by 2 or more, automatically evade the attacked enemy.

name: 대담한 방책
text:
신속. 당신이 능력 테스트에서 성공하려 할 때 플레이할 수 있습니다.
당신은 이번 능력 테스트에서 +2 능력값을 얻습니다.
flavor:
“맥글렌, 우릴 둘 다 죽일 셈이야?”
“아니, 친구. 일단 지금은 아니야.”
real_text:
Fast. Play when you would succeed at a skill test.
You get +2 skill value for this test.

name: 몰래 빠져나오기
text: 회피. 이번 회피 시도에서 당신의 능력값에 당신의 [intellect] 값을 추가합니다. 회피한 적이 [[정예]]가 아니고 난이도를 넘어선 차이 2 이상으로 성공하면, 그 적은 다음 정리 단계 동안 준비 상태가 되지 않습니다.
real_text: Evade. Add your [intellect] to your skill value for this evasion attempt. If you succeed by 2 or more and the evaded enemy is non-[[Elite]], it does not ready during the next upkeep phase.

name: 기회주의자
text:
당신이 수행하는 능력 테스트에서만 소모할 수 있습니다.
난이도보다 3 이상 높은 차이로 능력 테스트에 성공하면, 이 테스트가 끝난 후 ‘기회주의자’ 카드를 버리는 대신 당신의 손으로 가져옵니다.
real_text:
Commit only to a skill test you are performing.
If you succeed by 3 or more, return Opportunist to your hand after this test instead of discarding it.

name: 무기 마법 부여
text: 당신이 위치한 장소에 있는 조사자 한 명이 조종하는 [[무기]] 자산 하나에 부착합니다. 자산당 1장 한정. 부착된 자산은 [[유물]] 특성을 획득하고, (기존 슬롯에 추가로) 마법 슬롯을 1칸 차지합니다. [reaction] 당신이 부착된 자산을 사용하여 전투 행동을 실시할 때, 이 카드를 소진합니다: 이번 공격에서 당신의 [combat]에, 이 카드 소유자의 [willpower]를 추가합니다. 이번 공격은 +1 피해를 줍니다.
real_text: Attach to a [[Weapon]] asset controlled by an investigator at your location. Limit 1 per asset. Attached asset gains the [[Relic]] trait and takes up an arcane slot in addition to its other slots. [reaction] When you perform a Fight action using attached asset, exhaust this card: Add the owner of this card's [willpower] to your [combat] for this attack. This attack deals +1 damage.

name: 금칙의 서약
text: 특별. 당신은 +1 [willpower], +1 [intellect], +1 [combat], +1 [agility]을 얻습니다. 강제 - ‘금칙의 서약’이 플레이 영역에 들어온 후: 다음과 같이 서약을 합니다. “나는 매번 내 차례 동안 (카드 뽑기/플레이/소모 중 하나)를 하지 않겠습니다.” ‘금칙의 서약’이 플레이 상태인 동안, 당신이 이 서약을 깬다면, ‘금칙의 서약’을 버리고 혼돈 주머니에 [curse] 토큰을 10개 추가합니다.
real_text: Exceptional. You get +1 [willpower], +1 [intellect], +1 [combat], and +1 [agility]. Forced - After Geas enters play: Make a promise using the following formula - "I shall not (draw/play/commit) any cards during each of my turns." If you break this promise while Geas is in play, discard it and add 10 [curse] tokens to the chaos bag.

name: 역경
text:
사용(자원 2개). 매 라운드 시작에, 이 카드에 놓인 자원이 2개가 되도록 보충합니다.
[free] 당신의 자원 저장소 또는 ‘역경’에서 자원을 1개 소비합니다: 당신은 이번 능력 테스트에서 +1 [combat] 또는 +1 [agility]을 얻습니다.
real_text:
Uses (2 resources). Replenish these resources at the start of each round.
[fast] Spend 1 resource from your resource pool or from Hard Knocks: You get +1 [combat] or +1 [agility] for this skill test.

name: 이키아크
text:
당신은 +1 [willpower]와 +1 [intellect]을 얻습니다. 당신은 ‘이키아크’ 밑에 놓인 약점마다 -1 [willpower]와 -1 [intellect]을 얻습니다.
[reaction] 당신이 위치한 장소에 있는 조사자 한 명이 기본 약점을 1장 뽑았을 때, ‘이키아크’를 소진합니다: 그 약점의 효과를 취소하고 그 약점을 ‘이키아크’ 밑에 뒷면으로 놓습니다. ‘이키아크’가 플레이 영역에서 나가면, 이 카드 밑에 있는 각 약점의 소유자는 해당 약점을 뽑아야 합니다.
real_text:
You get +1 [willpower] and +1 [intellect]. You get -1 [willpower] and -1 [intellect] for each weakness beneath Ikiaq.
[reaction] When an investigator at your location draws a basic weakness, exhaust Ikiaq: Cancel that weakness's effects and place it facedown beneath Ikiaq. Its owner must draw it if Ikiaq leaves play.

name: 불안한 평화
text:
‘불안한 평화’를 플레이하기 위한 추가 비용으로, 혼돈 주머니 그리고/또는 플레이 상태인 카드에 봉인된 [bless] 토큰을 도합 5개 찾아서 토큰 저장소로 되돌려 놓습니다.
신속. 신화 단계의 “1.4 모든 조사자는 조우 카드를 1장씩 뽑습니다” 과정을 시작하려 할 때 플레이할 수 있습니다. 이번 신화 단계의 해당 과정을 건너뜁니다.
real_text:
As an additional cost to play A Watchful Peace, search the chaos bag and/or cards in play for a total of 5 [bless] tokens and return them to the token pool.
Fast. Play when the "draw encounter cards" step of the mythos phase would begin.
Skip this step of the mythos phase.

name: 깊이 파고들다
text:
사용(자원 2개). 매 라운드 시작에, 이 카드에 놓인 자원이 2개가 되도록 보충합니다.
[free] 당신의 자원 저장소 또는 ‘깊이 파고들다’에서 자원을 1개 소비합니다: 당신은 이번 능력 테스트에서 +1 [willpower] 또는 +1 [agility]을 얻습니다.
real_text:
Uses (2 resources). Replenish these resources at the start of each round.
[fast] Spend 1 resource from your resource pool or from Dig Deep: You get +1 [willpower] or +1 [agility] for this skill test.

name: 태양의 가호
text:
신속. 봉인([bless] 토큰 최대 3개까지). ‘태양의 가호’에 봉인된 토큰이 없다면, 이 카드를 버립니다.
[reaction] 당신이 혼돈 주머니에서 혼돈 토큰 하나를 공개하려 할 때, ‘태양의 가호’를 소진합니다: 그 대신 이 카드에 봉인된 토큰 하나를 방금 혼돈 주머니에서 공개한 것처럼 간주하여 해결합니다.
real_text:
Fast. Seal (up to 3 [bless]). If there are no tokens sealed on Favor of the Sun, discard it.
[reaction] When you would reveal a chaos token from the chaos bag, exhaust Favor of the Sun: Resolve a token sealed here instead, as if it were just revealed from the chaos bag.

name: 공포의 추격전
text:
쉬움 / 보통
[skull]: -1(도로 덱에 남은 카드가 6장 이하라면, -1 대신 -3).
[cultist]: -1. 실패하면, 난이도에 모자란 차이마다, 당신의 탑승물에 있는 조사자 한 명은 자신이 가진 단서 1개를 당신이 위치한 장소에 놓습니다.
[tablet]: -2. 실패하면, 난이도에 모자란 차이마다, 당신의 탑승물에 있는 조사자 한 명은 자원을 1개 잃습니다.
[elder_thing]: -4. 실패하면, 플레이 상태인 모든 적의 ‘사냥꾼’ 키워드를 해결합니다.
back_text:
어려움 / 전문가
[skull]: -2(도로 덱에 남은 카드가 6장 이하라면, -2 대신 -4).
[cultist]: -2. 실패하면, 난이도에 모자란 차이마다, 당신의 탑승물에 있는 조사자 한 명은 자신이 가진 단서 1개를 당신이 위치한 장소에 놓습니다.
[tablet]: -3. 실패하면, 난이도에 모자란 차이마다, 당신의 탑승물에 있는 조사자 한 명은 자원을 1개 잃습니다.
[elder_thing]: -4. 플레이 상태인 모든 적의 ‘사냥꾼’ 키워드를 해결합니다.
real_text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -1 (-3 instead if there are 6 or fewer locations remaining in the Road deck).
[cultist]: -1. For each point you fail by, an investigator in your vehicle places 1 of their clues on your location.
[tablet]: -2. For each point you fail by, an investigator in your vehicle loses 1 resource.
[elder_thing]: -4. If you fail, resolve the hunter keyword on each enemy in play.

name: 놈들이 따라붙었어! (v. I)
text: As an additional cost for you to move while not in a vehicle, you must spend 2 actions. Forced - At the end of the round: Starting with the rearmost location, set each location with no vehicles, enemies, or investigators aside, out of play (or add it to the victory display if it has Victory X and has no clues on it). Stop when you reach a location with at least 1 vehicle, enemy, or investigator; or the location behind the rearmost investigator.
flavor: On your way to Falcon Point, you are ambushed by agents of the Order!
real_text: As an additional cost for you to move while not in a vehicle, you must spend 2 actions. Forced - At the end of the round: Starting with the rearmost location, set each location with no vehicles, enemies, or investigators aside, out of play (or add it to the victory display if it has Victory X and has no clues on it). Stop when you reach a location with at least 1 vehicle, enemy, or investigator; or the location behind the rearmost investigator.

name: 악마의 암초에 도사린 공포
text: Spawn - Rearmost location. Hunter. Massive. Retaliate. Forced - When The Terror of Devil Reef would be defeated: Instead, remove all damage from it and exhaust it. It cannot ready for the remainder of the round.

back_text: Each investigator is defeated and suffers 1 physical trauma.
flavor: The Order is out for blood!
back_flavor:
Day is starting to break through the trees to the east, and thanks to the interference of your relentless pursuers, you still haven't made it to Falcon Point. Your car has begun to shake and stutter. You know it is only a matter of minutes before it runs out of fuel, but you have no choice. They've almost caught up to you. You force the accelerator down - 
The turn catches you by surprise. You try to skid to a halt, but it's too late. There is a brief feeling of weightlessness as the wheels leave the ground. Time slows to a crawl. Then, a whirlwind of chaos erupts around you.
The next thing you know, you are crawling out of the wreckage. You are bloody and bruised, but alive. And by some twist of fortune, your pursuers have driven past the spot of your accident. "Next time, I'm driving," Agent Harper jokes between fits of coughing.

For now.

[reaction] When you would fail a skill test, exhaust Jacob Morrison: You get +2 skill value for that test.
[reaction] After a [bless] token is revealed from the chaos bag during a skill test you are performing: Ready Jacob Morrison.

name: 모이라이의 신단
text: 당신이 위치한 장소에 부착합니다. 사용(공물 3개). 부착된 장소는 다음 기능을 획득합니다: “[free] 조우 덱 맨 위 카드를 1장 뽑고, ‘모이라이의 신단’을 소진하고, 공물을 1개 소비합니다: 당신의 버린 카드 더미에서 (레벨 합이 5 이하가 되도록) 카드를 최대 2장까지 당신의 손으로 가져옵니다. 이 장소에 위치한 조사자라면 누구나 이 기능을 격발해도 됩니다.” 아컴 나이츠 2019 “모이라이” 이벤트에서 디자인한 카드입니다.
real_text: Attach to your location. Uses (3 offerings). Attached location gains: "[fast] Draw the top card of the encounter deck, exhaust Shrine of the Moirai, and spend 1 offering: Return up to 2 cards with a total combined level of 5 or less from your discard pile to your hand. Any investigator at this location may trigger this ability." Card design by the Moirai at Arkham Nights 2019.

name: 휘둘러차기
text: 전투. 이번 공격에서 당신의 능력값에 당신의 [agility]을 추가합니다. 이번 공격은 +1 피해를 줍니다. 성공하면, 공격받은 적을 자동 회피합니다.
flavor: “훌륭해, 리. 다시 한 번 더.”
real_text: Fight. Add your [agility] to your skill value for this attack. This attack deals +1 damage. If you succeed, automatically evade the attacked enemy.

name: 호접검
text: [action]: 전투. 당신은 이번 공격에서 +1 [combat]을 얻습니다. 이번 공격 후, 당신은 한 번 더 전투하기 위해 ‘호접검’을 소진해도 됩니다. 해당 공격에서 당신의 능력값에 당신의 [agility]을 추가합니다. 해당 공격은 +1 피해를 줍니다.
flavor: 숙련자의 손아귀에서는 마치 길게 뻗은 손날과도 같이 유려하게 움직인다.
real_text: [action]: Fight. You get +1 [combat] for this attack. After this attack, you may exhaust Butterfly Swords to fight again, adding your [agility] to your skill value for that attack. That attack deals +1 damage.

name: 별들 사이에 쓰여 있나니
text:
신속. 당신의 차례 동안에만 플레이할 수 있습니다.
당신의 덱 맨 위 카드를 1장 버립니다. 그 카드가 약점이라면, 그 카드를 당신의 덱에 다시 섞어넣습니다. 그 외의 경우, 당신의 차례가 끝날 때까지, (그 카드가 당신의 버린 카드 더미에 있는 동안) 그 카드를 당신이 수행하는 적합한 능력 테스트마다 소모합니다.
real_text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Discard the top card of your deck. If that card is a weakness, shuffle it back into your deck. Otherwise, for the remainder of your turn, while that card is in your discard pile, commit it to each eligible skill test you perform.

name: 용 장대
text: 당신에게 마법 슬롯이 1칸 추가됩니다. [action]: 전투. 이미 차지되어 있는 당신의 마법 슬롯마다, 당신은 이번 공격에서 +1 [combat]을 얻습니다. 당신의 마법 슬롯이 2칸 이상 차지되어 있다면, 이번 공격은 +1 피해를 줍니다.
real_text: You have 1 additional arcane slot. [action]: Fight. You get +1 [combat] for this attack for each of your arcane slots that is filled. If at least 2 of your arcane slots are filled, this attack deals +1 damage.

name: 천구 도해서
text:
[fast] ‘천구 도해서’를 소진합니다: 당신의 덱 맨 위 카드를 1장 확인해 봅니다. 그 카드가 약점이 아니라면, 그 카드를 ‘천구 도해서’에 뒷면으로 부착합니다(부착된 카드는 최대 5장).
[fast]: ‘천구 도해서’에 부착된 카드 1장을 적합한 능력 테스트에 소모합니다. 그 테스트가 성공하면, 그 카드를 버리는 것이 아니라, 그 대신 당신의 손으로 가져옵니다. (테스트당 1번 한정.)
real_text:
[fast] Exhaust Astronomical Atlas: Look at the top card of your deck. If it is not a weakness, attach it facedown to Astronomical Atlas (max 5 cards attached).
[fast]: Commit a card attached to Astronomical Atlas to an eligible skill test. If that test succeeds, add that card to your hand instead of discarding it. (Limit once per test.)

name: 수적 우위
text: 당신이 조종하는 카드 가운데 서로 다른 역할군마다 ‘수적 우위’는 [wild] 아이콘을 획득합니다.
flavor: “뒤 좀 맡아 줄래? 사실, 앞쪽도 맡아 줬으면 좋겠어.”
real_text: Strength in Numbers gains a [wild] icon for each different class among cards you control.

name: 의과대 학생
text: [reaction] ‘의과대 학생’이 플레이 영역에 들어온 후: 당신이 위치한 장소에 있는 조사자 한 명 또는 [[조력자]] 자산 하나에게서 피해 1과 공포 1을 회복시킵니다.
flavor: “이거 하면 학점 딸 수 있는 거 맞죠?”
real_text: [reaction] After Medical Student enters play: Heal 1 damage and 1 horror from an investigator or [[Ally]] asset at your location.

name: 마이클 레이
text:
당신은 +1 [intellect]과 +1 [combat]을 얻습니다.
[reaction] 당신이 조사하는 데 성공한 후: 토큰 저장소에서 자원을 1개 가져와 ‘마이클 레이’에 놓습니다. 이렇게 놓인 자원은 증거로 간주합니다(증거는 최대 3개).
[reaction] 당신이 공격을 개시할 때, ‘마이클 레이’를 소진하고 증거를 1개 소비합니다: 당신은 이번 공격에서 +1 피해를 줍니다.
real_text: You get +1 [intellect] and +1 [combat]. [reaction] After you successfully investigate: Place 1 resource (from the token pool) on Michael Leigh, as evidence (to a maximum of 3 evidence). [reaction] When you initiate an attack, exhaust Michael Leigh and spend 1 evidence: You deal +1 damage for this attack.

name: 점복술
text: 사용(충전 4회). [action]: 조사. 당신은 이번 조사에서 [intellect] 대신 [willpower]를 사용해도 되며, 당신은 +1 능력값을 얻습니다. 성공하면, 충전을 1회 또는 2회 소비합니다. 당신이 위치한 장소에서 단서를 1개 발견하는 것이 아니라, 그 대신 소비한 충전 개수만큼 당신이 위치한 장소에서 단서를 발견합니다. 난이도를 넘어선 차이 0으로 성공하면, 당신의 손에서 카드를 1장 선택해서 버립니다.
real_text: Uses (4 charges). [action]: Investigate. For this investigation, you may use [willpower] instead of [intellect], and you get +1 skill value. If you succeed, spend 1 or 2 charges. Instead of discovering a clue at your location, discover 1 clue at your location for each charge spent. If you succeed by 0, choose and discard a card from your hand.

name: 흐릿한 잔상
text: 사용(충전 3회). [action] ‘흐릿한 잔상’에 충전이 남아 있다면: 회피. 당신은 이번 회피 시도에서 [agility] 대신 [willpower]를 사용해도 되며, 당신은 +1 능력값을 얻습니다. 성공하면, 충전 1회를 소비합니다 (그리고) 이번 차례에 추가로 행동을 1번 더 수행해도 됩니다. 난이도를 넘어선 차이 0으로 성공하면, 피해를 1 받습니다.
real_text: Uses (3 charges). [action] If Blur has charges remaining: Evade. For this evasion attempt, you may use [willpower] instead of [agility], and you get +1 skill value. If you succeed, spend 1 charge and you may take an additional action this turn. If you succeed by 0, take 1 damage.

name: 안개 속 한 줄기 빛
text:
쉬움 / 보통
[skull]: -1. 당신이 위치한 장소가 침수된 상태라면, 다른 혼돈 토큰을 하나 더 공개합니다.
[cultist]: -2. 실패하면, 이번 테스트가 끝난 후, 당신이 위치한 장소의 침수 수준을 한 단계 높입니다.
[tablet]: -3. 당신이 위치한 장소가 침수된 상태이고 이번 테스트가 실패했다면, 피해를 1 받습니다.
[elder_thing]: -4. 실패하면, 교전 상태가 아니고 준비 상태인 적 중에, 가장 가까운 적 하나를 당신이 위치한 장소를 향해 1칸 이동시킵니다. 이렇게 이동하는 동안 그 적은 ‘냉담한’ 키워드를 잃습니다.
back_text:
어려움 / 전문가
[skull]: -2. 당신이 위치한 장소가 침수된 상태라면, 다른 혼돈 토큰을 하나 더 공개합니다.
[cultist]: -2. 실패하면, 이번 테스트가 끝난 후, 당신이 위치한 장소의 침수 수준을 한 단계 높입니다(그렇게 할 수 없다면, 그 대신 공포를 1 받습니다).
[tablet]: -3. 당신이 위치한 장소가 침수된 상태이고 이번 테스트가 실패했다면, 피해를 2 받습니다.
[elder_thing]: -4. 교전 상태가 아닌 적 중에, 가장 가까운 적 하나를 당신이 위치한 장소를 향해 1칸 이동시킵니다. 이렇게 이동하는 동안 그 적은 ‘냉담한’ 키워드를 잃습니다.
real_text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -1. If your location is flooded, reveal an additional chaos token.
[cultist]: -2. If you fail, after this test ends, increase the flood level of your location.
[tablet]: -3. If you fail this test and your location is flooded, take 1 damage.
[elder_thing]: -4. If you fail, move the nearest ready unengaged enemy once toward your location. It loses aloof during this movement.

name: 인스머스 만에 피어오른 안개
text: Locations on the same row are connected to one another. Forced - When this agenda advances: Move all doom on it to the next agenda.
back_text: Spawn the set-aside Oceiros Marsh enemy engaged with the lead investigator. Place the set-aside blue key on Oceiros Marsh. Shuffle each set-aside copy of Worth His Salt into the encounter deck. Each investigator loses each of their clues. Put the set-aside Lighthouse Basement location into play directly below Lighthouse Stairwell. Advance the act directly to act 2a (do not resolve act 1b).
flavor: A curl of mist wraps the lighthouse in an otherworldy veil. The waves lap at the rocks on the shoreline like hungry, wet tongues. Overhead, the moon gleams unnaturally bright in the sky. You have a curious feeling you are not alone...
back_flavor:
You don't see the attack coming until it is too late. Just as you round a corner, you are struck across the head and sent reeling. Your ambusher pins you against the wall, his grin full of sharp, jagged teeth. You recognize the repulsive face from your memories.
"It's you again," Oceiros says with a hint of surprise in his croaking voice. "So you're the ones who've been snooping around. No matter. Your meddling ends now."
real_text: Locations on the same row are connected to one another. Forced - When this agenda advances: Move all doom on it to the next agenda.

name: 바다처럼 불변하도다
text: Locations on the same row are connected to one another. Forced - When an investigator is captured: Advance this agenda. Forced - When this agenda advances: Move all doom on it to the next agenda.
back_text: Each investigator is captured. Place each of their keys on Holding Cells. If Oceiros Marsh is in play, set him aside, out of play. Shuffle each set-aside copy of Taken Captive into the encounter deck. Reveal the Lighthouse Basement. Put Sunken Grotto (Lower Depths) into play directly below Sunken Grotto (Upper Depths) and Sunken Grotto (Final Depths) into play directly below Sunken Grotto (Lower Depths). Then, put random set-aside Tidal Tunnel locations into play until there are exactly 4 locations on each row, except for the row with the Lantern Room. (See Campaign Guide for diagram.) Advance the act directly to act 3a (do not resolve act 2b).
flavor: The Order knows you’re here. You have little time to spare - you have to find the way into their lair before they mobilize to capture you!
back_flavor: Suddenly, you are ambushed by more of the repulsive hybrid creatures than you can possibly fend off. Cold, scaled hands grab your arms and pin them behind your back. The next thing you know, a sack is thrown over your head, obscuring your vision. You struggle in vain against your captors, but you are outnumbered and outmatched. "Take them below," a croaking voice commands. "They must learn the consequences of trespassing on sacred ground."
real_text: Locations on the same row are connected to one another. Forced - When an investigator is captured: Advance this agenda. Forced - When this agenda advances: Move all doom on it to the next agenda.

name: 차오르는 바닷물
text: Locations on the same row are connected to one another.
back_text: Search all out-of-play areas for Oceiros Marsh and spawn him in the Sunken Grotto (Upper Depths). Remove each [[Falcon Point]] location from the game (or add them to the victory display if they have Victory X and no clues on them). Move each enemy and investigator at those locations to Sunken Grotto (Upper Depths). Each other card at those locations is discarded. Find the 4 bottommost locations that can have their flood levels increased. Increase each of their flood levels.
flavor: A wave of cold familiarity washes over you as you see the water level starting to rise throughout the tunnels. The tide is rolling in. If you aren’t quick, there won’t be much left here to investigate. Luckily, you still have a way out should the tide rise too quickly...
back_flavor: Familiar, heavy breathing echoes across the slick rocks of the caverns and the stone walls of the lighthouse. You duck behind some cover as you hear footsteps approaching. Then comes the loud creaking and slamming of a heavy metal door, followed by a telltale click that stops your heart dead. Someone has sealed the exit to the lighthouse above...
real_text: Locations on the same row are connected to one another.

name: 송골매 곶에 도사린 공포
text: Oceiros Marsh gets +2 [per_investigator] health. Locations on the same row are connected to one another. (Beware - the scenario may not end when this agenda advances, but the tide will continue to rise...)
back_text: Find the 4 bottommost locations that can have their flood levels increased. Increase each of their flood levels. If you cannot, proceed to (→R3). Otherwise, flip this agenda back over and continue playing.
flavor: The crash of waves on the shoreline echoes through the porous tunnels underneath the lighthouse. Your pulse pounds in your ears as you struggle to stay ahead of the water.
back_flavor: The tide continues to rise...
real_text: Oceiros Marsh gets +2 [per_investigator] health. Locations on the same row are connected to one another. (Beware - the scenario may not end when this agenda advances, but the tide will continue to rise...)

name: 등대
text: Objective - Spend the requisite number of clues before the agenda advances.
back_text: Spawn the set-aside Oceiros Marsh enemy in Lighthouse Keeper's Cottage, exhausted. Place the set-aside blue key on him. Shuffle each set-aside copy of Worth His Salt into the encounter deck. Put the set-aside Lighthouse Basement location into play directly below Lighthouse Stairwell. Advance the agenda directly to agenda 2a (do not resolve agenda 1b).
flavor: All signs point to this lighthouse being a base of operations for the Esoteric Order of Dagon. There’s not much left of Innsmouth to investigate, so this is your best chance to find answers. What exactly is the Order up to? You must find out before they realize you’re here...
back_flavor:
As you tiptoe through the old, timeworn structure, you hear muffled conversation from within the small cottage attached to the lighthouse. You press your ear upon a nearby wall and stand perfectly still, your heart racing.
"Find them," a deep, croaking voice orders. "Do not let them reach the grotto. The Order's secrets must be preserved."
"Yes, Oceiros," a few quiet voices reply in unison. You wait until the sound of footsteps has faded before you resume your investigation. It looks like your hunch was right. Oceiros is here!
real_text: Objective - Spend the requisite number of clues before the agenda advances.

name: 방도를 찾아서
text: Objective - If an investigator enters Lighthouse Basement before the agenda advances, advance.
back_text: If Oceiros Marsh is in play, add him to the victory display. Put Sunken Grotto (Lower Depths) into play directly below Sunken Grotto (Upper Depths) and Sunken Grotto (Final Depths) into play directly below Sunken Grotto (Lower Depths). Then, put random set-aside Tidal Tunnel locations into play until there are exactly 4 locations on each row, except for the row with the Lantern Room. (See Campaign Guide for diagram.) Shuffle each set-aside copy of Taken Captive into the encounter deck. Advance the agenda directly to agenda 3a (do not resolve agenda 2b).
flavor: Falcon Point contains many secrets the Order does not wish you to know. Perhaps dealing with Oceiros will open the way.
back_flavor: You use Oceiros's key to open the basement door of the lighthouse, expecting to find a small stone cellar. What you find instead is a network of flooded caverns extending deep into the cliffside of Falcon Point, perhaps even below sea level. You were right to come here - who knows what secrets the Order keeps here, away from prying eyes?
real_text: Objective - If an investigator enters Lighthouse Basement before the agenda advances, advance.

name: 심해의 추종자
text: Forced - At the end of the investigation phase: Each investigator at a fully flooded location must either take 3 damage or move to the location directly below their location. Objective - If each undefeated investigator has resigned, advance. (Hint - You may wish to find what you came for before you leave this place. The black and red keys represent the objects you need the most.)
back_text:
If at least 1 investigator resigned from the Moon Room:
The underwater tunnels seem to go on forever, stretching into murk-ridden eddies. Dark salt water crashes against the glass helmet of your suit. After what feels like an eternity, you burst into the cold evening air, chilled to the bone. You pull the heavy suit off, piece by piece, the moment you reach the shore.
(→R1) If each investigator who resigned did so from the Falcon Point Gatehouse:
You flee into the lonely woods, panting for air. Somehow, you've escaped the denizens of the deep once more.
(→R2)
flavor: Deep below the lighthouse is a web of tunnels filled with information pertaining to the Order’s activities. You must learn what you can before escaping.
real_text: Forced - At the end of the investigation phase: Each investigator at a fully flooded location must either take 3 damage or move to the location directly below their location. Objective - If each undefeated investigator has resigned, advance. (Hint - You may wish to find what you came for before you leave this place. The black and red keys represent the objects you need the most.)

name: 송골매 곶 수위실
text: Falcon Point Gatehouse cannot be fully flooded. [action]: Resign. You head back into the woods, leaving the lighthouse and its mysteries behind. If you control the black or red keys, place each one you control on the current act.
back_text: Falcon Point Gatehouse cannot be fully flooded.
back_flavor: Thick fog obscures your approach as you climb the trail leading to Falcon Point. With any luck, the lighthouse will be abandoned... but luck hasn’t been on your side as of late.
real_text: Falcon Point Gatehouse cannot be fully flooded. [action]: Resign. You head back into the woods, leaving the lighthouse and its mysteries behind. If you control the black or red keys, place each one you control on the current act.

name: 등대 계단실
text:
Lighthouse Stairwell cannot be fully flooded.
[free] If there are any [[Relic]] story assets currently set aside: Add 1 of them to your hand.
back_text: Lighthouse Stairwell cannot be fully flooded.
back_flavor: The heavy door leading into the lighthouse is already ajar. Somebody has been here recently...
real_text:
Lighthouse Stairwell cannot be fully flooded.
[fast] If there are any [[Relic]] story assets currently set aside: Add 1 of them to your hand.

name: 등명기실
text: Lantern Room cannot be flooded. Forced - After Lantern Room is revealed: Place the set-aside white key on it.
back_text: Lantern Room cannot be flooded.
back_flavor: At the very top of the stairwell, a narrow wooden door warped by rain damage blocks your way to the lantern room atop the lighthouse.
real_text: Lantern Room cannot be flooded. Forced - After Lantern Room is revealed: Place the set-aside white key on it.

name: 송골매 곶 절벽
text: Falcon Point Cliffside cannot be fully flooded. [free] If you control the white key: Using the white key, you peer out into the dark, stormy horizon, and something sparks in your memories. Read Flashback XII in the Campaign Guide.
back_text: Falcon Point Cliffside cannot be fully flooded.
back_flavor: The sharp cliffside juts over the Innsmouth coast. Dark waves crash against the jagged rocks. A fall from here would certainly be deadly.
real_text: Falcon Point Cliffside cannot be fully flooded. [fast] If you control the white key: Using the white key, you peer out into the dark, stormy horizon, and something sparks in your memories. Read Flashback XII in the Campaign Guide.

name: 등대지기 오두막
text: Lighthouse Keeper's Cottage cannot be fully flooded. Forced - After Lighthouse Keeper's Cottage is revealed: Place the set-aside yellow key on it.
back_text: Lighthouse Keeper's Cottage cannot be fully flooded.
back_flavor: The cottage next to the lighthouse is in shambles. It’s a wonder the door hasn’t already fallen off its hinges. Beyond, the building’s interior smells of fish and mold.
real_text: Lighthouse Keeper's Cottage cannot be fully flooded. Forced - After Lighthouse Keeper's Cottage is revealed: Place the set-aside yellow key on it.

name: 가라앉은 동굴
text: [free] Investigators at this location spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Look at the revealed side of a Tidal Tunnel location on this row.
back_text: The door leading into the basement of the lighthouse is locked tight. You cannot enter this location unless you control the blue key.
flavor: Well, that's certainly not a cellar.
back_flavor: A thick padlock bars your way into what you suspect is a small cellar below the lighthouse.
real_text: [fast] Investigators at this location spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Look at the revealed side of a Tidal Tunnel location on this row.

text:

You are bound and dragged deep underground, then thrown into a sealed prison cell, surrounded on all sides by dripping stone walls. Your cries fall on deaf ears as your captor's footsteps fade into the distance.
Remove the captured investigator from their location and return each asset in that investigator's hand slots to their hand. Turn that investigator's mini-card sideways to indicate that they have been captured. Captured investigators cannot move, fight, or be engaged. Flip this story card over to its "Holding Cells" side and put it into play. It is not on any existing row or column, and is only connected to Sunken Grotto locations through its connection icons. Place the captured investigator in Holding Cells. From now on, whenever an investigator is captured, resolve this same effect (return each asset in their hand slots to their hand, turn their mini-card sideways, and place them in Holding Cells).

back_text: 덱 크기: 30장. 덱 구성 선택지: 레벨 0-3 수호자 카드([guardian]), 레벨 0-3 [[통찰]] 카드, 레벨 0-3 [[전술]] 카드, 레벨 0-5 중립 카드. 덱 구성 요구조건(덱 크기에 포함되지 않습니다): 로랜드의 38구경 특제 권총, 은폐, 무작위 기본 약점 카드 1장. 추가 경험치: 당신은 추가 경험치 5점을 가지고 캠페인을 시작합니다(이 추가 경험치는 독립 시나리오 모드에서 경험치에 따라 받아야 하는 약점 개수에 영향을 미치지 않습니다).
flavor: “보안관, 내가 소란을 일으킬 일이 있다면, 그럴만한 문제가 있기 때문 아니겠습니까.”
back_flavor: 로랜드는 절차와 규칙을 지키는 것에서 안정감을 느껴왔다. 로랜드는 요원이라는 직업이 어떤 주어진 상황 속에서도 따를 수 있는 지침이 있다는 점에 안도했다. 하지만 최근, 그의 연방 요원 수첩에서는 적혀 있지 않은 케이스를 맡게 되었다. 기괴한 괴물, 시간과 공간을 통하는 차원문, 마법 주문을 맞닥뜨렸을 때 어떻게 해야 하는지는 그의 연방 수첩 어디에도 없었다. 그의 눈으로 보지 못했다면, 결코 믿지 않았을 일들이 일어나고 있었다... 그리고 이것들을 그의 윗선에서 이해할 리도 없었다.

text: Forced - When a non-weakness [[Cultist]] enemy would be defeated: Heal damage from that enemy until it has 1 remaining health, instead. Forced - If Roland Banks is defeated: Proceed to (→R2) [action]: Resign. You don't want to miss your deadline, so you close the case.
back_text: Remove a [[Cultist]] enemy in the victory display from the game (Mr. Grey, if able). (→R1).
flavor: Your superiors are pressuring you to drop your investigation. Mr. Grey's influence, no doubt. Meanwhile, he and his lackies are doing everything in their power to quietly remove you from the equation, once and for all.
back_flavor:
"It's not enough," your superior scolds you. "I'm sorry, but it's just too contrived for me to believe. And if I don't believe it, the courts won't, either. I mean, honestly. Cults? Human sacrifices?"
You grit your teeth and slam your hand down on the myriad documents and evidence you've collected. It's all there, you insist.
"It's been weeks and you don't have a real case here. Just a lot of circumstantial mumbo-jumbo," he deflects. "And besides, Mr. Grey is a cornerstone of this community. That you would disparage him with these accusations..." The hint of derision towards you in his voice gives him away. Is he on Grey's payroll? Or worse? Either way, it's clear arguing won't get you anywhere. You know better than to make a fuss. You'll have to keep your head down and do things your own way if you want to make a difference in Arkham.

[fast] Spend 1 resource: Exhaust a [[Cultist]] enemy engaged with you (it remains engaged). Only Roland Banks may trigger this ability.] Objective - Parley with as many conspirators as you can. If 10 [[Cultist]] enemies are in the victory display, advance.
flavor: Taking down the culprits behind the sacrifices can only be done with proof, in a court of law. You'll have to do this fair and square.
back_flavor:
Mr. Grey paces the length of his cell, glaring at you from behind the bars. "You're going to regret this, Agent Banks," he snarls. "You'll be begging for my mercy when this is over."
You politely remind Mr. Grey that threatening a federal agent is a felony.
"There are worse things to be afraid of than the likes of you," he replies, before slumping into the corner of his cell, defeated.
The true culprit is behind bars, but you still don't know what his real purpose was in aiding the conspirators behind the murders. What could possibly compel one to take the lives of so many? You don't know - but you intend to find out.

What was once the rhythmic drip, drip, drip of trickling water is now a distant, resounding roar of rushing floodwater. But there is also something else. The rumbling of something enormous, something that stirs under the bedrock...

Choose an investigator to take control of the set-aside Thomas Dawson story asset. For the remainder of this scenario, Thomas Dawson does not take up an ally slot. That investigator may also take control of 1 spent key on the scenario reference card.
flavor: "Glancing up at the window I had left, I observed it was still dark, though far across the crumbling chimneys to the north I could see lights ominously blazing in the Order of Dagon Hall..." - H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Shadow over Innsmouth</u>
back_flavor:
Hearing footsteps up ahead, you press yourself against a nearby wall, fearing the worst. You and your would-be ambusher leap out at the same time, brandishing your weapons... then immediately withdraw once you recognize one another.
"Oh, it's you," Dawson says, holstering his handgun. "I've searched that entire wing," he says, motioning to the hall he came from. "Found this, but not much else." He offers the key in his possession, then pulls out his flashlight and takes the lead. "Might as well stick together from here on out."

text: Forced - When your turn begins, if you are at a fully flooded location, you struggle for air: When your turn ends, if you did not enter an unflooded or partially flooded location during your turn, take 5 direct damage.

flavor: The building rumbles to its foundations. Something sinister is happening deep below the halls of the Order of Dagon. If you don't stop it, who knows what may be unleashed?
back_flavor: Suddenly, a tremendous sound thunders through the building, like a furious explosion and the resonance of a booming voice all at once. At first you think the building must be collapsing. You take cover and lift your arms above your head to shield yourself from falling rubble, but no debris strikes you. Instead, it is an echoing roar that brings you to your knees and forces the air out of your lungs. Your eardrums threaten to shatter as the sound grows louder and louder. Darkness creeps into your vision until it swallows your memories whole.

Remove each location other than Grand Entryway from the game (or add them to the victory display if they have Victory X and no clues on them), discarding each card at those locations. Shuffle the set-aside Tidal Tunnel locations and put each of them into play. Increase the flood level of each location. Shuffle each set-aside Syzygy and Tidal Alignment card into the encounter deck, along with the encounter discard pile.
flavor: "We all hed to take the Oath o' Dagon, an' later on they was secon' an' third Oaths that some of us took." - H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Shadow over Innsmouth</u>
back_flavor: Each of the Order's chambers are devoted to an aspect of their grand scheme - the secret that lies at the foundation of the Order, the poison that dwells in the roots of Innsmouth - but whatever that secret is, it is just beyond your grasp. At least, until the moment you discover the truth behind the building itself: It is nothing but a cover for the Order's true headquarters. As you unlock the pathway that leads into the cavernous depths beneath the building, you wonder what secrets could possibly dwell below...
real_text: Each [[Suspect]] enemy gets +1 [per_investigator] health, loses aloof, and cannot be parleyed with. flavor: You descend into the caverns beneath the Order of Dagon's headquarters, unaware of the horrific fate that awaits you in the depths.
back_flavor:
The more you explore the caverns, the more alien and inhuman the architecture becomes. Soon, it feels like you have crossed the threshold of another world entirely. It is reminiscent of the ruins you saw beneath Devil Reef, but those depths are miles from here... right? Or is this network of caves so vast, it spans the entirety of Innsmouth?
Soon you come upon a grand set of doors in the center of the web of gilded corridors. Many other paths stem from this hall, but it is this door - and the strange, heavy breathing that thrums throughout the walls and the floor - that calls to you...
real_text: Each [[Suspect]] enemy gets +1 [per_investigator] health, loses aloof, and cannot be parleyed with. [fast] Spend the blue, red, white, or yellow key: Discard each [[Obstacle]] card attached to your location. Objective - If an investigator has "unlocked the final depths," advance.

name: 세 번째 서약
text: Each [[Suspect]] enemy gets +1 [per_investigator] health, loses aloof, and cannot be parleyed with. [fast] Spend the blue, red, white, or yellow key: Discard each [[Obstacle]] card attached to your location. Objective - Disrupt the Order's ritual by placing clues on this act. If there are 3 [per_investigator] clues on this act, advance.
back_text: In your Campaign Log, record the Order's ritual was disrupted. - If Dagon (Deep in Slumber) is in play, in your Campaign Log, record Dagon still slumbers. - If Dagon (Awakened and Enraged) is in play or in the victory display, in your Campaign Log, record Dagon has awakened. (→R1)
flavor: The Order's final secret lies just beyond this door. The entity to which the Order's service is pledged. The creature that holds them in its clutches. The conspiracy's beating heart.
back_flavor: A sudden stillness permeates the chamber. The only sound you hear is the gentle rippling of the reflecting pool inside the cult's hidden lair, and the pounding of your own heart in your chest as you struggle to understand what you have seen. Whatever ritual the Order was performing has been disrupted by your hand, but Agent Dawson does not look relieved. "Okay. Okay. Right," he says through choked breaths. His hands shake as he lowers his weapon. "Come on, quickly. We have another task to perform." Another task? You have no idea what Dawson is talking about. He notices your confusion and shakes his head. "No time to explain. Follow me." Then a fuzzy darkness overtakes your memories...

name: 웅장한 현관

flavor: Even this deep beneath the surface of the ocean, you can tell that your time is running short. You feel the pull of the tide as it courses through the water. Every bone in your body quakes. The walls breathe as though alive.

name: 대홍수
text: If an [[Ancient One]] enemy is slumbering, flip it to its (Awakened and Enraged) side. flavor: The great flood has begun. With the ritual complete, the seas shall overtake the Earth, and there will be nothing left but the primordial ocean and its denizens. You are all that stands in the way of humanity's extinction.
back_flavor: The chanting of the Deep Ones rises to a crescendo. The alien walls of Y'ha-nthlei twist and contort before your eyes, like lungs desperately clawing for breath. The air becomes thin. Water seeps through the walls. Nothing can stop the pull of the tide now. Nothing can stop the great flood. A triumphant roar sounds throughout the city, and the citizens of the deep rise to meet the cry in their jubilance. You collapse in exhaustion and resignation. Your part is over, now. The part of humanity will soon follow.

text: Objective - If each investigator is at Gateway to Y'ha-nthlei and the investigators possess each of the following keys (blue, red, yellow, and green), you may choose to advance.
back_text: Remove each location other than Gateway to Y'ha-nthlei from the game (or add them to the victory display if they have Victory X and no clues remaining). Discard each card at those locations. Put set-aside locations into play as shown in the Campaign Guide, following the "Act 2 Setup" instructions. (Note that the number of Y'ha-nthlei locations used and the arrangement of the locations varies depending on the number of investigators in the game.) Put the set-aside Hydra enemy into play in the Lair of Hydra, (Deep in Slumber) side faceup. Put the set-aside Dagon enemy into play in the Lair of Dagon. Check Campaign Log. If Dagon has awakened, he enters play (Awakened and Enraged) side faceup. If Dagon still slumbers, he enters play (Deep in Slumber) side faceup.
flavor: Finally you reach the gateway to the final depths: a swirling vortex of otherworldly currents beyond which Y'ha-nthlei, the city of the Deep Ones, waits. Somehow, you must gain entrance...
back_flavor: A maelstrom of currents tugs at your flesh as you cross through the gateway. When you emerge on the other side, you are no longer in the simple tidal caverns beneath Devil Reef, but inside a vast city within the depths: a city of otherworldly, alien architecture and, surprisingly, riches beyond your wildest imagination.

If each location in play is unflooded, advance.

Victory 2.
flavor: Deep within the city of Y'ha-nthlei, the Deep Ones are performing a ritual that will drown the Earth under the seas. The only way to counteract this ritual is to unveil the depths and expose the city to the sky.
back_flavor: The seas part with a roaring torrent. Chill air flows through the corridors of Y'ha-nthlei as it rises. When the stars look down upon its alien, emerald halls, something in the air changes. There is a sound like a snap and the hissing of air being pulled through the vacuum of space. Then, like automobiles lurching to life, the Earth and the Moon begin to move once more.

If each location in play is unflooded, advance.

name: 해저 도시 (v. II)
text: Objective - Recover the riches of the Deep Ones. If the Lair of Dagon, the Lair of Hydra, and the Vault of Riches with the purple key have no clues on them, advance.
back_text: Add this card to the victory display. - If there is another act card in play, you may choose to either continue playing in order to accomplish the objective on that act card, or proceed immediately to (→R1) without fulfilling that objective. - If there are no other act cards in play, proceed to (→R1). Victory 2.
flavor: You've agreed to help Agent Harper complete her mission to find and bring back the vast wealth of Y'ha-nthlei. Who knows what the government will do with such riches...
back_flavor: The gold and jewels hoarded in the vaults of the Deep Ones are too plentiful to count. There is no doubt in your mind: This is how the creatures - and by proxy, the Esoteric Order of Dagon - were able to manipulate the people of Innsmouth and bring more into their fold. Even a few handfuls of such riches would be enough for one to live comfortably for the rest of their life. You and Agent Harper grab only the most valuable relics you can find, leaving the rest to sink with the remainder of the city. "We have submarines stationed off the coast. When we're done here, they'll blow this place apart," she explains.
real_text: Objective - Recover the riches of the Deep Ones. If the Lair of Dagon, the Lair of Hydra, and the Vault of Riches with the purple key have no clues on them, advance.

name: 해저 도시 (v. III)
text: Objective - Collapse the vault containing the Deep Ones' riches. If Dagon and Hydra each have at least 4 [per_investigator] damage on them, advance.
back_text: Add this card to the victory display. - If there is another act card in play, you may choose to either continue playing in order to accomplish the objective on that act card, or proceed immediately to (→R1) without fulfilling that objective. - If there are no other act cards in play, proceed to (→R1). Victory 2.
flavor: You refuse to be a pawn in the government's schemes. Even so, you don't wish Agent Harper to come to any harm. You tell her to escape while she can, and she slips away, cursing under her breath. Now you have a new goal - send the riches of Y'ha-nthlei into the depths so they can never again be used against humanity.
back_flavor: With the deities of the Deep Ones thrashing and howling in pain, sections of the city begin to collapse all around you. Hoping to use this to your advantage, you lure the creatures closer and closer to the vaults where their riches are held. The vast hoards of gold and jewels are no doubt how the creatures - and by proxy, the Esoteric Order of Dagon - were able to manipulate the people of Innsmouth and bring more into their fold. You cannot let that ever happen again. One final blow sends one of the creatures staggering through the wall. The ceiling collapses, and a torrent of seawater follows. You escape just before you are caught inside.

name: 노먼 위더스
text: 당신의 덱 맨 위 카드 1장을 공개해 둔 채로 게임을 진행합니다. 라운드당 한 번, 당신의 덱 맨 위 카드 1장을 당신의 손에 있는 것처럼 간주하여 자원 비용을 1만큼 낮춰 플레이해도 됩니다. 강제 - 당신의 덱 맨 위 카드로 약점이 공개된 후: 그 카드를 뽑습니다. [elder_sign] 효과: +X. 당신의 덱 맨 위 카드 1장과 당신의 손에 있는 카드 1장을 맞바꿔도 됩니다. X는 당신의 덱 맨 위 카드의 자원 비용입니다.
back_text: 덱 크기: 30장. 덱 구성 선택지: 레벨 0 탐구자 카드([seeker]), 레벨 1-5 신비주의자 카드([mystic]), 레벨 0-5 중립 카드, 이외의 레벨 0 신비주의자 카드([mystic]) 최대 5장. 덱 구성 요구조건(덱 크기에 포함되지 않습니다): 리브르 디봉, 종말의 전조, 무작위 기본 약점 카드 1장.
back_flavor: 별은 수많은 비밀을 안고 있고, 노먼은 불가사의한 현상을 무시하는 부류의 사람이 아니었다. 그리하여 밤하늘에서 감쪽같이 여섯 개의 별이 동시에 사라졌을 때, 비록 노먼의 동료들은 그저 상상일 뿐이라고 말했지만 노먼으로서는 도저히 간과할 수 없었다. 노먼은 해답을 찾는 데 수 년이 걸렸고, 그동안 교수로서의 경력도 끝장날 위기까지 내몰렸다. 그러나 결국 그는 한 고서에서 답을 찾아내고야 말았다. 고서에는 별들의 위치와 그것이 사라지는 순서는 물론, 그 날짜와 시간까지 기록되어 있었다. 고서에 따르면 이는 만물의 종말을 예고하는 징조라 한다. 인간이 이룩한 모든 것을 갈기갈기 찢어버릴 거대한 괴수가 도래할 거라는 전조였다. 노먼은 괴수가 세상을 파괴하는 것을 막기 위해 자신이 무엇을 할 수나 있을지 확신하지 못하지만, 별들 사이에 그 답이 있다면 반드시 찾아내리라.

name: 몬터레이 잭
text:
[reaction] 당신의 차례 끝에, 현재 당신이 위치한 장소가 당신이 이번 라운드를 시작한 장소에서 1칸 떨어져 있다면: 자원을 1개 획득하거나 카드를 1장 뽑습니다(당신이 이번 라운드를 시작한 장소에서 2칸 이상 떨어져 있다면, 하나만 하는 것이 아니라, 그 대신 둘 다 합니다).
[elder_sign] 효과: +1. 현재 당신이 위치한 장소가 당신이 이번 라운드를 시작한 장소에서 1칸 이상 떨어져 있다면, 자원을 1개 획득하거나 카드를 1장 뽑습니다.
back_text: 덱 크기: 30장. 덱 구성 선택지: 레벨 0 무법자([rogue]) 카드, 레벨 1-5 탐구자([seeker]) 카드, 레벨 0-5 중립 카드, 이외의 레벨 0 탐구자([seeker]) 카드 최대 5장. 덱 구성 요구조건 (덱 크기에 포함되지 않습니다): 든든한 소채찍, 파묻힌 비밀, 무작위 기본 약점 카드 1장.
back_flavor: 잭은 어릴 적에 아버지의 고고학 탐사대를 따라 세계를 누볐다. 스스로의 힘으로 전 세계를 누비는 보물 사냥꾼이자 성공한 고고학자가 된 “몬터레이”는, 아버지의 자취를 따라 고대의 문명들과 잊힌 문화의 유산을 찾아냈다. 그러나 낯익은 문양이 새겨진 은제 펜던트를 발견한 후로, 몬터레이는 자신의 과거 속을 샅샅이 탐험해야만 했다. 그 문양은 몇 년 전 살해당한 아버지의 이마에 새겨져 있던 것과 완전히 똑같았던 것이다. 그날 이후로, 몬터레이는 꿈속에서도 그 문양에 시달렸다. 그러나 몬터레이는 진실에 점차 다가서고 있었다. 아버지의 죽음에 얽힌 불가사의를 풀어내기 전까지 몬터레이는 절대 멈추지 않을 것이다. 그 어떤 대가를 치르는 한이 있더라도…

name: 릴리 첸
text:
당신은 자신의 덱에 있는 모든 ‘규율’을, [[깨지지 않은]] 면이 보이도록 플레이 영역에 두고 게임을 시작합니다.
[elder_sign] 효과: +2. 이번 테스트가 끝난 후, 당신이 조종하는 [[깨진]] ‘규율’ 하나를 [[깨지지 않은]] 면으로 뒤집습니다.
back_text: 덱 크기: 30장. 덱 구성 선택지: 레벨 0 신비주의자([mystic]) 카드, 레벨 1-5 수호자([guardian]) 카드, 레벨 0-5 중립 카드, 이외의 레벨 0 수호자([guardian]) 카드 최대 5장. 덱 구성 요구조건 (덱 크기에 포함되지 않습니다): ‘규율’ 자산마다 ‘운명을 짊어지다’ 사본 1장씩(아래 참조), 무작위 기본 약점 카드 1장. 덱 구성 제한: [[총]] 자산 포함 불가. 추가 요구조건: 덱을 구성할 때, ‘규율’ 자산 하나를 선택하여 당신의 덱에 추가합니다. 이는 덱 구성 요구조건의 일부로 간주합니다. 경험치 누계 15점마다, 서로 다른 ‘규율’ 자산 1장씩을 선택하여 덱에 추가해도 됩니다.
flavor: “일생을 악에 맞서기 위해 준비해 왔어요. 절대 흔들리지 않을 겁니다.”
back_flavor: 첸 리는 말수가 적은 사람이다. 그러나 입을 열어야 할 때는 신중하고 현명하게 말하는 사람이다. 첸 리는 일생을 규율에 따라 훈련한 끝에, 조금도 주저하지 않고 물 흐르듯 유려하게 무예를 구사하게 되었다. 그녀를 길러 온 수도승들은, 첸 리가 거대한 악에 맞서야 하는 특별한 운명을 타고났다고 여긴다. 이제 그들은 머지않아 악이 도래할 것이고, 오직 첸 리만이 그 악을 막을 수 있다고 믿는다.

text:
